AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for two Cognito identity pools (unauthenticated) with associated IAM roles for Lambda and Step Functions testing."

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: Test
    Description: "Environment name used for tagging purposes."

Resources:
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cognito Identity Pool for Lambda-based access
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      IdentityPoolName: !Sub "LambdaIdentityPool-${Environment}"
      # No CognitoIdentityProviders – unauthenticated only

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cognito Identity Pool for Step Functions-based access
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  StepFunctionsIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      IdentityPoolName: !Sub "StepFunctionsIdentityPool-${Environment}"
      # No CognitoIdentityProviders – unauthenticated only

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Role for Lambda-facing pool
  # Trusts: Cognito (unauthenticated web identity) and Lambda service
  # Permissions: DynamoDB, Lambda, SES
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
              - sts:TagSession
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !Ref LambdaIdentityPool
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaRoleInlinePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ses:SendEmail
                  - ses:SendRawEmail
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Role for Step Functions-facing pool
  # Trusts: Cognito (unauthenticated web identity) and Step Functions service
  # Permissions: Lambda invoke
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  StepFunctionsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
              - sts:TagSession
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !Ref StepFunctionsIdentityPool
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StepFunctionsRoleInlinePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Role Attachment for Lambda pool
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref LambdaIdentityPool
      Roles:
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt LambdaRole.Arn

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Role Attachment for Step Functions pool
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  StepFunctionsIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref StepFunctionsIdentityPool
      Roles:
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt StepFunctionsRole.Arn

Outputs:
  LambdaIdentityPoolId:
    Description: "Cognito Identity Pool ID for Lambda-based access"
    Value: !Ref LambdaIdentityPool
  StepFunctionsIdentityPoolId:
    Description: "Cognito Identity Pool ID for Step Functions-based access"
    Value: !Ref StepFunctionsIdentityPool
  LambdaRoleArn:
    Description: "IAM Role ARN for Lambda-facing pool"
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaRole.Arn
  StepFunctionsRoleArn:
    Description: "IAM Role ARN for Step Functions-facing pool"
    Value: !GetAtt StepFunctionsRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'PCI Compliance Automation: IAM role and SSM documents for Config conformance packs'

Resources:
  # IAM Role for SSM Automation
  PCIAutomationAssumeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'pciautomationassumerole-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ssm.amazonaws.com
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
                - events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PCIAutomationInlinePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:ReleaseAddress
                  - ec2:DescribeAddresses
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                Resource: '*'

  # SSM Automation Document: Restrict Default Security Group
  RestrictDefaultSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: 'Revoke all ingress and egress rules from the VPC default security group'
        parameters:
          SecurityGroupId:
            type: String
            description: 'ID of the default security group to restrict'
        mainSteps:
          - name: RevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRules
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: revoke_default_sg_rules
              InputPayload:
                SecurityGroupId: '{{ SecurityGroupId }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                import json

                def revoke_default_sg_rules(event, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    sg_id = event['SecurityGroupId']
                    # Describe the security group to get existing rules
                    response = ec2.describe_security_groups(GroupIds=[sg_id])
                    sg = response['SecurityGroups'][0]
                    # Revoke all ingress rules
                    if sg['IpPermissions']:
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_ingress(GroupId=sg_id, IpPermissions=sg['IpPermissions'])
                    # Revoke all egress rules
                    if sg['IpPermissionsEgress']:
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_egress(GroupId=sg_id, IpPermissions=sg['IpPermissionsEgress'])
                    return {'Success': True}
            outputs:
              - Name: Success
                Selector: $.Payload.Success
                Type: Boolean

  # SSM Automation Document: Delete Unused Security Groups
  DeleteUnusedSecurityGroups:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: 'Delete a security group if it has no associated resources'
        parameters:
          SecurityGroupId:
            type: String
            description: 'ID of the security group to delete'
        mainSteps:
          - name: DeleteUnusedSecurityGroup
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: delete_unused_sg
              InputPayload:
                SecurityGroupId: '{{ SecurityGroupId }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                import json

                def delete_unused_sg(event, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    sg_id = event['SecurityGroupId']
                    # Check if security group is in use by describing network interfaces
                    response = ec2.describe_network_interfaces(Filters=[{'Name': 'group-id', 'Values': [sg_id]}])
                    if response['NetworkInterfaces']:
                        raise Exception(f'Security group {sg_id} is associated with network interfaces and cannot be deleted')
                    # No associations, proceed to delete
                    ec2.delete_security_group(GroupId=sg_id)
                    return {'Deleted': True}
            outputs:
              - Name: Deleted
                Selector: $.Payload.Deleted
                Type: Boolean

  # SSM Automation Document: Release Unassociated Elastic IPs
  ReleaseUnassociatedEIPs:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: 'Release an unassociated Elastic IP address using its allocation ID'
        parameters:
          AllocationId:
            type: String
            description: 'Allocation ID of the Elastic IP to release'
        mainSteps:
          - name: ReleaseUnassociatedEIP
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: release_unassociated_eip
              InputPayload:
                AllocationId: '{{ AllocationId }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                import json

                def release_unassociated_eip(event, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    allocation_id = event['AllocationId']
                    # Describe the address to check association
                    response = ec2.describe_addresses(AllocationIds=[allocation_id])
                    address = response['Addresses'][0]
                    if 'AssociationId' in address:
                        raise Exception(f'Elastic IP {allocation_id} is still associated and cannot be released')
                    # Release the address
                    ec2.release_address(AllocationId=allocation_id)
                    return {'Released': True}
            outputs:
              - Name: Released
                Selector: $.Payload.Released
                Type: Boolean

  # SSM Automation Document: Update ASG Health Check to ELB
  UpdateASGHealthCheckToELB:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: 'Update an Auto Scaling group health check type to ELB and set grace period to 300 seconds'
        parameters:
          AutoScalingGroupName:
            type: String
            description: 'Name of the Auto Scaling group to update'
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateAutoScalingGroupHealthCheck
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: AutoScaling
              Api: UpdateAutoScalingGroup
              InputPayload:
                AutoScalingGroupName: '{{ AutoScalingGroupName }}'
                HealthCheckType: ELB
                HealthCheckGracePeriod: 300

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template to mirror CodeCommit repositories via CodeBuild with EventBridge triggers'
Parameters:
  ReplicaRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    AllowedValues:
      - us-east-1
      - us-east-2
      - us-west-1
      - us-west-2
      - eu-west-1
      - eu-central-1
      - ap-southeast-1
      - ap-southeast-2
      - ap-northeast-1
    Description: Target AWS region for repository replicas

Resources:
  # CodeBuild IAM Role
  CodeBuildRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: codebuild.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /

  # Inline policy for CodeBuild role
  CodeBuildPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: CodeBuildMirrorPolicy
      Roles:
        - !Ref CodeBuildRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/codebuild/*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - codecommit:GitPull
              - codecommit:GitPush
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:card-service'
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule-service'
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:ecs-pipeline'
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:codecommit:${ReplicaRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:card-service'
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:codecommit:${ReplicaRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule-service'
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:codecommit:${ReplicaRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:ecs-pipeline'

  # CodeBuild Project
  CodeBuildProject:
    Type: AWS::CodeBuild::Project
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'codecommit-mirror-${AWS::StackName}'
      Description: 'Mirrors CodeCommit repositories to replica region'
      ServiceRole: !GetAtt CodeBuildRole.Arn
      Artifacts:
        Type: NO_ARTIFACTS
      Environment:
        Type: LINUX_CONTAINER
        ComputeType: BUILD_GENERAL1_SMALL
        Image: aws/codebuild/amazonlinux2-x86_64-standard:5.0
        PrivilegedMode: false
        EnvironmentVariables:
          - Name: REPLICA_REGION
            Value: !Ref ReplicaRegion
      Source:
        Type: NO_SOURCE
        BuildSpec: |
          version: 0.2
          phases:
            install:
              runtime-versions:
                python: 3.11
              commands:
                - pip install git-remote-codecommit
            build:
              commands:
                - |
                  for repo in card-service rule-service ecs-pipeline; do
                    echo "Cloning ${repo} from source region..."
                    git clone "codecommit::${AWS_REGION}://${repo}" "/tmp/${repo}"
                    cd "/tmp/${repo}"
                    git checkout mainline
                    echo "Adding remote for replica region..."
                    git remote add replica "codecommit::${REPLICA_REGION}://${repo}"
                    echo "Pushing to replica region..."
                    git push replica mainline
                    cd /
                    rm -rf "/tmp/${repo}"
                  done
      EncryptionKey: alias/aws/s3
      TimeoutInMinutes: 10
      QueuedTimeoutInMinutes: 5

  # EventBridge IAM Role
  EventBridgeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /

  # Policy for EventBridge role
  EventBridgePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: EventBridgeCodeBuildStart
      Roles:
        - !Ref EventBridgeRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: codebuild:StartBuild
            Resource: !GetAtt CodeBuildProject.Arn

  # EventBridge Rule
  EventBridgeRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'codecommit-mirror-rule-${AWS::StackName}'
      Description: 'Triggers CodeBuild project on pushes to mainline branch of specified repositories'
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.codecommit
        detail-type:
          - CodeCommit Repository State Change
        resources:
          - !Sub 'arn:aws:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:card-service'
          - !Sub 'arn:aws:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule-service'
          - !Sub 'arn:aws:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:ecs-pipeline'
        detail:
          event:
            - referenceCreated
            - referenceUpdated
          referenceType:
            - branch
          referenceName:
            - mainline
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !GetAtt CodeBuildProject.Arn
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeRole.Arn
          Id: CodeBuildTarget

Outputs:
  CodeBuildProjectName:
    Description: Name of the CodeBuild project
    Value: !Ref CodeBuildProject
  EventBridgeRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge rule
    Value: !GetAtt EventBridgeRule.Arn
  CodeBuildRoleName:
    Description: Name of the IAM role for CodeBuild
    Value: !Ref CodeBuildRole
  EventBridgeRoleName:
    Description: Name of the IAM role for EventBridge
    Value: !Ref EventBridgeRole

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Secure S3 bucket infrastructure for testing with replication and access logging.

Parameters:
  ApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Default: testanu
    Description: Application name used to prefix all resource names.

Resources:
  PrimaryBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-primary-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref AccessLogBucket
        LogFilePrefix: logs/
      ReplicationConfiguration:
        Role: !GetAtt ReplicationRole.Arn
        Rules:
          - Status: Enabled
            Destination:
              Bucket: !GetAtt ReplicaBucket.Arn

  AccessLogBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-logs-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  ReplicaBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Route53 hosted zone and DNS records for Ear Hustle production environment

Parameters:
  Domain:
    Type: String
    Default: earhustlesq.com
    Description: The primary domain name for the hosted zone

Resources:
  HostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref Domain
      HostedZoneTags:
        - Key: prx:ops:environment
          Value: Production
        - Key: prx:dev:application
          Value: Ear Hustle

  # Merged TXT record for root domain (SPF, Google Site Verification, Zoom, ATProto)
  RootDomainTXT:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    DependsOn: HostedZone
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Join [".", [!Ref Domain, ""]]
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 3600
      ResourceRecords:
        - "\"v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com ~all\""
        - "\"google-site-verification=xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx\""
        - "\"zoom-domain-verification=xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx\""
        - "\"did=did:plc:xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx\""

  DMARCRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    DependsOn: HostedZone
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Join [".", ["_dmarc", !Ref Domain, ""]]
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 3600
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub "\"v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:dmarc@${Domain}\""

    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet

        - "10 ALT4.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM."

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for Aurora Global Database failover automation using SSM and Lambda'

Resources:
  SSMRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SSMAutomationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rds:DescribeDBClusters
                  - rds:DescribeGlobalClusters
                  - rds:FailoverGlobalCluster
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - route53-recovery-control:GetRoutingControlState
                  - route53-recovery-control:UpdateRoutingControlState
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:UpdateSecret
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationExecutions
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                Resource: '*'

  LambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaSSMPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationExecutions
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt SSMRole.Arn

  SSMDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: 'Automation document to failover an Aurora Global Database and update ARC routing and Secrets Manager'
        parameters:
          primaryRegion:
            type: String
            description: 'Primary region'
            default: us-east-1
          secondaryRegion:
            type: String
            description: 'Secondary region'
          clusterIdentifier:
            type: String
            description: 'Global cluster identifier'
          routingControlArn:
            type: String
            description: 'ARN of the ARC routing control'
          secretArn:
            type: String
            description: 'ARN of the Secrets Manager secret to update'
        mainSteps:
          - name: DetermineActiveRegion
            action: aws:executeScript
            description: 'Determine the currently active region by reading ARC routing control state'
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                routingControlArn: '{{ routingControlArn }}'
                primaryRegion: '{{ primaryRegion }}'
                secondaryRegion: '{{ secondaryRegion }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                def handler(event, context):
                    client = boto3.client('route53-recovery-control')
                    response = client.get_routing_control_state(RoutingControlArn=event['routingControlArn'])
                    state = response['RoutingControlState']
                    # Assume ON means primary is active, OFF means secondary is active
                    if state == 'On':
                        active_region = event['primaryRegion']
                    else:
                        active_region = event['secondaryRegion']
                    return {'ActiveRegion': active_region}
            outputs:
              - Name: ActiveRegion
                Selector: $.Payload.ActiveRegion
                Type: String
          - name: FailoverGlobalCluster
            action: aws:executeScript
            description: 'Perform the global cluster failover to the secondary region'
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                clusterIdentifier: '{{ clusterIdentifier }}'
                secondaryRegion: '{{ secondaryRegion }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                def handler(event, context):
                    client = boto3.client('rds')
                    response = client.failover_global_cluster(
                        GlobalClusterIdentifier=event['clusterIdentifier'],
                        TargetRegion=event['secondaryRegion']
                    )
                    return {'FailoverStatus': 'Initiated'}
            outputs:
              - Name: FailoverStatus
                Selector: $.Payload.FailoverStatus
                Type: String
          - name: UpdateRoutingAndSecret
            action: aws:executeScript
            description: 'Flip ARC routing control state and update Secrets Manager secret with new writer endpoint'
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                routingControlArn: '{{ routingControlArn }}'
                secretArn: '{{ secretArn }}'
                clusterIdentifier: '{{ clusterIdentifier }}'
                primaryRegion: '{{ primaryRegion }}'
                secondaryRegion: '{{ secondaryRegion }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                import json
                def handler(event, context):
                    # Update routing control to point to secondary region (new primary)
                    arc_client = boto3.client('route53-recovery-control')
                    # Flip state: if currently On, set Off; if Off, set On
                    current_state = arc_client.get_routing_control_state(RoutingControlArn=event['routingControlArn'])['RoutingControlState']
                    new_state = 'Off' if current_state == 'On' else 'On'
                    arc_client.update_routing_control_state(
                        RoutingControlArn=event['routingControlArn'],
                        RoutingControlState=new_state
                    )
                    # Get the new writer endpoint from the global cluster
                    rds_client = boto3.client('rds')
                    global_cluster = rds_client.describe_global_clusters(GlobalClusterIdentifier=event['clusterIdentifier'])['GlobalClusters'][0]
                    # Find the writer endpoint in the new primary region (secondaryRegion)
                    writer_endpoint = None
                    for member in global_cluster['GlobalClusterMembers']:
                        if member['IsWriter']:
                            writer_endpoint = member['DBClusterArn']  # ARN, but we need endpoint? Actually we need the writer endpoint from the cluster.
                            # Better to describe the cluster in the new primary region
                            break
                    # Describe the cluster in the new primary region to get endpoint
                    rds_regional = boto3.client('rds', region_name=event['secondaryRegion'])
                    clusters = rds_regional.describe_db_clusters(DBClusterIdentifier=event['clusterIdentifier'].split(':')[-1])  # extract cluster name
                    writer_endpoint = clusters['DBClusters'][0]['Endpoint']
                    # Update the secret
                    secrets_client = boto3.client('secretsmanager')
                    secrets_client.update_secret(
                        SecretId=event['secretArn'],
                        SecretString=json.dumps({'writerEndpoint': writer_endpoint})
                    )
                    return {'NewWriterEndpoint': writer_endpoint}

  TriggerFailover:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: TriggerFailover
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import json
          import os

          def handler(event, context):
              ssm = boto3.client('ssm')
              # Expect event to contain parameters
              params = {
                  'primaryRegion': [event.get('primaryRegion', 'us-east-1')],
                  'secondaryRegion': [event['secondaryRegion']],
                  'clusterIdentifier': [event['clusterIdentifier']],
                  'routingControlArn': [event['routingControlArn']],
                  'secretArn': [event['secretArn']]
              }
              response = ssm.start_automation_execution(
                  DocumentName='AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument',
                  DocumentVersion='$DEFAULT',
                  Parameters=params,
                  AutomationAssumeRole=os.environ.get('SSM_ROLE_ARN')
              )
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': json.dumps({
                      'AutomationExecutionId': response['AutomationExecutionId']
                  })
              }
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SSM_ROLE_ARN: !GetAtt SSMRole.Arn

Outputs:
  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: 'ARN of the TriggerFailover Lambda function'
    Value: !GetAtt TriggerFailover.Arn
  SSMDocumentName:
    Description: 'Name of the SSM Automation document'
    Value: !Ref SSMDocument

                - echo "Build completed on `date`"

  BuildImageFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 900
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          import time
          import json

          def handler(event, context):
              project_name = event['ResourceProperties']['ProjectName']
              if event['RequestType'] in ['Create', 'Update']:
                  codebuild = boto3.client('codebuild')
                  logs_client = boto3.client('logs')
                  try:
                      response = codebuild.start_build(projectName=project_name)
                      build_id = response['build']['id']
                      print(f"Started build: {build_id}")
                      while True:
                          build = codebuild.batch_get_builds(ids=[build_id])['builds'][0]
                          status = build['buildStatus']
                          print(f"Build {build_id} status: {status}")
                          if status == 'SUCCEEDED':
                              cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {"BuildId": build_id})
                              return
                          elif status in ['FAILED', 'FAULT', 'STOPPED', 'TIMED_OUT']:
                              print(f"Build {build_id} failed. Details: {json.dumps(build, default=str)}")
                              log_group = build.get('logsGroupName', '')
                              log_stream = build.get('logsStreamName', '')
                              if log_group and log_stream:
                                  try:
                                      log_events = logs_client.get_log_events(logGroupName=log_group, logStreamName=log_stream, limit=20)
                                      for event_entry in log_events['events']:
                                          print(event_entry['message'])
                                  except Exception as log_err:
                                      print(f"Could not retrieve logs: {log_err}")
                              cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {"BuildId": build_id, "Status": status})
                              return
                          time.sleep(5)
                  except Exception as e:
                      print(f"Exception: {str(e)}")
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {"Error": str(e)})
                      return
              elif event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
      Environment:
        Variables:
          PROJECT_NAME: !Ref CodeBuildProject

  BuildImageCustomResource:
    Type: Custom::BuildImage
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt BuildImageFunction.Arn
      ProjectName: !Ref CodeBuildProject

  AppRunnerService:
    Type: AWS::AppRunner::Service
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-apprunner'
      SourceConfiguration:
        AuthenticationConfiguration:
          AccessRoleArn: !GetAtt AppRunnerECRAccessRole.Arn
        ImageRepository:
          ImageIdentifier: !Sub '${AWS::AccountId}.dkr.ecr.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${ECRRepository}:latest'
          ImageRepositoryType: ECR
          ImageConfiguration:
            Port: 8080
            StartCommand: /bin/sh -c "echo healthy > /tmp/status && exec python3 -m http.server 8080 --directory /tmp"
            RuntimeEnvironmentVariables:
              - Name: ALLOW_IP_RANGE
                Value: 0.0.0.0/0
              - Name: AWS_REGION
                Value: !Ref AWS::Region
              - Name: AWS_ACCOUNT_ID
                Value: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              - Name: ADMIN_EMAIL
                Value: !Ref AdminEmail
              - Name: ADMIN_USER_NAME
                Value: !Ref AdminUserName
              - Name: QUICKSIGHT_TEMPLATE_ID
                Value: !Ref QuickSightTemplateId
              - Name: QUICKSIGHT_DATASET_ID
                Value: !Ref QuickSightDataSetId
              - Name: QUICKSIGHT_DATASOURCE_ID
                Value: !Ref QuickSightDataSourceId
              - Name: DATABASE_NAME
                Value: !Ref DatabaseName
              - Name: TABLE_NAME
                Value: !Ref TableName
              - Name: FILTER_COLUMN_NAME
                Value: !Ref FilterColumnName
        AutoDeploymentsEnabled: true
      HealthCheckConfiguration:
        Protocol: HTTP
        Path: /status
        Interval: 10
        Timeout: 5
        HealthyThreshold: 1
        UnhealthyThreshold: 3
      InstanceConfiguration:
        Cpu: 1 vCPU
        Memory: 2 GB
        InstanceRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskRole.Arn
    DependsOn:
      - BuildImageCustomResource

  Creates six centralized EventBridge sink event buses and six IAM service roles
  (CloudWatch, CloudFormation, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Slack, and Auto Scaling)
  that allow the EventBridge service to forward organizational security and
  operations events to the matching sink bus in this account.

  OrgPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Organizational prefix used in all resource names.
    Default: org
    MaxLength: 20
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z0-9-]+'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: Deployment environment.
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - prod
  Organization:
    Type: String
    Description: Organization name applied as a tag to all resources.
    Default: ExampleOrg
  CostCenter:
    Type: String
    Description: Cost center applied as a tag to all resources.
    Default: CC-1000
  Owner:
    Type: String
    Description: Team or individual responsible for these resources.
    Default: security-operations

        - Key: CostCenter

        - Key: Owner

        - Key: Purpose

        - Key: Source

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark aligned stack that creates SSM Automation runbooks
  to enable VPC Flow Logs with REJECT traffic capture.
Resources:
  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: 'AWS::KMS::Key'
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: 'Customer managed KMS key for VPC Flow Logs CloudWatch Logs encryption'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: 'AllowRootAccountFullAccess'
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: 'AllowCloudWatchLogsService'
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
  FlowLogsKmsAlias:
    Type: 'AWS::KMS::Alias'
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AliasName: 'alias/cis-vpc-flow-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey
  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: 'AWS::Logs::LogGroup'
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: '/aws/vpc-flow-logs/reject-traffic'
      RetentionInDays: 3653
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
  DeliveryRole:
    Type: 'AWS::IAM::Role'
    Properties:
      RoleName: 'cis-vpc-flow-logs-delivery-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - 'vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com'
                - 'ssm.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: 'cis-vpc-flow-logs-delivery-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: 'AllowLogGroupDelivery'
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc-flow-logs/reject-traffic'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc-flow-logs/reject-traffic:log-stream:*'
              - Sid: 'AllowFlowLogManagement'
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ec2:CreateFlowLogs'
                  - 'ec2:DeleteFlowLogs'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeFlowLogs'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeVpcs'
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: 'AllowPassDeliveryRole'
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'iam:PassRole'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/cis-vpc-flow-logs-delivery-role'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'iam:PassedToService':
                      - 'vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com'
                      - 'ssm.amazonaws.com'
              - Sid: 'AllowFlowLogKmsKeyUse'
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:Encrypt'
                  - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
  AutomationRole:
    Type: 'AWS::IAM::Role'
    Properties:
      RoleName: 'cis-vpc-flow-logs-automation-execution-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: 'ssm.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: 'cis-vpc-flow-logs-automation-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: 'AllowAutomationReadAndFlowLogs'
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ec2:Describe*'
                  - 'ec2:CreateFlowLogs'
                  - 'ec2:DeleteFlowLogs'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeFlowLogs'
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: 'AllowDescribeLogGroups'
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogGroups'
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: 'AllowAutomationExecution'
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ssm:StartAutomationExecution'
                  - 'ssm:GetAutomationExecution'
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: 'AllowPassFlowLogDeliveryRole'
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'iam:PassRole'
                Resource: !GetAtt DeliveryRole.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'iam:PassedToService': 'vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com'
              - Sid: 'AllowPassAutomationRole'
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'iam:PassRole'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/cis-vpc-flow-logs-automation-execution-role'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'iam:PassedToService': 'ssm.amazonaws.com'
              - Sid: 'AllowDecryptFlowLogKmsKey'
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
  DirectRemediationDocument:
    Type: 'AWS::SSM::Document'
    Properties:
      Name: 'CIS-VPCFlowLogs-EnableRejectFlowLogs'
      DocumentType: 'Automation'
      Content:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |-
            {
              "schemaVersion": "0.3",
              "description": "Enables VPC Flow Logs with REJECT traffic capture on the specified VPC.",
              "assumeRole": "{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}",
              "parameters": {
                "VpcId": {
                  "type": "String",
                  "description": "(Required) The ID of the VPC to enable REJECT flow logging on."
                },
                "AutomationAssumeRole": {
                  "type": "String",
                  "description": "(Required) IAM role ARN assumed by SSM Automation.",
                  "default": "${AutomationRoleArn}"
                }
              },
              "mainSteps": [
                {
                  "name": "EnableRejectVpcFlowLogs",
                  "action": "aws:executeScript",
                  "timeoutSeconds": 300,
                  "assumeRole": "{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}",
                  "inputs": {
                    "Runtime": "python3.12",
                    "Handler": "handler",
                    "InputPayload": {
                      "VpcId": "{{ VpcId }}",
                      "LogGroupName": "${LogGroupName}",
                      "DeliveryRoleArn": "${DeliveryRoleArn}"
                    },
                    "Script": "import boto3\n\ndef handler(event, context):\n    vpc_id = event['VpcId']\n    log_group_name = event['LogGroupName']\n    delivery_role_arn = event['DeliveryRoleArn']\n    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')\n    existing_flow_logs = ec2.describe_flow_logs(\n        Filters=[\n            {'Name': 'resource-id', 'Values': [vpc_id]},\n            {'Name': 'traffic-type', 'Values': ['REJECT']}\n        ]\n    ).get('FlowLogs', [])\n    existing = [\n        flow_log\n        for flow_log in existing_flow_logs\n        if flow_log.get('LogDestinationType') == 'cloud-watch-logs'\n        and flow_log.get('LogGroupName') == log_group_name\n    ]\n    if existing:\n        return {\n            'FlowLogId': existing[0]['FlowLogId'],\n            'AlreadyExists': True\n        }\n    created = ec2.create_flow_logs(\n        ResourceType='VPC',\n        ResourceIds=[vpc_id],\n        TrafficType='REJECT',\n        LogDestinationType='cloud-watch-logs',\n        LogGroupName=log_group_name,\n        DeliverLogsPermissionArn=delivery_role_arn\n    )\n    return {\n        'FlowLogId': created['FlowLogIds'][0],\n        'AlreadyExists': False\n    }"
                  }
                }
              ]
            }
          - AutomationRoleArn: !GetAtt AutomationRole.Arn
            LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
            DeliveryRoleArn: !GetAtt DeliveryRole.Arn
  ChangeRequestDocument:
    Type: 'AWS::SSM::Document'
    Properties:
      Name: 'CIS-VPCFlowLogs-EnableRejectFlowLogs-ChangeRequest'
      DocumentType: 'Automation.ChangeTemplate'
      Content:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |-
            {
              "schemaVersion": "0.3",
              "description": "Change Manager change template that requires approval before enabling REJECT VPC Flow Logs.",
              "assumeRole": "{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}",
              "parameters": {
                "VpcId": {
                  "type": "String",
                  "description": "(Required) The ID of the VPC to enable REJECT flow logging on."
                },
                "Approvers": {
                  "type": "String",
                  "description": "(Required) Approvers for the Change Manager change request."
                },
                "ChangeRequestName": {
                  "type": "String",
                  "description": "(Required) Name of the Change Manager change request."
                },
                "AutomationAssumeRole": {
                  "type": "String",
                  "description": "(Required) IAM role ARN assumed by SSM Automation.",
                  "default": "${AutomationRoleArn}"
                }
              },
              "mainSteps": [
                {
                  "name": "RunRejectFlowLogsRemediation",
                  "action": "aws:executeAutomation",
                  "timeoutSeconds": 600,
                  "assumeRole": "{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}",
                  "inputs": {
                    "DocumentName": "${DirectDocumentName}",
                    "RuntimeParameters": {
                      "VpcId": "{{ VpcId }}",
                      "AutomationAssumeRole": "{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}"
                    }
                  }
                }
              ]
            }
          - AutomationRoleArn: !GetAtt AutomationRole.Arn
            DirectDocumentName: !Ref DirectRemediationDocument
Outputs:
  DirectRemediationDocumentName:
    Description: 'Name of the direct SSM Automation runbook.'
    Value: !Ref DirectRemediationDocument
  ChangeRequestDocumentName:
    Description: 'Name of the Change Manager change template.'
    Value: !Ref ChangeRequestDocument
  FlowLogsLogGroupName:
    Description: 'CloudWatch Logs log group for REJECT VPC Flow Logs.'
    Value: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
  DeliveryRoleArn:
    Description: 'ARN of the VPC Flow Logs delivery role.'
    Value: !GetAtt DeliveryRole.Arn
  AutomationRoleArn:
    Description: 'ARN of the SSM Automation execution role.'
    Value: !GetAtt AutomationRole.Arn

          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          import socket

          route53 = boto3.client('route53')

          def clean_ds_id(dsid):
              return dsid.split('/')[-1] if dsid.startswith('/delegationset/') else dsid

          def resolve(host):
              ipv4 = ipv6 = ''
              if not host:
                  return ipv4, ipv6
              try:
                  addr = socket.getaddrinfo(host, None, socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
                  if addr: ipv4 = addr[0][4][0]
              except: pass
              try:
                  addr = socket.getaddrinfo(host, None, socket.AF_INET6, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
                  if addr: ipv6 = addr[0][4][0].split('%')[0]
              except: pass
              return ipv4, ipv6

              for i, n in enumerate(ns, 1):
                  data[f'NameServer{i}'] = n
                  ipv4, ipv6 = resolve(n)
                  data[f'IPv4Address{i}'] = ipv4
                  data[f'IPv6Address{i}'] = ipv6
              return data

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              req_type = event['RequestType']
              phys_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId')
              try:
                  if req_type == 'Create':
                      cr = event['ResourceProperties'].get('CallerReference', f"{event['StackId']}-{event['LogicalResourceId']}")
                      resp = route53.create_reusable_delegation_set(CallerReference=cr)
                      dsid = clean_ds_id(resp['DelegationSet']['Id'])
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, build_data(dsid, resp['DelegationSet']['NameServers']), dsid)
                  elif req_type == 'Update':
                      resp = route53.get_reusable_delegation_set(Id=phys_id)
                      dsid = clean_ds_id(resp['DelegationSet']['Id'])
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, build_data(dsid, resp['DelegationSet']['NameServers']), phys_id)

                      if phys_id:
                          try:
                              route53.delete_reusable_delegation_set(Id=phys_id)
                          except Exception as e:
                              if not (hasattr(e, 'response') and e.response.get('Error', {}).get('Code') == 'NoSuchDelegationSet'):
                                  raise
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, phys_id)
                  else:
                      raise Exception(f'Unsupported request type: {req_type}')

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Serverless API for content moderation using Amazon Rekognition
Resources:
  ContentModerationRestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: ContentModeration
      Description: REST API for image content moderation
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  ContentModerationResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ContentModerationRestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt ContentModerationRestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: moderate

  ContentModerationMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ContentModerationRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ContentModerationResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub
          - arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${LambdaArn}/invocations
          - LambdaArn: !GetAtt LambdaFunction.Arn

  ContentModerationDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - ContentModerationMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ContentModerationRestApi
      Description: Deployment for ContentModeration API

  ContentModerationStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ContentModerationRestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ContentModerationDeployment
      StageName: prod
      Description: Production stage

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: RekognitionDetectModerationLabels
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rekognition:DetectModerationLabels
                Resource: "*"

  LambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: invokeContentModeration
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Runtime: python3.14
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 256
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import urllib.request
          import urllib.error
          from urllib.parse import urlparse
          import boto3
          import os

          ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = ('.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png')
          MAX_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024

          def respond(status_code, payload):
              return {
                  'statusCode': status_code,
                  'headers': {
                      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                      'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'
                  },
                  'body': json.dumps(payload)
              }

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body') or '{}')
              except (TypeError, ValueError):
                  return respond(400, {'error': 'Invalid JSON body'})

              url = body.get('url')
              if not url:
                  return respond(400, {'error': 'Missing required field: url'})

              try:
                  parsed = urlparse(url)
                  if parsed.scheme not in ('http', 'https') or not parsed.netloc:
                      return respond(400, {'error': 'URL must be a valid http or https URL'})

                  if not any(parsed.path.lower().endswith(ext) for ext in ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS):
                      return respond(400, {'error': 'Unsupported image format. Only jpg, jpeg, or png are allowed'})

                  request = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'ContentModeration/1.0'})
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=20) as response:
                      content_length = response.headers.get('Content-Length')
                      if content_length and content_length.isdigit() and int(content_length) > MAX_SIZE:
                          return respond(400, {'error': 'Image exceeds 5MB limit'})
                      image_bytes = response.read(MAX_SIZE + 1)
              except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
                  if e.code == 404:
                      return respond(404, {'error': 'Image not found'})
                  return respond(502, {'error': 'Error fetching image: {}'.format(e.code)})
              except urllib.error.URLError as e:
                  return respond(502, {'error': 'Could not fetch image: {}'.format(str(e.reason))})
              except Exception as e:
                  return respond(500, {'error': 'Could not fetch image: {}'.format(str(e))})

              if len(image_bytes) > MAX_SIZE:
                  return respond(400, {'error': 'Image exceeds 5MB limit'})

              try:
                  rekognition = boto3.client('rekognition', region_name=os.environ['AWS_REGION'])
                  response = rekognition.detect_moderation_labels(
                      Image={'Bytes': image_bytes},
                      MinConfidence=60
                  )
              except Exception as e:
                  return respond(500, {'error': 'Rekognition error: {}'.format(str(e))})

              moderation_labels = [
                  {
                      'Name': label.get('Name'),
                      'Confidence': label.get('Confidence'),
                      'ParentName': label.get('ParentName')
                  }
                  for label in response.get('ModerationLabels', [])
              ]

              return respond(200, {'moderationLabels': moderation_labels})

    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/invokeContentModeration
      RetentionInDays: 14

  LambdaApiPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    DependsOn:
      - ContentModerationMethod
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub
        - arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ApiId}/*/POST/moderate
        - ApiId: !Ref ContentModerationRestApi

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Self-contained VPCs for Users and Fog layers with S3 and KMS endpoints, plus additional endpoints for Fog VPC.'

Resources:
  # Users VPC
  UsersVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.50.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: UsersVPC

  # Fog VPC
  FogVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.60.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: FogVPC

  # Users Subnet (first AZ)
  UsersSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref UsersVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.50.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs:
              Ref: 'AWS::Region'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: UsersSubnet

  # Fog Subnet (first AZ)
  FogSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.60.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs:
              Ref: 'AWS::Region'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: FogSubnet

  # Users Route Table
  UsersRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref UsersVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: UsersRouteTable

  # Fog Route Table
  FogRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: FogRouteTable

  # Users Subnet Route Table Association
  UsersSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref UsersSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref UsersRouteTable

  # Fog Subnet Route Table Association
  FogSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref FogSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref FogRouteTable

  # Users S3 Gateway Endpoint
  UsersS3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref UsersVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref UsersRouteTable
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceVpc': !Ref UsersVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: UsersS3Endpoint

  # Fog S3 Gateway Endpoint
  FogS3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref FogRouteTable
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceVpc': !Ref FogVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: FogS3Endpoint

  # Security Group for Users Interface Endpoints
  UsersEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Users VPC interface endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref UsersVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.50.0.0/16
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: UsersEndpointSG

  # Security Group for Fog Interface Endpoints
  FogEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Fog VPC interface endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.60.0.0/16
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: FogEndpointSG

  # Users KMS Interface Endpoint
  UsersKmsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref UsersVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kms'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref UsersSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref UsersEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: UsersKmsEndpoint

  # Fog KMS Interface Endpoint
  FogKmsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kms'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref FogSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref FogEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: FogKmsEndpoint

  # Fog Secrets Manager Interface Endpoint
  FogSecretsManagerEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.secretsmanager'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref FogSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref FogEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: FogSecretsManagerEndpoint

  # Fog EventBridge Interface Endpoint
  FogEventsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.events'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref FogSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref FogEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: FogEventsEndpoint

  # Fog STS Interface Endpoint
  FogStsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sts'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref FogSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref FogEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: FogStsEndpoint

  # Fog Lambda Interface Endpoint
  FogLambdaEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.lambda'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref FogSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref FogEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: FogLambdaEndpoint

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Security Hub automation rules to suppress reviewed findings"

Parameters:
  IamExcludedUserArn1:
    Type: String
    Description: "ARN of first IAM user to exclude from IAM finding suppression (e.g., arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/User1)"
    AllowedPattern: "^$|arn:aws:iam::\\d{12}:user/[\\w+=,.@-]+"
    Default: "arn:aws:iam::000000000000:user/no-such-user"
  IamExcludedUserArn2:
    Type: String
    Description: "ARN of second IAM user to exclude from IAM finding suppression (e.g., arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/User2)"
    AllowedPattern: "^$|arn:aws:iam::\\d{12}:user/[\\w+=,.@-]+"
    Default: "arn:aws:iam::000000000000:user/no-such-user"
  CisSubAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: "AWS account ID for which CIS findings are scoped"
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^\\d{12}$"
    Default: "000000000000"
  CisFindingId1:
    Type: String
    Description: "First CIS finding title to suppress (e.g., CIS 1.1)"
    Default: "CIS 1.1"
  CisFindingId2:
    Type: String
    Description: "Second CIS finding title to suppress (e.g., CIS 1.2)"
    Default: "CIS 1.2"
  CisFindingId3:
    Type: String
    Description: "Third CIS finding title to suppress (e.g., CIS 1.3)"
    Default: "CIS 1.3"
  CisFindingId4:
    Type: String
    Description: "Fourth CIS finding title to suppress (e.g., CIS 2.1)"
    Default: "CIS 2.1"
  CisFindingId5:
    Type: String
    Description: "Fifth CIS finding title to suppress (e.g., CIS 2.2)"
    Default: "CIS 2.2"
  BroaderControlId1:
    Type: String
    Description: "First compliance control ID to suppress organization-wide (e.g., EC2.9)"
    Default: "EC2.9"
  BroaderControlId2:
    Type: String
    Description: "Second compliance control ID to suppress (e.g., S3.1)"
    Default: "S3.1"
  BroaderControlId3:
    Type: String
    Description: "Third compliance control ID to suppress (e.g., Config.1)"
    Default: "Config.1"
  BroaderControlId4:
    Type: String
    Description: "Fourth compliance control ID to suppress (e.g., IAM.8)"
    Default: "IAM.8"
  BroaderControlId5:
    Type: String
    Description: "Fifth compliance control ID to suppress (e.g., S3.2)"
    Default: "S3.2"
  PublicBucketArn1:
    Type: String
    Description: "ARN of first intentionally public S3 bucket"
    AllowedPattern: "arn:aws:s3:::.*"
    Default: "arn:aws:s3:::example-public-bucket1"
  PublicBucketArn2:
    Type: String
    Description: "ARN of second intentionally public S3 bucket"
    AllowedPattern: "arn:aws:s3:::.*"
    Default: "arn:aws:s3:::example-public-bucket2"
  PublicBucketArn3:
    Type: String
    Description: "ARN of third intentionally public S3 bucket"
    AllowedPattern: "arn:aws:s3:::.*"
    Default: "arn:aws:s3:::example-public-bucket3"
  EbsAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: "AWS account ID for which EBS default encryption finding is suppressed"
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^\\d{12}$"
    Default: "000000000000"
  UnusedCredAccount1:
    Type: String
    Description: "First AWS account ID for which unused credential and access key rotation findings are suppressed"
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^\\d{12}$"
    Default: "000000000000"
  UnusedCredAccount2:
    Type: String
    Description: "Second AWS account ID for which unused credential and access key rotation findings are suppressed"
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^\\d{12}$"
    Default: "000000000000"
  GuardDutyAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: "AWS account ID where cross-account Bedrock API activity is expected"
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^\\d{12}$"
    Default: "000000000000"
  GuardDutyFindingType:
    Type: String
    Description: "GuardDuty finding type to suppress"
    Default: "UnauthorizedAccess:IAMUser/CrossAccountBedrockApiCall"

Resources:
  IamFindingsSuppressionRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: "SuppressIAMFindingsOrgWide"
      Description: "Suppresses IAM-related findings organization-wide while excluding specific IAM users"
      RuleOrder: 1
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
      Criteria:
        Type:
          - Comparison: CONTAINS
            Value: "IAM"
        ProductName:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: "IAM"
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: "IAM Access Analyzer"
        ResourceId:
          - Comparison: NOT_EQUALS
            Value: !Ref IamExcludedUserArn1
          - Comparison: NOT_EQUALS
            Value: !Ref IamExcludedUserArn2

  CisFindingsSubAccountRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: "SuppressCISFindingsSubAccount"
      Description: "Suppresses a set of CIS benchmark findings scoped to a specific sub-account"
      RuleOrder: 2
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
      Criteria:
        AwsAccountId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref CisSubAccountId
        Title:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref CisFindingId1
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref CisFindingId2
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref CisFindingId3
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref CisFindingId4
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref CisFindingId5

  BroaderFindingsSuppressionRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: "SuppressBroaderFindingsOrgWide"
      Description: "Suppresses a broader set of CIS and AWS Foundational Security Best Practices findings organization-wide"
      RuleOrder: 3
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
      Criteria:
        ComplianceSecurityControlId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref BroaderControlId1
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref BroaderControlId2
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref BroaderControlId3
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref BroaderControlId4
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref BroaderControlId5

  PublicBucketFindingsSuppressionRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: "SuppressPublicBucketFindings"
      Description: "Suppresses public-access findings for a known list of intentionally public S3 buckets"
      RuleOrder: 4
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
      Criteria:
        ResourceType:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: "AwsS3Bucket"
        ResourceId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref PublicBucketArn1
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref PublicBucketArn2
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref PublicBucketArn3

  EbsDefaultEncryptionSuppressionRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: "SuppressEBSDefaultEncryptionFinding"
      Description: "Suppresses EBS default-encryption finding for a specific account"
      RuleOrder: 5
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
      Criteria:
        AwsAccountId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref EbsAccountId
        ComplianceSecurityControlId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: "EC2.8"

  UnusedCredentialAccessKeySuppressionRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: "SuppressUnusedCredentialAccessKeyFindings"
      Description: "Suppresses unused-credential and access-key-rotation findings for two specific accounts running infrequent automation"
      RuleOrder: 6
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
      Criteria:
        Type:
          - Comparison: CONTAINS
            Value: "IAMUser"
        AwsAccountId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref UnusedCredAccount1
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref UnusedCredAccount2
        Title:
          - Comparison: CONTAINS
            Value: "UnusedCredential"
          - Comparison: CONTAINS
            Value: "AccessKey"

  GuardDutyBedrockApiSuppressionRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: "SuppressGuardDutyBedrockApiActivity"
      Description: "Suppresses a specific GuardDuty finding type related to expected cross-account Bedrock API activity"
      RuleOrder: 7
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
      Criteria:
        Type:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref GuardDutyFindingType
        AwsAccountId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref GuardDutyAccountId
