AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: CloudFormation template for Athena named queries analyzing AppStream 2.0 usage data

Parameters:
  DatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: appstream-usage
    Description: Name of the Glue database for AppStream usage data
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: appstream_usage_table
    Description: Name of the Athena table containing AppStream 2.0 session logs
  WorkGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: AppStreamUsageAnalysis
    Description: Name of the Athena workgroup

Resources:
  QueryResultsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "athena-query-results-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  UsageDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Ref DatabaseName
        Description: Database for AppStream 2.0 usage analytics

  AthenaWorkGroup:
    Type: AWS::Athena::WorkGroup
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref WorkGroupName
      State: ENABLED
      WorkGroupConfiguration:
        ResultConfiguration:
          OutputLocation: !Sub "s3://${QueryResultsBucket}/athena-results/"
          EncryptionConfiguration:
            EncryptionOption: SSE_S3

  # Query 1: Current vs previous month average session length per stack
  AvgSessionLengthPerStackQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: avg_session_length_per_stack_monthly
      Description: Compares average session length per stack for current month vs previous month
      Database: !Ref DatabaseName
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT
          stack,
          month,
          ROUND(AVG(session_duration_seconds) / 60.0, 2) AS avg_session_length_minutes
        FROM (
          SELECT
            stack,
            session_duration_seconds,
            CASE
              WHEN date_trunc('month', session_start) = date_trunc('month', current_date) THEN 'Current Month'
              WHEN date_trunc('month', session_start) = date_trunc('month', current_date - interval '1' month) THEN 'Previous Month'
              ELSE 'Other'
            END AS month
          FROM ${TableName}
          WHERE
            date_trunc('month', session_start) >= date_trunc('month', current_date - interval '1' month)
            AND date_trunc('month', session_start) <= date_trunc('month', current_date)
        )
        WHERE month IN ('Current Month', 'Previous Month')
        GROUP BY stack, month
        ORDER BY stack, month DESC
      WorkGroup: !Ref AthenaWorkGroup

  # Query 2: Daily session counts
  DailySessionCountsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: daily_session_counts
      Description: Daily session counts grouped by date and stack
      Database: !Ref DatabaseName
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT
          CAST(session_start AS DATE) AS session_date,
          stack,
          COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS session_count
        FROM ${TableName}
        GROUP BY CAST(session_start AS DATE), stack
        ORDER BY session_date DESC, stack
      WorkGroup: !Ref AthenaWorkGroup

  # Query 3: All session details
  AllSessionDetailsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: all_session_details
      Description: Retrieves all columns from the AppStream usage table ordered by session start time
      Database: !Ref DatabaseName
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT *
        FROM ${TableName}
        ORDER BY session_start DESC
      WorkGroup: !Ref AthenaWorkGroup

  # Query 4: Streaming hours per user
  StreamingHoursPerUserQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: streaming_hours_per_user
      Description: Total streaming hours per user per month
      Database: !Ref DatabaseName
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT
          user_name,
          date_trunc('month', session_start) AS month,
          ROUND(SUM(session_duration_seconds) / 3600.0, 2) AS streaming_hours
        FROM ${TableName}
        GROUP BY user_name, date_trunc('month', session_start)
        ORDER BY month DESC, streaming_hours DESC
      WorkGroup: !Ref AthenaWorkGroup

  # Query 5: Unique users per application
  UniqueUsersPerApplicationQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: unique_users_per_application
      Description: Count of distinct users per application
      Database: !Ref DatabaseName
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT
          application,
          COUNT(DISTINCT user_name) AS unique_users
        FROM ${TableName}
        WHERE application IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY application
        ORDER BY application
      WorkGroup: !Ref AthenaWorkGroup

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'QuickSight Administrative Monitoring and Data Pipeline Environment'
Parameters:
  ScriptBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: admin-console-cfn-dataprepare-code
    Description: Name prefix for the S3 bucket to store Glue ETL scripts.

Mappings: {}

Conditions: {}

Resources:
  # Admin S3 Bucket – unique per stack to avoid name collision
  AdminBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::StackName}'
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: QuickSightAdminSuite

  # Script S3 Bucket – unique per stack to avoid name collision
  ScriptBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${ScriptBucketName}-${AWS::StackName}'
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: QuickSightAdminSuite

  # Consolidated IAM Role
  ConsolidatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
                - glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ConsolidatedPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AdminBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${AdminBucket.Arn}/*'
                  - !GetAtt ScriptBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${ScriptBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:StartJobRun
                  - glue:GetJobRun
                  - glue:BatchStopJobRun
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
                Resource: '*'

  # Glue Jobs
  GlueJobAssetsAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-assets-access'
      Role: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.2X
      NumberOfWorkers: 5
      Timeout: 360
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/scripts/assets_access.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        --ADMIN_BUCKET: !Ref AdminBucket
        --AWS_ACCOUNT_ID: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        Application: QuickSightAdminSuite

  GlueJobDatasetMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-dataset-metadata'
      Role: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      Timeout: 240
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/scripts/dataset_metadata.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        --ADMIN_BUCKET: !Ref AdminBucket
        --AWS_ACCOUNT_ID: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        Application: QuickSightAdminSuite

  GlueJobFolderAssets:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-folder-assets'
      Role: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      Timeout: 240
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/scripts/folder_assets.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        --ADMIN_BUCKET: !Ref AdminBucket
        --AWS_ACCOUNT_ID: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        Application: QuickSightAdminSuite

  GlueJobQMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-q-metadata'
      Role: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      Timeout: 240
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/scripts/q_metadata.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        --ADMIN_BUCKET: !Ref AdminBucket
        --AWS_ACCOUNT_ID: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        Application: QuickSightAdminSuite

  GlueJobDatasourceProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-datasource-properties'
      Role: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      Timeout: 240
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/scripts/datasource_properties.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        --ADMIN_BUCKET: !Ref AdminBucket
        --AWS_ACCOUNT_ID: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        Application: QuickSightAdminSuite

  # Glue job for metrics collection
  GlueJobMetricsCollector:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-metrics-collector'
      Role: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      Timeout: 240
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/scripts/metrics_collector.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        --ADMIN_BUCKET: !Ref AdminBucket
        --AWS_ACCOUNT_ID: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        Application: QuickSightAdminSuite

  # Glue Triggers – staggered daily schedule starting 2 AM UTC
  TriggerAssetsAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-trigger-assets-access'
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(0 2 ? * * *)
      StartOnCreation: false
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobAssetsAccess

  TriggerDatasetMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-trigger-dataset-metadata'
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(5 2 ? * * *)
      StartOnCreation: false
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobDatasetMetadata

  TriggerFolderAssets:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-trigger-folder-assets'
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(10 2 ? * * *)
      StartOnCreation: false
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobFolderAssets

  TriggerQMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-trigger-q-metadata'
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(15 2 ? * * *)
      StartOnCreation: false
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobQMetadata

  TriggerDatasourceProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-trigger-datasource-properties'
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(20 2 ? * * *)
      StartOnCreation: false
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobDatasourceProperties

  # Trigger for metrics collector
  TriggerMetricsCollector:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-trigger-metrics-collector'
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(25 2 ? * * *)
      StartOnCreation: false
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobMetricsCollector

Outputs:
  AdminBucketName:
    Description: Admin S3 bucket for data lake
    Value: !Ref AdminBucket
  ScriptBucketName:
    Description: S3 bucket for Glue scripts
    Value: !Ref ScriptBucket
  ConsolidatedRoleArn:
    Description: IAM role ARN for all services
    Value: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
  GlueJobAssetsAccess:
    Description: Glue job for assets access
    Value: !Ref GlueJobAssetsAccess
  GlueJobDatasetMetadata:
    Description: Glue job for dataset metadata
    Value: !Ref GlueJobDatasetMetadata
  GlueJobFolderAssets:
    Description: Glue job for folder assets
    Value: !Ref GlueJobFolderAssets
  GlueJobQMetadata:
    Description: Glue job for Q metadata
    Value: !Ref GlueJobQMetadata
  GlueJobDatasourceProperties:
    Description: Glue job for datasource properties
    Value: !Ref GlueJobDatasourceProperties
  GlueJobMetricsCollector:
    Description: Glue job for CloudWatch metrics collection
    Value: !Ref GlueJobMetricsCollector

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^((\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2})$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR (e.g., 10.0.0.0/16)
  SubnetCidr:
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/19
    AllowedPattern: ^((\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2})$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR (e.g., 10.0.0.0/19)
  PuppetIP:
    Description: IP address for puppet.example.com
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.10
    AllowedPattern: ^((\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3})$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 address (e.g., 10.0.0.10)
  LinuxAgentIP:
    Description: IP address for linuxagent.example.com
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.11
    AllowedPattern: ^((\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3})$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 address (e.g., 10.0.0.11)
  WindowsAgentIP:
    Description: IP address for windowsagent.example.com
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.12
    AllowedPattern: ^((\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3})$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 address (e.g., 10.0.0.12)
Resources:
  PuppetVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Puppet-VPC
  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PuppetVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Puppet-Public-Subnet
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Puppet-IGW
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PuppetVPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PuppetVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Puppet-Public-RT
  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PuppetHostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: example.com
      VPCs:
        - VPCId: !Ref PuppetVPC
          VPCRegion: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
  PuppetRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PuppetHostedZone
      Name: puppet.example.com
      Type: A
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref PuppetIP
  LinuxAgentRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PuppetHostedZone
      Name: linuxagent.example.com
      Type: A
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref LinuxAgentIP
  WindowsAgentRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PuppetHostedZone
      Name: windowsagent.example.com
      Type: A
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref WindowsAgentIP
Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: The ID of the VPC created for Puppet
    Value: !Ref PuppetVPC
  SubnetId:
    Description: The ID of the public subnet created for Puppet
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet

    Type: "AWS::EC2::VPC"
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: "10.0.0.0/16"
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  # Internet Gateway
  InternetGateway:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::InternetGateway"
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Public Subnet
  PublicSubnet:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Subnet"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "10.0.1.0/24"
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  # Private Subnets
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Subnet"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "10.0.2.0/24"
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Subnet"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "10.0.3.0/24"
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  # Elastic IP for NAT Gateway
  NatGatewayEIP:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::EIP"
    Properties:
      Domain: "vpc"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  # NAT Gateway
  NatGateway:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::NatGateway"
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  # Public Route Table
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::RouteTable"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  PublicRoute:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Route"
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation"
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # Private Route Table
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::RouteTable"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  PrivateRoute:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Route"
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation"
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation"
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # Security Group for ECS tasks
  ECSSecurityGroup:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup"
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "Security group for ECS tasks"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          CidrIp: "10.0.0.0/16"
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: "0.0.0.0/0"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  # Self-referencing ingress rule (separate resource to avoid circular dependency)
  ECSSecurityGroupSelfIngress:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress"
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref ECSSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: -1
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref ECSSecurityGroup

  # ECS Cluster
  ECSCluster:
    Type: "AWS::ECS::Cluster"
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cluster"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  # CloudWatch Log Group
  LogGroup:
    Type: "AWS::Logs::LogGroup"
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/ecs/${EnvironmentName}/${ServiceName}"
      RetentionInDays: 14

  # IAM Task Execution Role
  TaskExecutionRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  # IAM Task Role (default, used only if CustomTaskRoleArn is not provided)
  TaskRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  # ECS Task Definition
  TaskDefinition:
    Type: "AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition"
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub "${ServiceName}-task"
      ExecutionRoleArn: !Ref TaskExecutionRole
      TaskRoleArn: !If [UseCustomTaskRole, !Ref CustomTaskRoleArn, !Ref TaskRole]
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      Cpu: !Ref Cpu
      Memory: !Ref Memory
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: !Ref ServiceName
          Image: !Ref ContainerImage
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref LogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref "AWS::Region"
              awslogs-stream-prefix: ecs
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  # Cloud Map Private DNS Namespace
  PrivateDnsNamespace:
    Type: "AWS::ServiceDiscovery::PrivateDnsNamespace"
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${ServiceName}.${EnvironmentName}.local"
      Vpc: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  # Cloud Map Service
  CloudMapService:
    Type: "AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Service"
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ServiceName
      DnsConfig:
        DnsRecords:
          - Type: SRV
            TTL: 60
        RoutingPolicy: MULTIVALUE
      NamespaceId: !Ref PrivateDnsNamespace
      HealthCheckCustomConfig:
        FailureThreshold: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  # ECS Service
  ECSService:
    Type: "AWS::ECS::Service"
    Properties:
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      TaskDefinition: !Ref TaskDefinition
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredCount
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      ServiceName: !Ref ServiceName
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ECSSecurityGroup
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
      ServiceRegistries:
        - RegistryArn: !GetAtt CloudMapService.Arn
          ContainerName: !Ref ServiceName
          ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  # Scalable Target
  ScalableTarget:
    Type: "AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget"
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 10
      MinCapacity: 2
      ResourceId: !Sub "service/${ECSCluster}/${ServiceName}"
      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
      ServiceNamespace: ecs
    DependsOn: ECSService

  # Scale Out Policy
  ScaleOutPolicy:
    Type: "AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy"
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${ServiceName}-ScaleOutPolicy"
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 70
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 80
            ScalingAdjustment: 1
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 80
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 90
            ScalingAdjustment: 2
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 90
            ScalingAdjustment: 3

  # Scale In Policy
  ScaleInPolicy:
    Type: "AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy"
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${ServiceName}-ScaleInPolicy"
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 0
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 10
            ScalingAdjustment: -3
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 10
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 15
            ScalingAdjustment: -2
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 15
            ScalingAdjustment: -1

  # Scale Out Alarm
  ScaleOutAlarm:
    Type: "AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm"
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${ServiceName}-ScaleOutAlarm"
      AlarmDescription: !Sub "Scale out when CPU >= 70% for ${ServiceName}"
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref ECSCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !Ref ECSService
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: breaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleOutPolicy

  # Scale In Alarm
  ScaleInAlarm:
    Type: "AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm"
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${ServiceName}-ScaleInAlarm"
      AlarmDescription: !Sub "Scale in when CPU <= 20% for ${ServiceName}"
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref ECSCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !Ref ECSService
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      Threshold: 20
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleInPolicy

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: "VPC ID"
    Value: !Ref VPC
  ECSClusterName:
    Description: "ECS Cluster name"
    Value: !Ref ECSCluster
  ECSServiceName:
    Description: "ECS Service name"
    Value: !Ref ECSService
  CloudMapNamespaceId:
    Description: "Cloud Map namespace ID"
    Value: !Ref PrivateDnsNamespace
  CloudMapServiceArn:
    Description: "Cloud Map service ARN"
    Value: !GetAtt CloudMapService.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Self-contained AWS network backbone for hybrid interconnect with OCI. Creates VPC, TGW, VPN (conditional), flow logs with KMS key.'

Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.94.0.0/16'
    Description: 'CIDR block for the VPC.'
  SubnetCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.94.10.0/24'
    Description: 'CIDR block for the private subnet.'
  InternalCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.0/8'
    Description: 'Internal CIDR allowed for inbound HTTPS to the security group.'
  OCIBackboneCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.0/8'
    Description: 'OCI backbone CIDR for outbound HTTPS and VPN routes. Override with actual OCI CIDR.'
  OCIVpnPublicIP:
    Type: String
    Default: '0.0.0.0'
    Description: 'Public IP address of the OCI VPN endpoint. Required only when CreateVPN is true; override this placeholder with a valid public IP.'
  CreateVPN:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'
    Description: 'Whether to create VPN resources (CustomerGateway, VPNConnection, routes).'
  BgpAsn:
    Type: Number
    Default: 65000
    Description: 'BGP ASN for the Customer Gateway (static routes only, BGP disabled).'

Conditions:
  CreateVPNResources: !Equals [!Ref CreateVPN, 'true']

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: HybridNetworkVPC

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: HybridNetworkIGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateSubnet

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: HybridNetworkRouteTable

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AmazonSideAsn: 64512
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: HybridNetworkTGW

  TransitGatewayVPCAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: HybridNetworkTGW-VPCAttachment

  TGWRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: HybridNetworkTGW-RouteTable

  TGWRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TGWRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TransitGatewayVPCAttachment

  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: 'Security group allowing HTTPS inbound from internal CIDR and outbound to OCI backbone.'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref InternalCIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref OCIBackboneCIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: HybridNetworkSG

  FlowLogsKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: 'KMS key for VPC flow log encryption'
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowRootAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowFlowLogsRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'

  FlowLogsKMSAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/flowlogs-${AWS::StackName}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKMSKey

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DependsOn: FlowLogsKMSKey
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/vpc/flowlogs/hybrid
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKMSKey.Arn

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogGroup'
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc/flowlogs/hybrid:*'

  FlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: HybridNetworkFlowLog

  CustomerGateway:
    Condition: CreateVPNResources
    Type: AWS::EC2::CustomerGateway
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BgpAsn: !Ref BgpAsn
      IpAddress: !Ref OCIVpnPublicIP
      Type: ipsec.1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: OCI-CustomerGateway

  VPNConnection:
    Condition: CreateVPNResources
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNConnection
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      CustomerGatewayId: !Ref CustomerGateway
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Type: ipsec.1
      StaticRoutesOnly: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: OCI-VPNConnection

  VPNConnectionRoute:
    Condition: CreateVPNResources
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNConnectionRoute
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OCIBackboneCIDR
      VpnConnectionId: !Ref VPNConnection

  TransitGatewayRoute:
    Condition: CreateVPNResources
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OCIBackboneCIDR
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TGWRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref VPNConnection

Outputs:
  VPCId:
    Description: 'VPC ID'
    Value: !Ref VPC
  PrivateSubnetId:
    Description: 'Private subnet ID'
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet
  TransitGatewayId:
    Description: 'Transit Gateway ID'
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway
  SecurityGroupId:
    Description: 'Security Group ID'
    Value: !Ref SecurityGroup
  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Description: 'CloudWatch Log Group for flow logs'
    Value: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
  KMSKeyId:
    Description: 'KMS Key ID for flow logs'
    Value: !Ref FlowLogsKMSKey
  VPNConnectionId:
    Condition: CreateVPNResources
    Description: 'VPN Connection ID'
    Value: !Ref VPNConnection

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: Self-contained QuickSight admin console data preparation pipeline

Parameters:
  ScriptLocationPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: scripts/
    Description: Prefix for script files in the S3 bucket

Resources:
  DataBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "${AWS::AccountId}-quicksight-admin-data-prep"
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  DataBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref DataBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${DataBucket}"
              - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${DataBucket}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                "aws:SecureTransport": "false"
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt PipelineRole.Arn
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${DataBucket}"
              - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${DataBucket}/*"

  PipelineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - quicksight.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/IAMFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonS3FullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/CloudWatchFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/CloudWatchLogsFullAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: QuickSightFullAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: quicksight:*
                Resource: "*"

  # Glue Jobs: 3 PythonShell (Glue 3.0, Python 3.9) and 2 Glue ETL (Glue 5.0, G.1X)
  GroupMembershipJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: group-membership-job
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/${ScriptLocationPrefix}group_membership.py"
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
      DefaultArguments:
        "--job-bookmark-option": "job-bookmark-disable"
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
      MaxRetries: 0
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1

  ObjectAccessJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: object-access-job
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/${ScriptLocationPrefix}object_access.py"
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
      DefaultArguments:
        "--job-bookmark-option": "job-bookmark-disable"
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
      MaxRetries: 0
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1

  FolderAssetsJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: folder-assets-job
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/${ScriptLocationPrefix}folder_assets.py"
        PythonVersion: "3"
      DefaultArguments:
        "--job-bookmark-option": "job-bookmark-disable"
      GlueVersion: "5.0"
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      MaxRetries: 0
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1

  FolderLookupJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: folder-lookup-job
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/${ScriptLocationPrefix}folder_lookup.py"
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
      DefaultArguments:
        "--job-bookmark-option": "job-bookmark-disable"
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
      MaxRetries: 0
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1

  FolderPathJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: folder-path-job
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/${ScriptLocationPrefix}folder_path.py"
        PythonVersion: "3"
      DefaultArguments:
        "--job-bookmark-option": "job-bookmark-disable"
      GlueVersion: "5.0"
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      MaxRetries: 0
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1

  # Scheduled Triggers – every 3 hours
  GroupMembershipTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: group-membership-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "rate(3 hours)"
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GroupMembershipJob

  ObjectAccessTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: object-access-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "rate(3 hours)"
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref ObjectAccessJob

  FolderAssetsTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: folder-assets-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "rate(3 hours)"
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref FolderAssetsJob

  FolderLookupTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: folder-lookup-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "rate(3 hours)"
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref FolderLookupJob

  FolderPathTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: folder-path-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "rate(3 hours)"
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref FolderPathJob

Outputs:
  GroupMembershipS3Path:
    Description: S3 path for group membership data
    Value: !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/output/group_membership/"

  ObjectAccessS3Path:
    Description: S3 path for object access data
    Value: !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/output/object_access/"

  FolderAssetsS3Path:
    Description: S3 path for folder assets data
    Value: !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/output/folder_assets/"

  FolderLookupS3Path:
    Description: S3 path for folder lookup data
    Value: !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/output/folder_lookup/"

  FolderPathS3Path:
    Description: S3 path for folder path data
    Value: !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/output/folder_path/"

  CloudTrailLogTableName:
    Description: Name of the CloudTrail log table (to be used in Glue catalog)
    Value: "cloudtrail_logs"

  CloudTrailLogS3Location:
    Description: S3 location for CloudTrail logs
    Value: !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/cloudtrail-logs/"

    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$"

    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$"

    Default: "MyImageRecipe"

  DistConfigName:

  LambdaExecutionRole:

          - Effect: Allow

                      return
                  bucket = event['ResourceProperties']['Bucket']
                  key = event['ResourceProperties']['Key']
                  content = event['ResourceProperties']['Content']
                  s3 = boto3.client('s3')
                  s3.put_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key, Body=content)
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
              except Exception as e:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'Error': str(e)})

    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource

      Key: !Ref ChefRecipeObjectKey

          action :install
        end
        service 'httpd' do
          action [:enable, :start]
        end
  # IAM role for Lambda to enable Amazon Inspector (inline policies to avoid race condition)
  InspectorEnableLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InspectorEnableLambdaPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - inspector2:Enable
                  - inspector2:Disable
                  - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                Resource: "*"
  # Lambda function to enable Amazon Inspector for EC2
  InspectorEnableFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-inspector-enable"
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt InspectorEnableLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 120
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
                      return

                  client.enable(resourceTypes=['EC2'])

                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'Error': str(e)})

  InspectorEnableCustomResource:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt InspectorEnableFunction.Arn
  # IAM role for Image Builder EC2 instance
  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
                - imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonS3ReadOnlyAccess
  ImageBuilderCustomPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: ImageBuilderCustom
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeTags
              - imagebuilder:GetComponent
              - imagebuilder:GetImageRecipe
              - imagebuilder:GetDistributionConfiguration
              - imagebuilder:GetInfrastructureConfiguration
            Resource: "*"
  # Instance profile
  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole
  # Bucket policy to restrict access to Image Builder instance role
  ChefRecipeBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ChefRecipeBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt ImageBuilderInstanceRole.Arn
            Action: s3:GetObject
            Resource: !Sub "${ChefRecipeBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                s3:ResourceAccount: !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
  # Image Builder component: Chef recipe downloader
  ChefRecipeComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ComponentName
      Platform: "Linux"
      Version: "1.0.0"
      Description: "Downloads and executes Chef recipe from S3"
      ChangeDescription: "Initial version"
      Data: !Sub |
        name: ChefRecipeDownloader
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: DownloadChefRecipe
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - aws s3 cp s3://${ChefRecipeBucket}/${ChefRecipeObjectKey} /tmp/recipe.rb
                    - sudo chef-client --local-mode /tmp/recipe.rb
      KmsKeyId: !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
  # Image Builder component: Custom build workflow (SSM agent update and metadata collection)
  CustomBuildWorkflowComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${PipelineName}-custom-build-workflow"
      Platform: "Linux"
      Version: "1.0.0"
      Description: "Updates SSM agent and collects metadata"
      ChangeDescription: "Initial version"
      Data: |
        name: CustomBuildWorkflow
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: UpdateSSMAgent
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo yum update -y amazon-ssm-agent
              - name: CollectMetadata
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - uname -a > /tmp/metadata.txt
                    - df -h >> /tmp/metadata.txt
                    - cat /tmp/metadata.txt
      KmsKeyId: !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
  # Image recipe
  ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ImageRecipeName
      Version: "1.0.0"
      ParentImage: "{{resolve:ssm:/aws/service/ecs/optimized-ami/amazon-linux-2/recommended/image_id}}"
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref ChefRecipeComponent
        - ComponentArn: !Ref CustomBuildWorkflowComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: "/dev/xvda"
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: !Ref RootVolumeType
  # Infrastructure configuration
  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref InfraConfigName
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
  # Distribution configuration
  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref DistConfigName
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref TargetRegion
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: "{{ imagebuilder:imageName }}-{{ imagebuilder:buildVersionNumber }}-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}"
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserIds:
                - !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
            AmiTags:
              ManagedBy: "ImageBuilder"
  # Image pipeline (depends on Inspector enablement)
  ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    DependsOn:
      - InspectorEnableCustomResource
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref PipelineName
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref ImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: !Ref BuildScheduleCron
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: "EXPRESSION_MATCH_AND_DEPENDENCY_UPDATES_AVAILABLE"
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 60
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ImageScanningEnabled: true
  # Lifecycle policy
  LifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref LifecyclePolicyName
      Description: "Deprecates AMIs older than 30 days, excludes production"
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ImageBuilderInstanceRole.Arn
      ResourceType: "AMI_IMAGE"
      ResourceSelection:
        TagMap:
          ManagedBy: "ImageBuilder"
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: "DEPRECATE"
          Filter:
            Type: "AGE"
            Value: !Ref LifecyclePolicyAgeDays
            Unit: "DAYS"
            RetainAtLeast: 1
          ExclusionRules:
            TagMap:
              Environment: production

    Description: "ARN of the Image Builder pipeline"
    Value: !Ref ImagePipeline
  ImageRecipeArn:
    Description: "ARN of the Image Recipe"
    Value: !Ref ImageRecipe
  S3BucketName:
    Description: "Name of the S3 bucket containing Chef recipes"
    Value: !Ref ChefRecipeBucket

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template to create VPC, five EC2 instances, and comprehensive CloudWatch alarms'

Resources:
  # VPC
  MyVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: EC2Monitoring
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production

  # Internet Gateway
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: EC2Monitoring
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref MyVPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Public Subnet
  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref MyVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: EC2Monitoring
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production

  # Route Table
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref MyVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: EC2Monitoring
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # Security Group
  InstanceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for EC2 instances
      VpcId: !Ref MyVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress: []
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: EC2Monitoring
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production

  # EC2 Instances
  EC2Instance1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      ImageId: '{{resolve:ssm:/aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/amzn2-ami-hvm-x86_64-gp2}}'
      InstanceType: t3.micro
      NetworkInterfaces:
        - DeviceIndex: 0
          SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
          GroupSet:
            - !Ref InstanceSecurityGroup
          AssociatePublicIpAddress: true
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: 8
            VolumeType: gp2
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: EC2Monitoring
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production
        - Key: Name
          Value: Instance1

  EC2Instance2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      ImageId: '{{resolve:ssm:/aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/amzn2-ami-hvm-x86_64-gp2}}'
      InstanceType: t3.micro
      NetworkInterfaces:
        - DeviceIndex: 0
          SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
          GroupSet:
            - !Ref InstanceSecurityGroup
          AssociatePublicIpAddress: true
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: 8
            VolumeType: gp2
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: EC2Monitoring
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production
        - Key: Name
          Value: Instance2

  EC2Instance3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      ImageId: '{{resolve:ssm:/aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/amzn2-ami-hvm-x86_64-gp2}}'
      InstanceType: t3.micro
      NetworkInterfaces:
        - DeviceIndex: 0
          SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
          GroupSet:
            - !Ref InstanceSecurityGroup
          AssociatePublicIpAddress: true
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: 8
            VolumeType: gp2
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: EC2Monitoring
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production
        - Key: Name
          Value: Instance3

  EC2Instance4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      ImageId: '{{resolve:ssm:/aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/amzn2-ami-hvm-x86_64-gp2}}'
      InstanceType: t3.micro
      NetworkInterfaces:
        - DeviceIndex: 0
          SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
          GroupSet:
            - !Ref InstanceSecurityGroup
          AssociatePublicIpAddress: true
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: 8
            VolumeType: gp2
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: EC2Monitoring
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production
        - Key: Name
          Value: Instance4

  EC2Instance5:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      ImageId: '{{resolve:ssm:/aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/amzn2-ami-hvm-x86_64-gp2}}'
      InstanceType: t3.micro
      NetworkInterfaces:
        - DeviceIndex: 0
          SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
          GroupSet:
            - !Ref InstanceSecurityGroup
          AssociatePublicIpAddress: true
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: 8

      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: EC2Monitoring
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production
        - Key: Name
          Value: Instance5

  # CPU Utilization Alarms (all five instances)
  CPUAlarm1:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub 'CPUUtilization-Alarm-${EC2Instance1}'
      AlarmDescription: 'CPU > 80% for 3 consecutive 5-minute periods'
      Namespace: AWS/EC2
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      Threshold: 80
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: InstanceId
          Value: !Ref EC2Instance1
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: EC2Monitoring
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production

      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: InstanceId
          Value: !Ref EC2Instance5
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: EC2Monitoring
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production

  # StatusCheckFailed Alarms (first three instances only)
  StatusCheckFailedAlarm1:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Content-level PII classification scanner for S3 Access Point using Comprehend"

Parameters:
  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "VPC ID for the Lambda function (leave empty for internet-origin access point)"
  SubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ""
    Description: "Subnet IDs for the Lambda VPC configuration (comma separated)"
  SecurityGroupId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Security Group ID for the Lambda VPC configuration"
  RouteTableIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ""
    Description: "Route Table IDs for the S3 Gateway endpoint (comma separated)"
  CreateEndpoints:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Default: "true"
    Description: "Whether to create VPC endpoints for S3, DynamoDB, Comprehend, and SNS"
  LambdaMemory:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    MinValue: 128
    MaxValue: 10240
    Description: "Memory size for the Lambda function in MB"
  LambdaTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 600
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 900
    Description: "Timeout for the Lambda function in seconds"
  LanguageCode:
    Type: String
    Default: "en"
    AllowedValues: ["en", "es", "fr", "de", "it", "pt", "ja", "ko", "zh", "ar", "hi"]
    Description: "Language code for Comprehend DetectPiiEntities"
  MaxFiles:
    Type: Number
    Default: 500
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 10000
    Description: "Maximum number of files to scan per Lambda invocation"
  LambdaCodeBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "S3 bucket containing the Lambda deployment package"
  LambdaCodeKey:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "S3 key of the Lambda deployment package"

Conditions:
  HasVpc: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VpcId, ""]]
  CreateEndpointsTrue: !Equals [!Ref CreateEndpoints, "true"]
  CreateVpcEndpoints: !And [Condition: HasVpc, Condition: CreateEndpointsTrue]
  HasSecurityGroup: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SecurityGroupId, ""]]
  HasSubnets: !Not [!Equals [!Join [",", !Ref SubnetIds], ""]]
  HasLambdaCode: !Not [!Equals [!Ref LambdaCodeBucket, ""]]

Resources:
  # S3 Bucket
  ScannerBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  # S3 Bucket Policy (grants access to LambdaRole only when accessed through the access point)
  ScannerBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ScannerBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt LambdaRole.Arn
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ScannerBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${ScannerBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                s3:DataAccessPointArn: !GetAtt ScannerAccessPoint.Arn

  # S3 Access Point (no inline policy – permissions are enforced via bucket policy)
  ScannerAccessPoint:
    Type: AWS::S3::AccessPoint
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ScannerBucket
      Name: !Sub "pii-scanner-ap-${AWS::StackName}"

  # DynamoDB Table
  ReportTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: FileId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: FileId
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      TableName: !Sub "pii-reports-${AWS::StackName}"

  # SNS Topic
  NotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub "pii-notifications-${AWS::StackName}"

  # IAM Role for Lambda
  LambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ScannerPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ScannerBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub "${ScannerBucket.Arn}/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - comprehend:DetectPiiEntities
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                Resource: !GetAtt ReportTable.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref NotificationTopic
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/pii-scanner-${AWS::StackName}*"

  # Lambda Function
  ScannerFunction:
    Condition: HasLambdaCode
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "pii-scanner-${AWS::StackName}"
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaRole.Arn
      MemorySize: !Ref LambdaMemory
      Timeout: !Ref LambdaTimeout
      Code:
        S3Bucket: !Ref LambdaCodeBucket
        S3Key: !Ref LambdaCodeKey
      Environment:
        Variables:
          LANGUAGE_CODE: !Ref LanguageCode
          MAX_FILES: !Ref MaxFiles
          BUCKET_NAME: !Ref ScannerBucket
          ACCESS_POINT_ARN: !GetAtt ScannerAccessPoint.Arn
          REPORT_TABLE: !Ref ReportTable
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN: !Ref NotificationTopic
      VpcConfig:
        Fn::If:
          - HasVpc
          - SubnetIds:
              Fn::If:
                - HasSubnets
                - !Ref SubnetIds
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
            SecurityGroupIds:
              Fn::If:
                - HasSecurityGroup
                - - !Ref SecurityGroupId
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  # VPC Endpoints (conditional)
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Condition: CreateVpcEndpoints
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3"
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds: !Ref RouteTableIds

  DynamoDBEndpoint:
    Condition: CreateVpcEndpoints
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.dynamodb"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        Fn::If:
          - HasSubnets
          - !Ref SubnetIds
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      SecurityGroupIds:
        Fn::If:
          - HasSecurityGroup
          - - !Ref SecurityGroupId
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  ComprehendEndpoint:
    Condition: CreateVpcEndpoints
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.comprehend"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        Fn::If:
          - HasSubnets
          - !Ref SubnetIds
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      SecurityGroupIds:
        Fn::If:
          - HasSecurityGroup
          - - !Ref SecurityGroupId
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  SNSEndpoint:
    Condition: CreateVpcEndpoints
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sns"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        Fn::If:
          - HasSubnets
          - !Ref SubnetIds
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      SecurityGroupIds:
        Fn::If:
          - HasSecurityGroup
          - - !Ref SecurityGroupId
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

Outputs:
  ScannerFunctionArn:
    Condition: HasLambdaCode
    Description: "ARN of the PII scanner Lambda function"
    Value: !GetAtt ScannerFunction.Arn
  ReportTableName:
    Description: "Name of the DynamoDB table for classification reports"
    Value: !Ref ReportTable
  ExampleInvocation:
    Condition: HasLambdaCode
    Description: "Example CLI command to invoke the scanner"
    Value: !Sub "aws lambda invoke --function-name ${ScannerFunction} --payload '{}' output.txt"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template to create AWS Glue databases and tables for LPG (property graph) and RDF data.

Parameters:
  LPGDatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: graph-database
    Description: Name of the Glue database for LPG tables.
  RDFDatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: graph-database-rdf
    Description: Name of the Glue database for RDF tables.

Resources:
  # ---------- Glue Databases ----------
  GlueDatabaseLPG:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Ref LPGDatabaseName
        Description: Database for property graph (LPG) tables.

  GlueDatabaseRDF:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Ref RDFDatabaseName
        Description: Database for RDF tables.

  # ---------- LPG Tables ----------
  AirportTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DependsOn: GlueDatabaseLPG
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref LPGDatabaseName
      TableInput:
        Name: airport
        Parameters:
          connectionType: gremlin
          graphLabel: vertex
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: elevation
              Type: int
            - Name: latitude
              Type: double
          SerdeInfo:
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ","

  CountryTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DependsOn: GlueDatabaseLPG
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref LPGDatabaseName
      TableInput:
        Name: country
        Parameters:
          connectionType: gremlin
          graphLabel: vertex
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: name
              Type: string
            - Name: population
              Type: int
          SerdeInfo:
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ","

  ContinentTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DependsOn: GlueDatabaseLPG
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref LPGDatabaseName
      TableInput:
        Name: continent
        Parameters:
          connectionType: gremlin
          graphLabel: vertex
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: name
              Type: string
          SerdeInfo:
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ","

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DependsOn: GlueDatabaseLPG
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref LPGDatabaseName
      TableInput:
        Name: route
        Parameters:
          connectionType: gremlin
          graphLabel: edge
          gremlinQuery: "g.V().hasLabel('airport').limit(10).outE('route').inV().path().by('code').by('code')"
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: source_airport_code
              Type: string
            - Name: destination_airport_code
              Type: string
            - Name: distance
              Type: double
          SerdeInfo:
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ","

  CustomAirportTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DependsOn: GlueDatabaseLPG
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref LPGDatabaseName
      TableInput:
        Name: customairport
        Parameters:
          connectionType: gremlin
          graphLabel: view
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: elevation
              Type: int
            - Name: latitude
              Type: double
          SerdeInfo:
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ","

  # ---------- RDF Tables ----------
  AirportRdfTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DependsOn: GlueDatabaseRDF
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref RDFDatabaseName
      TableInput:
        Name: airport_rdf
        Parameters:
          classification: rdf
          rdf.classuri: "class:Airport"
          rdf.querymode: class
          rdf.stripprefixes: "true"
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: elevation
              Type: int
            - Name: latitude
              Type: double
          SerdeInfo:
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ","

  RouteRdfTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DependsOn: GlueDatabaseRDF
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref RDFDatabaseName
      TableInput:
        Name: route_rdf
        Parameters:
          classification: rdf
          rdf.querymode: sparql
          rdf.stripprefixes: "true"
          rdf.prefix: "PREFIX air: <http://www.example.org/air-routes/ontology/>"
          rdf.sparqlquery: |
            SELECT ?incode ?outcode ?dist
            WHERE {
              ?route air:hasSource ?src ;
                     air:hasDestination ?dst ;
                     air:hasDistance ?dist .
              ?src air:code ?incode .
              ?dst air:code ?outcode .
            }
            LIMIT 10
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: incode
              Type: string
            - Name: outcode
              Type: string
            - Name: dist
              Type: int
          SerdeInfo:
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ","

  RouteRdfNopfxTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DependsOn: GlueDatabaseRDF
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref RDFDatabaseName
      TableInput:
        Name: route_rdf_nopfx
        Parameters:
          classification: rdf
          rdf.querymode: sparql
          rdf.stripprefixes: "true"
          # No prefix parameter; URIs are embedded directly in the query.
          rdf.sparqlquery: |
            SELECT ?incode ?outcode ?dist
            WHERE {
              ?route <http://www.example.org/air-routes/ontology/hasSource> ?src ;
                     <http://www.example.org/air-routes/ontology/hasDestination> ?dst ;
                     <http://www.example.org/air-routes/ontology/hasDistance> ?dist .
              ?src <http://www.example.org/air-routes/ontology/code> ?incode .
              ?dst <http://www.example.org/air-routes/ontology/code> ?outcode .
            }
            LIMIT 10
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: incode
              Type: string
            - Name: outcode
              Type: string
            - Name: dist
              Type: int
          SerdeInfo:
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ","
