AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: PiBot Cognito authentication setups for main web application and IoT trusted user provisioning.

Resources:
  MainUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: pibot-main-user-pool
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
      AutoVerifiedAttributes: []
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: false
          Mutable: true

  MainUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: pibot-main-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref MainUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

  MainIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: pibot-main-identity-pool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref MainUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !Sub
            - cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${PoolId}
            - PoolId: !Ref MainUserPool
          ServerSideTokenCheck: false

  MainAuthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: pibot-main-auth-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref MainIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      ManagedPolicyArns: []

  MainUnauthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: pibot-main-unauth-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref MainIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated
      ManagedPolicyArns: []

  MainAuthPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: pibot-main-auth-policy
      Roles:
        - !Ref MainAuthRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iot:Connect
              - iot:Publish
              - iot:Subscribe
              - iot:Receive
              - iot:GetThingShadow
              - iot:UpdateThingShadow
              - iot:ListThings
              - iot:DescribeEndpoint
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kinesisvideo:PutMedia
              - kinesisvideo:GetMedia
              - kinesisvideo:ListStreams
              - kinesisvideo:DescribeStream
              - kinesisvideo:GetDataEndpoint
              - kinesisvideo:ListTagsForStream
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - rekognition:DetectLabels
              - rekognition:DetectModerationLabels
              - rekognition:DetectFaces
              - rekognition:DetectText
              - rekognition:DetectCelebrity
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cognito-identity:GetId
              - cognito-identity:GetCredentialsForIdentity
              - cognito-sync:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
            Resource: '*'

  MainUnauthPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: pibot-main-unauth-policy
      Roles:
        - !Ref MainUnauthRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cognito-identity:GetId
              - cognito-identity:GetCredentialsForIdentity
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
            Resource: '*'

  MainIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref MainIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt MainAuthRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt MainUnauthRole.Arn

  ProvisioningUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: pibot-provisioning-user-pool
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
      AutoVerifiedAttributes: []
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: false
          Mutable: true

  ProvisioningUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: pibot-provisioning-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref ProvisioningUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

  ProvisioningIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: pibot-provisioning-identity-pool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: false
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref ProvisioningUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !Sub
            - cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${PoolId}
            - PoolId: !Ref ProvisioningUserPool
          ServerSideTokenCheck: false

  ProvisioningAuthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: pibot-provisioning-auth-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref ProvisioningIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      ManagedPolicyArns: []

  ProvisioningAuthPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: pibot-provisioning-auth-policy
      Roles:
        - !Ref ProvisioningAuthRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iot:CreateKeysAndCertificate
              - iot:RegisterThing
              - iot:DescribeEndpoint
              - iot:ListThings
              - iot:UpdateCertificate
              - iot:CreatePolicy
              - iot:AttachPolicy
              - iot:DetachPolicy
              - iot:CreateThing
              - iot:RegisterCertificate
              - iot:CreatePolicyVersion
              - iot:ListPolicies
              - iot:ListCertificates
            Resource: '*'

  ProvisioningIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref ProvisioningIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt ProvisioningAuthRole.Arn

    Description: Identity Pool ID for the main web application
    Value: !Ref MainIdentityPool
  MainUserPoolId:
    Description: User Pool ID for the main web application
    Value: !Ref MainUserPool

    Description: User Pool Client ID for the main web application

  ProvisioningIdentityPoolId:

    Description: User Pool ID for the IoT trusted user provisioning
    Value: !Ref ProvisioningUserPool
  ProvisioningClientId:
    Description: User Pool Client ID for the IoT trusted user provisioning
    Value: !Ref ProvisioningUserPoolClient

  MXTarget:
    Type: String
    Description: "Mail exchange server hostname for radiotopia.fm"

  ApexIPs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: "List of static IP addresses for the apex A record (website hosting)"
    Default: "192.0.2.1,192.0.2.2"
  WWWTarget:
    Type: String
    Description: "CNAME target for www.radiotopia.fm (third-party hosting service)"

  FeedTarget:
    Type: String
    Description: "CNAME target for feed.radiotopia.fm (feed proxy service)"

  SquarespaceVerificationHost:
    Type: String
    Description: "CNAME target for Squarespace domain verification (e.g., ext-sq.radiotopia.fm -> target)"

  CampaignMonitorVerificationHost:
    Type: String
    Description: "CNAME target for Campaign Monitor domain verification (e.g., cm.radiotopia.fm -> target)"

  GoogleWorkspaceVerificationHost:
    Type: String
    Description: "CNAME target for Google Workspace domain verification (e.g., google.radiotopia.fm -> target)"

      ResourceRecords:

    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:

      ResourceRecords:

      Type: CNAME

      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref SquarespaceVerificationHost

  CampaignMonitorCNAME:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: "cm.radiotopia.fm."
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref CampaignMonitorVerificationHost

  GoogleWorkspaceCNAME:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: "google.radiotopia.fm."
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref GoogleWorkspaceVerificationHost

  # ---------- THIRD-PARTY TXT DKIM RECORDS ----------
  MailChimpDKIMRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: "k1._domainkey.radiotopia.fm."

      ResourceRecords:

      Name: "cm._domainkey.radiotopia.fm."
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${CampaignMonitorDKIMTXT}"'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway with MCP integration'

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'protein-engineering'
    Description: 'Project name used for naming resources and SSM parameters'
  GatewayDescription:
    Type: String
    Default: 'Gateway for MCP integration'
    Description: 'Description for the API Gateway'
  GatewayName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'Optional name for the API Gateway; if left blank, defaults to ProjectName'

Conditions:
  IsGatewayNameEmpty: !Equals [!Ref GatewayName, '']

Resources:
  # IAM role for Bedrock AgentCore to invoke Lambda
  BedrockAgentCoreRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-agentcore-gateway-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeLambda
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !GetAtt LambdaFunction.Arn

  # Lambda execution role (basic logging)
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  # Placeholder Lambda function
  LambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-agentcore-lambda'
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          def handler(event, context):
              # Placeholder handler for MCP operations
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Hello from MCP AgentCore Gateway'})
              }

  # Permission for API Gateway to invoke Lambda
  LambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApi}/*'

  # Cognito User Pool for JWT authentication
  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-user-pool'
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          Mutable: true

  # Cognito User Pool Client
  CognitoUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

  # SSM parameter storing the Bedrock AgentCore role ARN
  SSMParameterRoleArn:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/agent-core-gateway-role-arn'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt BedrockAgentCoreRole.Arn

  # API Gateway REST API
  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !If [IsGatewayNameEmpty, !Ref ProjectName, !Ref GatewayName]
      Description: !Ref GatewayDescription

  # Cognito User Pool Authorizer (COGNITO_USER_POOLS)
  Authorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-jwt-authorizer'
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Type: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      IdentitySource: 'method.request.header.Authorization'
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt CognitoUserPool.Arn

  # Resource for /invoke endpoint
  ResourceInvoke:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: 'invoke'
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi

  # Resource for /results endpoint
  ResourceResults:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: 'results'
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi

  # Method for POST /invoke
  MethodInvoke:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ResourceInvoke
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref Authorizer
      RequestModels:
        application/json: !Ref MCPToolModel
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${LambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  # Method for POST /results
  MethodResults:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ResourceResults
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref Authorizer
      RequestModels:
        application/json: !Ref MCPToolModel
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${LambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  # API Gateway Model for MCP tool schema
  MCPToolModel:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Model
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Name: 'MCPToolSchema'
      ContentType: 'application/json'
      Schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          action:
            type: string
            enum: ['invoke_endpoint', 'get_results']
          sequence:
            type: string
          jobId:
            type: string
        required: ['action']

Outputs:
  GatewayId:
    Description: 'ID of the API Gateway'
    Value: !Ref RestApi
  GatewayUrl:
    Description: 'Invoke URL for the API Gateway'
    Value: !Sub 'https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
  BedrockAgentCoreRoleArn:
    Description: 'ARN of the IAM role for Bedrock AgentCore'
    Value: !GetAtt BedrockAgentCoreRole.Arn
  CognitoUserPoolId:
    Description: 'ID of the Cognito User Pool'
    Value: !Ref CognitoUserPool
  CognitoUserPoolClientId:
    Description: 'ID of the Cognito User Pool Client'
    Value: !Ref CognitoUserPoolClient

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Private VPC Infrastructure with ALB, Lambda, and Artifact Storage'

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  PublicSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.254.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the public NAT subnet
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for first private ALB subnet
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for second private ALB subnet
  PrivateSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private Lambda subnet
  EnableNATGateway:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - true
      - false
    Default: false
    Description: Enable NAT Gateway for internet egress from private subnets

Conditions:
  EnableNATGatewayCondition: !Equals [!Ref EnableNATGateway, true]

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VPC'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-IGW'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1-ALB'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2-ALB'

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet3-Lambda'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicRouteTable'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0

    Properties:

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRouteTable'

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation

Description: "CloudFormation template creating a Step Functions state machine, two API Gateway REST APIs (GET and POST) with IAM roles, stages, and deployments."

Parameters:
  GetApiStageName:
    Type: String
    Default: v1
    Description: Stage name for the GET API
  PostApiStageName:
    Type: String
    Default: v1

Resources:
  # IAM role for the state machine execution
  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StateMachineExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:DescribeExecution
                Resource: "*"

  # Step Functions state machine with two Pass states
  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: MyTwoStepPassStateMachine
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: |
        {
          "Comment": "A two-step pass workflow",
          "StartAt": "FirstStep",
          "States": {
            "FirstStep": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Result": "Hello from FirstStep",
              "Next": "SecondStep"
            },
            "SecondStep": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Result": "All done",
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }

  # IAM role for the GET API to invoke Step Functions
  ApiGatewayRoleGet:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !GetAtt StateMachine.Arn

  # IAM role for the POST API to invoke Step Functions
  ApiGatewayRolePost:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution

    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi

      Name: GetApi

    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method

      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution"
        Credentials: !GetAtt ApiGatewayRoleGet.Arn
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            {
              "stateMachineArn": "${StateMachine.Arn}"
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ""
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200

  # Deployment for GET API
  DeploymentGet:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: GetApiMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetApi
      Description: GET API deployment

  # Stage for GET API
  StageGet:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName: !Ref GetApiStageName
      RestApiId: !Ref GetApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref DeploymentGet

  # POST API Gateway REST API
  PostApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: PostApi
      Description: API Gateway with POST endpoint

  # POST method on the root resource
  PostApiMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostApi
      ResourceId: !GetAtt PostApi.RootResourceId
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution"
        Credentials: !GetAtt ApiGatewayRolePost.Arn
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            {
              "input": "$util.escapeJavaScript($input.json('$'))",
              "stateMachineArn": "${StateMachine.Arn}"
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ""
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200

  # Deployment for POST API
  DeploymentPost:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: PostApiMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostApi
      Description: POST API deployment

  # Stage for POST API
  StagePost:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName: !Ref PostApiStageName
      RestApiId: !Ref PostApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref DeploymentPost

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template for SQS audit queue with KMS encryption, DLQ, alarms, and SNS notifications.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Default: dev
    Description: Deployment environment (dev, staging, prod).

Mappings:
  EnvironmentConfig:
    dev:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 345600
      VisibilityTimeout: 30
    staging:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      VisibilityTimeout: 60
    prod:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      VisibilityTimeout: 120

Conditions:
  IsNonDev: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Environment, 'dev']]

Resources:
  AuditKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow SQS to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
            Resource: '*'

  AuditKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/audit-queue-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AuditKey

  DLQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Condition: IsNonDev
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      QueueName: audit-dlq
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, MessageRetentionPeriod]
      VisibilityTimeout: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, VisibilityTimeout]

  AuditQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      QueueName: audit-queue
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditKey
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, MessageRetentionPeriod]
      VisibilityTimeout: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, VisibilityTimeout]
      RedrivePolicy: !If
        - IsNonDev
        - deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt DLQueue.Arn
          maxReceiveCount: 5
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  AlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      DisplayName: AuditQueueAlarms

  OldMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AuditQueue-OldMessages'
      AlarmDescription: 'Alarm if oldest message in audit queue exceeds 1 hour'
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 3600
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  DLQAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsNonDev
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AuditQueue-DLQActivity'
      AlarmDescription: 'Alarm if DLQ has messages'
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt DLQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

Outputs:
  AuditQueueArn:
    Description: ARN of the main audit queue
    Value: !GetAtt AuditQueue.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AuditQueueArn'
  AuditQueueUrl:
    Description: URL of the main audit queue
    Value: !Ref AuditQueue
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AuditQueueUrl'
  DLQueueArn:
    Description: ARN of the dead letter queue
    Condition: IsNonDev
    Value: !GetAtt DLQueue.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DLQueueArn'
  DLQueueUrl:
    Description: URL of the dead letter queue
    Condition: IsNonDev
    Value: !Ref DLQueue
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DLQueueUrl'
  AuditKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key used for encryption
    Value: !GetAtt AuditKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AuditKeyArn'
  AlarmTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the SNS topic for alarm notifications
    Value: !Ref AlarmTopic
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AlarmTopicArn'

    Type: String
    Default: TemplateWebClient
  MachineAppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateMachineClient

  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      EmailConfiguration: {}

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Join
        - "-"
        - - "researchapp-agentcore"
          - !Select
            - 2
            - !Split
              - "/"
              - !Ref "AWS::StackId"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: "researchapp-agentcore"
      Name: "researchapp-agentcore"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: "read"
          ScopeDescription: "Read access"

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: "admin"
      Precedence: 10
      Description: "Admin group"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  CustomerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: "customer"
      Precedence: 5
      Description: "Customer group"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:

              userpoolid = event['userpoolid']
              client.admin_add_user_to_group(

      Type: String
      Value: !Ref WebAppClient

    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/MachineAppClientId
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref MachineClient

  MachineClientSecretParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/MachineAppClientSecret
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt MachineClient.ClientSecret

  OAuthScopesParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/OAuthScopes
      Type: String
      Value: "researchapp-agentcore/read"

  DiscoveryUrlParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/DiscoveryUrl
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration"

  TokenUrlParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:

      Value: !Sub "https://${UserPoolDomain}/oauth2/token"

  AuthorizeUrlParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter

      Type: String

  CognitoDomainParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/CognitoDomain
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref UserPoolDomain

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CryptoTickerAPI: A self-contained GraphQL API for cryptocurrency ticker data using AWS AppSync, DynamoDB, and CoinGecko API.'

Resources:
  # DynamoDB Table
  APIDataTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: hk
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: sk
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: hk
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: sk
          KeyType: RANGE
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: false

  # AppSync API
  CryptoTickerAPI:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: CryptoTickerAPI
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY

  # GraphQL Schema
  GraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type TickerInfo {
          ticker: String!
          price: Float
          timestamp: AWSDateTime
          priceHistory(ticker: String!, limit: Int, nextToken: String): TickerConnection
        }

        type TickerConnection {
          items: [TickerInfo]
          nextToken: String
        }

        type Query {
          ticker(Ticker: String!): TickerInfo
        }

        schema {
          query: Query
        }

  # IAM Role for AppSync
  AppSyncRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  # Inline Policy for DynamoDB access
  AppSyncDynamoDBPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: AppSyncDynamoDBPolicy
      Roles:
        - !Ref AppSyncRole
      PolicyDocument:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for MediaPackage live streaming with HLS and DASH endpoints, optional live-to-VOD archive bucket, and optional VOD packaging group and configurations."

Parameters:
  Prefix:
    Type: String
    Default: LiveStream
    Description: "Logical prefix for resource names."
  ArchiveBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Name of the S3 bucket for live-to-VOD archiving. Provide to enable DENY origination on endpoints."
  VodSourceBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Name of the S3 bucket for VOD source content. Provide to create VOD packaging group and configurations."
  HlsSegmentDurationSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 6
    Description: "Segment duration in seconds for the HLS endpoint and optional VOD HLS packaging configuration."
  StartoverWindowSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 300
    Description: "Startover window in seconds for both endpoints."
  ManifestName:
    Type: String
    Default: index
    Description: "Manifest name for both endpoints."
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    Description: "Environment tag value."
  CustomTagKey:
    Type: String
    Default: Project
    Description: "Key for a custom tag applied to all resources."
  CustomTagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: MyProject
    Description: "Value for the custom tag."

Conditions:
  HasArchiveBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ArchiveBucket, ""]]
  HasVodSourceBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VodSourceBucket, ""]]

Resources:
  # MediaPackage Channel
  Channel:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::Channel
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub "${Prefix}Channel"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
          Value: !Ref CustomTagValue

  # HLS Origin Endpoint
  HlsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub "${Prefix}HlsEndpoint"
      ChannelId: !Ref Channel
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      HlsPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: !Ref HlsSegmentDurationSeconds
      Origination: !If [HasArchiveBucket, "DENY", "ALLOW"]
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
          Value: !Ref CustomTagValue

  # DASH Origin Endpoint
  DashEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub "${Prefix}DashEndpoint"
      ChannelId: !Ref Channel
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      DashPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: 2
      Origination: !If [HasArchiveBucket, "DENY", "ALLOW"]
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
          Value: !Ref CustomTagValue

  # Archive S3 Bucket (live-to-VOD)
  ArchiveBucketResource:
    Condition: HasArchiveBucket
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Ref ArchiveBucket
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
          Value: !Ref CustomTagValue

  # VOD Source S3 Bucket
  VodSourceBucketResource:
    Condition: HasVodSourceBucket
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Ref VodSourceBucket
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
          Value: !Ref CustomTagValue

  # IAM Role for MediaPackage S3 access
  MediaPackageS3AccessRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${Prefix}MediaPackageS3AccessRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: mediapackage.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - !If
          - HasArchiveBucket
          - PolicyName: !Sub "${Prefix}ArchiveBucketAccess"
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: "2012-10-17"
              Statement:
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:GetObject
                    - s3:ListBucket
                  Resource:
                    - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${ArchiveBucket}"
                    - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${ArchiveBucket}/*"
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasVodSourceBucket
          - PolicyName: !Sub "${Prefix}VodSourceBucketAccess"
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: "2012-10-17"
              Statement:
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:GetObject
                    - s3:ListBucket
                  Resource:
                    - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${VodSourceBucket}"
                    - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${VodSourceBucket}/*"
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
          Value: !Ref CustomTagValue

  # Optional VOD Packaging Group
  PackagingGroup:
    Condition: HasVodSourceBucket
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::PackagingGroup
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub "${Prefix}PackagingGroup"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
          Value: !Ref CustomTagValue

  # Optional VOD HLS Packaging Configuration
  HlsPackagingConfiguration:
    Condition: HasVodSourceBucket
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::PackagingConfiguration
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub "${Prefix}HlsPackagingConfig"
      PackagingGroupId: !Ref PackagingGroup
      HlsPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: !Ref HlsSegmentDurationSeconds
        HlsManifests:
          - ManifestName: !Sub "${Prefix}HlsManifest"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
          Value: !Ref CustomTagValue

  # Optional VOD DASH Packaging Configuration
  DashPackagingConfiguration:
    Condition: HasVodSourceBucket
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::PackagingConfiguration
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub "${Prefix}DashPackagingConfig"
      PackagingGroupId: !Ref PackagingGroup
      DashPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: 2
        DashManifests:
          - ManifestName: !Sub "${Prefix}DashManifest"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
          Value: !Ref CustomTagValue

Outputs:
  ChannelArn:
    Description: "ARN of the MediaPackage channel"
    Value: !GetAtt Channel.Arn
  HlsEndpointUrl:
    Description: "URL of the HLS origin endpoint"
    Value: !GetAtt HlsEndpoint.Url
  DashEndpointUrl:
    Description: "URL of the DASH origin endpoint"
    Value: !GetAtt DashEndpoint.Url

            Resource: '*'

    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-controllers-policy'
      Description: Custom policy for controllers role - VPC, subnets, SGs, ELB, ASG, launch templates, EKS access entries, service-linked roles
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:*
              - elasticloadbalancing:*
              - autoscaling:*
              - eks:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
              - iam:PassRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:PutRolePolicy
              - iam:DeleteRolePolicy
              - iam:GetRole
              - iam:GetRolePolicy
              - iam:ListRolePolicies
              - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
              - iam:PassRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/*'

  ControllersEKSPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-controllers-eks-policy'
      Description: Policy for EKS cluster/nodegroup management, SSM, IAM, KMS, service-linked roles
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:GetRole
              - iam:ListRolePolicies
              - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
              - iam:GetPolicy

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com

            Action: sts:AssumeRole

        - !Ref ControllersPolicy
        - !Ref ControllersEKSPolicy

    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nodes-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template to create a DynamoDB table with configurable keys, billing mode, encryption, and optional CloudWatch alarms.

Parameters:
  PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: id
    Description: Name of the partition key attribute.
  PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: S
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
    Description: Type of the partition key attribute (S, N, or B).
  SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Name of the sort key attribute. Leave empty for no sort key.
  SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: N
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
    Description: Type of the sort key attribute (S, N, or B). Only used if SortKeyName is provided.
  BillingMode:
    Type: String
    Default: PROVISIONED
    AllowedValues:
      - PROVISIONED
      - PAY_PER_REQUEST
    Description: Billing mode for the DynamoDB table.
  ReadCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    Description: Provisioned read capacity units (only used when BillingMode is PROVISIONED).
  WriteCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    Description: Provisioned write capacity units (only used when BillingMode is PROVISIONED).
  EnableEncryption:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Enable server-side encryption using a customer-managed KMS key.
  EnableAlarms:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Enable CloudWatch alarms for throttling and error rates.

Conditions:
  HasSortKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SortKeyName, '']]
  IsProvisioned: !Equals [!Ref BillingMode, 'PROVISIONED']
  IsEncryptionEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableEncryption, 'true']
  IsAlarmsEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableAlarms, 'true']

Resources:
  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-dynamodb-table"
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref SortKeyType
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          KeyType: HASH
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            KeyType: RANGE
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      BillingMode: !Ref BillingMode
      ProvisionedThroughput: !If
        - IsProvisioned
        - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadCapacityUnits
          WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteCapacityUnits
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification: !If
        - IsEncryptionEnabled
        - SSEEnabled: true
          SSEType: KMS
          KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  KMSKey:
    Condition: IsEncryptionEnabled
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "KMS key for DynamoDB encryption in stack ${AWS::StackName}"
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: Allow DynamoDB to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dynamodb.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT

  SNSTopic:
    Condition: IsAlarmsEnabled
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-alarm-topic"
      TopicName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-alarm-topic"

  WriteThrottleAlarm:
    Condition: IsAlarmsEnabled
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-WriteThrottleEvents"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm for DynamoDB write throttle events"
      MetricName: WriteThrottleEvents
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SNSTopic

  ReadThrottleAlarm:
    Condition: IsAlarmsEnabled
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ReadThrottleEvents"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm for DynamoDB read throttle events"
      MetricName: ReadThrottleEvents
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SNSTopic

  SystemErrorsAlarm:
    Condition: IsAlarmsEnabled
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-SystemErrors"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm for DynamoDB system errors"
      MetricName: SystemErrors
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SNSTopic

  UserErrorsAlarm:
    Condition: IsAlarmsEnabled
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UserErrors"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm for DynamoDB user errors"
      MetricName: UserErrors
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SNSTopic

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'EC2 Image Builder pipeline for Amazon Linux 2023 AMIs (x86 and arm64) with Docker, Python, and SSM sudo access'

Parameters:
  ImageVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: '1.0.0'
    Description: 'Version for the image recipes (e.g., 1.0.0)'
  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 32
    MinValue: 10
    MaxValue: 500
    Description: 'Root volume size in GB'
  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Default: 'o-xxxxxxxxxx'
    AllowedPattern: '^o-[a-z0-9]{10,32}$'
    Description: 'AWS Organization ID for AMI sharing (e.g., o-xxxxxxxxxx)'

Resources:
  # VPC and Networking
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: '10.0.0.0/16'
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  Subnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: '10.0.0.0/20'
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  Subnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: '10.0.16.0/20'
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  RouteToInternet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  ImageBuilderSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      GroupDescription: Security group for Image Builder build instances
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: "-1"
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  # IAM Roles and Instance Profile
  ImageBuilderServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PassInstanceProfile
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt ImageBuilderInstanceProfile.Arn
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderServiceAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:RunInstances
                  - ec2:TerminateInstances
                  - ec2:StopInstances
                  - ec2:StartInstances
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  ImageBuilderEc2Role:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EC2InstanceBuilderAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:Describe*
                  - ec2:AttachVolume
                  - ec2:DetachVolume
                  - ec2:CreateSnapshot
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:RegisterImage
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - ec2:ModifyImageAttribute
                  - ec2:ModifySnapshotAttribute
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: S3AccessLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt LogsBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${LogsBucket.Arn}/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderEc2Role

  # S3 Logs Bucket
  LogsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  LogsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref LogsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${LogsBucket.Arn}/*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${LogsBucket.Arn}/*'

  # Image Builder Components
  InstallSoftwareComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: InstallSoftwareComponent
      Platform: Linux
      Version: '1.0.0'
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Data: |
        name: InstallSoftwareComponent
        description: Install Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages, and configure SSM sudo
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallDocker
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf install -y docker
                    - systemctl enable docker
                    - systemctl start docker
              - name: InstallDockerComposePlugin
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf install -y docker-compose-plugin
              - name: InstallPythonPackages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf install -y python3-pip
                    - pip3 install synapseclient pandas pysftp
              - name: EnableSSMUserSudo
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - echo "ssm-user ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL" > /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-agent-users
                    - chmod 440 /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-agent-users

  TestSoftwareComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: TestSoftwareComponent
      Platform: Linux
      Version: '1.0.0'
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Data: |
        name: TestSoftwareComponent
        description: Verify Docker Compose and Python imports
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: test
            steps:
              - name: TestDockerCompose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - docker compose version
              - name: TestPythonImports
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - python3 -c "import synapseclient; import pandas; import pysftp"

  # Image Recipes
  AmiRecipeX86:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: AmiRecipeX86
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: '{{resolve:ssm:/aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64}}'
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref InstallSoftwareComponent
        - ComponentArn: !Ref TestSoftwareComponent
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

  AmiRecipeArm64:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: AmiRecipeArm64
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: '{{resolve:ssm:/aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-arm64}}'
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref InstallSoftwareComponent
        - ComponentArn: !Ref TestSoftwareComponent
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

  # Infrastructure Configuration
  SharedInfraConfig:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: SharedInfraConfig
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet1
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderSecurityGroup
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      Logging:
        S3Logs:
          S3BucketName: !Ref LogsBucket
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

  # Distribution Configuration
  SharedDistConfig:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: SharedDistConfig
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref AWS::Region
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserGroups:
                - all
              OrganizationArns:
                - !Sub 'arn:aws:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:organization/${OrganizationId}'
            AmiTags:
              StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

  # Pipelines
  AmiPipelineX86:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: AmiPipelineX86
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref AmiRecipeX86
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref SharedInfraConfig
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref SharedDistConfig
      Status: ENABLED
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

  AmiPipelineArm64:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: AmiPipelineArm64
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref AmiRecipeArm64
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref SharedInfraConfig
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref SharedDistConfig
      Status: ENABLED
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

Outputs:
  PipelineX86:
    Description: 'ARN of the x86 Image Builder pipeline'
    Value: !Ref AmiPipelineX86
  PipelineArm64:
    Description: 'ARN of the arm64 Image Builder pipeline'
    Value: !Ref AmiPipelineArm64
  LogsBucketName:
    Description: 'S3 bucket for Image Builder logs'
    Value: !Ref LogsBucket
  VpcId:
    Description: 'VPC ID created for Image Builder'
    Value: !Ref VPC

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: CloudFormation template for AgentOps e-commerce analytics demo Cognito User Pool with seed users

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: agentops-ecommerce-users
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      EmailVerificationMessage: Your verification code is {####}
      EmailVerificationSubject: Verify your email for AgentOps
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: role
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      VerificationMessageTemplate:
        DefaultEmailOption: CONFIRM_WITH_CODE
        EmailMessage: Your verification code is {####}
        EmailSubject: Verify your email for AgentOps

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: agentops-web-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      CallbackURLs:
        - http://localhost:3000/auth/callback
      DefaultRedirectURI: http://localhost:3000/auth/callback
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
        - implicit
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
      GenerateSecret: false
      ReadAttributes:
        - email
        - profile
      WriteAttributes:
        - email
        - profile
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30

  GroupAlpha:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: team-alpha
      Precedence: 10
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  GroupBeta:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: team-beta
      Precedence: 20
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  GroupAdmin:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  SeederFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoSeedUserPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminCreateUser
                  - cognito-idp:AdminSetUserPassword
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                  - cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
                Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  SeederFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt SeederFunctionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 60
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          import os

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              status = cfnresponse.SUCCESS
              response_data = {}
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] in ['Create', 'Update']:
                      user_pool_id = event['ResourceProperties']['UserPoolId']
                      groups = event['ResourceProperties']['GroupNames']
                      users = event['ResourceProperties']['Users']
                      client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')
                      for user in users:
                          email = user['Email']
                          group = user['Group']
                          role = user['Role']
                          # Create user
                          client.admin_create_user(
                              UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                              Username=email,
                              TemporaryPassword='Demo1234!',
                              MessageAction='SUPPRESS',
                              UserAttributes=[
                                  {'Name': 'email', 'Value': email},
                                  {'Name': 'email_verified', 'Value': 'true'}
                              ]
                          )
                          # Set permanent password
                          client.admin_set_user_password(
                              UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                              Username=email,
                              Password='Demo1234!',
                              Permanent=True
                          )
                          # Set custom:role attribute
                          client.admin_update_user_attributes(
                              UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                              Username=email,
                              UserAttributes=[
                                  {'Name': 'custom:role', 'Value': role}
                              ]
                          )
                          # Add user to group
                          client.admin_add_user_to_group(
                              UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                              Username=email,
                              GroupName=group
                          )
                      response_data['Message'] = 'Users seeded successfully'
                  elif event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                      # Optionally, you could delete users here, but we skip cleanup
                      response_data['Message'] = 'No cleanup performed'
              except Exception as e:
                  status = cfnresponse.FAILED
                  response_data['Message'] = str(e)
              cfnresponse.send(event, context, status, response_data)

  SeederCustomResource:
    Type: Custom::UserSeeder
    DependsOn:
      - GroupAlpha
      - GroupBeta
      - GroupAdmin
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt SeederFunction.Arn
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GroupNames:
        - team-alpha
        - team-beta
        - admin
      Users:
        - Email: alice@demo.local
          Group: team-alpha
          Role: member
        - Email: bob@demo.local
          Group: team-alpha
          Role: member
        - Email: charlie@demo.local
          Group: team-alpha
          Role: team_admin
        - Email: dave@demo.local
          Group: team-beta
          Role: member
        - Email: eve@demo.local
          Group: team-beta
          Role: team_admin
        - Email: admin@demo.local
          Group: admin
          Role: admin

    Description: ID of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
  ClientId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito User Pool Client
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
  Region:
    Description: AWS Region where resources are deployed
    Value: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
  SeederFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda function used to seed users
    Value: !GetAtt SeederFunction.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for AWS Client VPN usage reporting: CloudWatch Logs Insights queries and dashboard.'
Parameters:
  FolderPath:
    Type: String
    Default: aws-client-vpn
    Description: Folder path to organize the CloudWatch Logs Insights queries.
  ClientVpnLogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: aws/aws-client-vpn/prod
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group containing Client VPN logs.

  OverallUsageQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${FolderPath}/overall-usage-per-endpoint'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        stats count(*) as totalConnections by endpointId
  UsagePerAuthTypeQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${FolderPath}/usage-per-auth-type'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        stats count(*) as connections by endpointId, authMethod
  DistinctUsersQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${FolderPath}/distinct-users-per-endpoint'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        stats count_distinct(userName) as distinctUsers by endpointId
  ConnectionDurationsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${FolderPath}/connection-durations'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        stats avg(connectionDuration) as avgDuration, min(connectionDuration) as minDuration, max(connectionDuration) as maxDuration by endpointId

    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${FolderPath}/usage-per-auth-type-ad-saml'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Cognito User Pool for Hospitality Insights - Prod'

Parameters:
  SSOProviderName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'Name of the SSO provider (e.g., AzureAD). Leave empty to disable SSO.'
  SSOClientId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'Client ID for the SSO provider'
  SSOClientSecret:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    NoEcho: true
    Description: 'Client secret for the SSO provider'
  SSOAuthorizeUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'Authorization endpoint URL of the SSO provider'
  SSOTokenUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'Token endpoint URL of the SSO provider'
  SSOUserInfoUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'UserInfo endpoint URL of the SSO provider'
  DomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'Custom domain prefix for the Cognito hosted UI. Leave empty to disable custom domain.'

Conditions:
  HasSSO: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SSOProviderName, '']]
  HasDomain: !Not [!Equals [!Ref DomainPrefix, '']]

Resources:
  HospitalityInsightsUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: 'HospitalityInsightsUserPool'
      Schema:
        - Name: 'last_login'
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: false
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false
          RequireSymbols: false
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      MfaConfiguration: 'OFF'
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      UserPoolTags:
        environment: prod
      LambdaConfig:
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt PostAuthLambda.Arn

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref HospitalityInsightsUserPool
      ClientName: 'HospitalityInsightsClient'
      GenerateSecret: false
      RefreshTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        RefreshToken: days
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_CUSTOM_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      CallbackURLs:
        - 'https://example.com'
      LogoutURLs:
        - 'https://example.com'
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
        - implicit
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  CognitoUpdateUserAttributesPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: CognitoUpdateUserAttributes
      Roles:
        - !Ref LambdaExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/${HospitalityInsightsUserPool}'

  PostAuthLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: 'HospitalityInsightsPostAuth'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import datetime

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')
              user_pool_id = event['userPoolId']
              username = event['userName']
              now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
              client.admin_update_user_attributes(
                  UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                  Username=username,
                  UserAttributes=[
                      {'Name': 'custom:last_login', 'Value': now}
                  ]
              )
              return event

  LambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PostAuthLambda.Arn
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/${HospitalityInsightsUserPool}'

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: 'Admin'
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref HospitalityInsightsUserPool

  RegularUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: 'RegularUser'
      Precedence: 2
      UserPoolId: !Ref HospitalityInsightsUserPool

  PowerUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: 'PowerUser'
      Precedence: 3
      UserPoolId: !Ref HospitalityInsightsUserPool

  SSOIdentityProvider:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Condition: HasSSO
    Properties:
      ProviderName: !Ref SSOProviderName
      ProviderType: 'OIDC'
      UserPoolId: !Ref HospitalityInsightsUserPool
      AttributeMapping:
        email: 'email'
        username: 'sub'
      ProviderDetails:
        authorize_scopes: 'openid email profile'
        client_id: !Ref SSOClientId
        client_secret: !Ref SSOClientSecret
        authorize_url: !Ref SSOAuthorizeUrl
        token_url: !Ref SSOTokenUrl
        attributes_url: !Ref SSOUserInfoUrl
        attributes_url_add_attributes: 'true'

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Condition: HasDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Ref DomainPrefix
      UserPoolId: !Ref HospitalityInsightsUserPool

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: 'The ID of the Cognito user pool'
    Value: !Ref HospitalityInsightsUserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolId'

  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: 'The ID of the Cognito user pool client'
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolClientId'

  CognitoDomainURL:
    Description: 'The Cognito hosted UI domain (if custom domain is configured)'
    Value: !If
      - HasDomain
      - !Sub 'https://${DomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
      - 'No custom domain configured'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CognitoDomainURL'
