AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: WebSocket API for managing client connections and session state

Resources:
  # DynamoDB table for session tracking
  SessionTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ttl
        Enabled: true

  # IAM role for API Gateway to access DynamoDB
  ApiGatewayDynamoDBRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt SessionTable.Arn

  # Lambda execution role for EchoFunction
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudWatchLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: arn:aws:logs:*:*:*

  # Lambda function for $default route (echo)
  EchoFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: WebSocketEchoFunction
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': event.get('body', '')
              }

  # Lambda permission for API Gateway to invoke EchoFunction
  LambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref EchoFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com

  # WebSocket API
  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: WebSocketSessionApi
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: $request.body.action

  # $connect route and integration
  ConnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $connect
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Join
        - /
        - - integrations
          - !Ref ConnectIntegration

  ConnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS
      IntegrationUri: !Join
        - ""
        - - "arn:aws:apigateway:"
          - !Ref "AWS::Region"
          - ":dynamodb:action/PutItem"
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      CredentialsArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayDynamoDBRole.Arn
      RequestTemplates:
        "$default": !Sub |
          {
            "TableName": "${SessionTable}",
            "Item": {
              "connectionId": {"S": "$context.connectionId"},
              "ttl": {"N": "4102444800"}
            }
          }
      PayloadFormatVersion: "1.0"
      TimeoutInMillis: 10000

  # $disconnect route and integration
  DisconnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $disconnect
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Join
        - /
        - - integrations
          - !Ref DisconnectIntegration

  DisconnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS
      IntegrationUri: !Join
        - ""
        - - "arn:aws:apigateway:"
          - !Ref "AWS::Region"
          - ":dynamodb:action/DeleteItem"
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      CredentialsArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayDynamoDBRole.Arn
      RequestTemplates:
        "$default": !Sub |
          {
            "TableName": "${SessionTable}",
            "Key": {
              "connectionId": {"S": "$context.connectionId"}
            }
          }
      PayloadFormatVersion: "1.0"
      TimeoutInMillis: 10000

  # $default route and integration (Lambda proxy)
  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $default
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Join
        - /
        - - integrations
          - !Ref DefaultIntegration

  DefaultIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !GetAtt EchoFunction.Arn
      PayloadFormatVersion: "1.0"
      TimeoutInMillis: 10000

  # Deployment and stage
  Deployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - ConnectRoute
      - DisconnectRoute
      - DefaultRoute
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi

  Stage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName: api
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref Deployment

Outputs:
  WebSocketURL:
    Description: WebSocket connection URL
    Value: !Join
      - ''
      - - 'wss://'
        - !Ref WebSocketApi
        - '.execute-api.'
        - !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        - '.amazonaws.com/api'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template that provisions logging infrastructure for FIS chaos engineering (experiment template not created due to unsupported resource types in target environment)'

Parameters:
  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-west-2
    Description: The remote region to block traffic to / pause replication for.
  ExperimentDuration:
    Type: Number
    Default: 20
    Description: Duration of the experiment in minutes.

Resources:
  ChaosKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting FIS experiment logs
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: key-default-1
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow FIS to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: fis.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow CloudWatch Logs to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  ExperimentLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /fis/chaos-experiment-${AWS::StackName}
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt ChaosKmsKey.Arn

Outputs:
  LogGroupArn:
    Description: ARN of the CloudWatch log group for FIS experiment logging
    Value: !GetAtt ExperimentLogGroup.Arn
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key used for log encryption
    Value: !GetAtt ChaosKmsKey.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'VPC network foundation for Kerberos-secured Amazon EMR on EKS'

Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.1.0/24'
    Description: 'CIDR block for the VPC'
  PublicSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.1.0/26'
    Description: 'CIDR block for public subnet 1'
  PublicSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.1.64/26'
    Description: 'CIDR block for public subnet 2'
  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.1.128/26'
    Description: 'CIDR block for private subnet 1'
  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.1.192/26'
    Description: 'CIDR block for private subnet 2'
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'emroneks'
    Description: 'Environment name for tagging'

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'
        - Key: Application
          Value: 'EMRonEKS'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Public Subnets
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public1-${AWS::Region}a'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public2-${AWS::Region}b'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'

  # Private Subnets
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private1-${AWS::Region}a'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private2-${AWS::Region}b'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  # Elastic IPs for NAT Gateways
  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  # NAT Gateways
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-natgw1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-natgw2'

  # Public Route Table
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-rt'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # Private Route Table 1 (AZ1)
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private1-rt'

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  # Private Route Table 2 (AZ2)
  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private2-rt'

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  # KMS Key for Flow Logs Encryption
  FlowLogsKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: 'Enable IAM User Permissions'
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: 'Allow VPC Flow Logs Role to use the key'
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: 'Allow CloudWatch Logs to use the key'
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-flowlogs-kms'

  FlowLogsKMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${EnvironmentName}/flowlogs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKMSKey

  # IAM Role for VPC Flow Logs
  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-flowlogs-role'

  # Separate IAM Policy for Flow Logs permissions (logs + KMS) to break circular dependency
  FlowLogsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: 'VPCFlowLogsPolicy'
      Roles:
        - !Ref FlowLogsRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'logs:CreateLogGroup'
              - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
              - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
              - 'logs:DescribeLogGroups'
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsKMSKey.Arn

  # CloudWatch Log Group for Flow Logs
  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKMSKey.Arn

  # VPC Flow Log
  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      TrafficType: ALL
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-flowlog'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for EC2 Image Builder pipeline with custom component, workflow, and lifecycle policy."

Parameters:
  ParentImageArn:
    Type: String
    Default: "arn:aws:imagebuilder:us-east-1:aws:image/amazon-linux-2-ecs-optimized-x86/1.0.0"
    Description: "ARN of the parent image. Region and account are resolved dynamically when default is used."
  EnvironmentTagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "Dev"
    Description: "Value for the Environment tag used in lifecycle policy filter."
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/16"
  SubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.1.0/24"

Conditions:
  UseDefaultParentImage:
    Fn::Equals: [!Ref ParentImageArn, "arn:aws:imagebuilder:us-east-1:aws:image/amazon-linux-2-ecs-optimized-x86/1.0.0"]

Resources:
  # VPC, Subnet, Internet Gateway, Route Table
  BuildVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "imagebuilder-vpc"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "imagebuilder-igw"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "imagebuilder-rt"

  DefaultPublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  BuildSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "imagebuilder-subnet"

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref BuildSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  BuildSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVPC
      GroupDescription: "Security group for Image Builder build instances"
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: "0.0.0.0/0"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "imagebuilder-sg"

  # S3 bucket for logs
  LogsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "imagebuilder-logs-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"

  # IAM Roles and Instance Profile
  ImageBuilderRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
                - imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess
      Path: "/"

  BuildInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderRole

  LifecycleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess
      Path: "/"

  # Custom Component - sample-component (includes SSM agent update + Chef install)
  SampleComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: "sample-component"
      Version: "1.0.0"
      Platform: "Linux"
      ChangeDescription: "Component to update SSM agent and install Chef Client"
      Data: |
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: UpdateSSMAgent
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - "sudo yum update -y amazon-ssm-agent"
              - name: DownloadChefInstaller
                action: WebDownload
                inputs:
                  - source: "https://www.chef.io/chef/install.sh"
                    destination: "/tmp/install.sh"
              - name: InstallChef
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - "bash /tmp/install.sh"

  # Custom Workflow - sample-workflow
  SampleWorkflow:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Workflow
    Properties:
      Name: "sample-workflow"
      Version: "1.0.0"
      Type: "BUILD"
      ChangeDescription: "Workflow to update SSM agent and build AMI"
      Data: |
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        name: sample-workflow
        steps:
          - name: BuildAMI
            action: CreateImage
            inputs:
              instanceId: "i-placeholder"

  # Image Recipe - sample-recipe
  SampleRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: "sample-recipe"
      Version: "1.0.0"
      ParentImage: !Sub
        - "${ParentImageArn}"
        - ParentImageArn: !If
            - UseDefaultParentImage
            - !Sub "arn:aws:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/amazon-linux-2-ecs-optimized-x86/1.0.0"
            - !Ref ParentImageArn
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref SampleComponent
        - ComponentArn: !Sub "arn:aws:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:component/chrony-time-configuration-test/1.0.0"
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: "/dev/xvda"
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: 30
            VolumeType: gp2
      WorkingDirectory: "/tmp"
      Tags:
        Environment: !Ref EnvironmentTagValue

  # Infrastructure Configuration
  SampleInfraConfig:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: "sample-infrastructure-config"
      Description: "Infrastructure config for sample pipeline"
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref BuildInstanceProfile
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref BuildSecurityGroup
      SubnetId: !Ref BuildSubnet
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      Logging:
        S3Logs:
          S3BucketName: !Ref LogsBucket
          S3KeyPrefix: "/imagebuilder-logs/"
      ResourceTags:
        Environment: !Ref EnvironmentTagValue

  # Distribution Configuration
  SampleDistConfig:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: "sample-distribution"
      Description: "Distribute to us-east-1 with launch permissions to current account"
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref AWS::Region
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: "sample-ami-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}"
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserIds:
                - !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        Environment: !Ref EnvironmentTagValue

  # Image Pipeline - sample-image-pipeline
  SampleImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: "sample-image-pipeline"
      Description: "Pipeline that runs daily at 9AM UTC with image scanning and tests enabled"
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref SampleRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref SampleInfraConfig
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref SampleDistConfig
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: "cron(0 9 * * ? *)"
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: "EXPRESSION_MATCH_AND_DEPENDENCY_UPDATES_AVAILABLE"
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ImageScanningEnabled: true
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 60
      Status: "ENABLED"
      Tags:
        Environment: !Ref EnvironmentTagValue

  # Lifecycle Policy - sample-lifecycle-policy
  SampleLifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: "sample-lifecycle-policy"
      Description: "Deprecates AMIs older than 6 months for resources tagged Environment=Dev"
      ResourceType: "AMI_IMAGE"
      ResourceSelection:
        TagMap:
          Environment: !Ref EnvironmentTagValue
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: "DEPRECATE"
          Filter:
            Type: "AGE"
            Value: 180
            Unit: "DAYS"
            RetainAtLeast: 1
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt LifecycleRole.Arn
      Tags:
        Environment: !Ref EnvironmentTagValue

Outputs:
  PipelineArn:
    Description: "ARN of the Image Builder pipeline"
    Value: !Ref SampleImagePipeline
  LifecyclePolicyArn:
    Description: "ARN of the lifecycle policy"
    Value: !Ref SampleLifecyclePolicy

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Cognito authentication layer for Lex chatbot web UI with optional live chat API support
Parameters:
  IdentityPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: identity pool
    Description: Name for the Cognito Identity Pool
  LexV1BotName:
    Type: String
    Default: OrderFlowers
    Description: Name of the Lex V1 bot (used if Lex V2 Bot ID is not provided)
  LexV2BotID:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Lex V2 Bot ID (leave blank to use Lex V1)
  LexV2BotAliasID:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Lex V2 Bot Alias ID (required if Lex V2 Bot ID is provided)
  ForceCognitoLogin:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'
    Description: When true, denies unauthenticated access to Lex and live chat API actions
  ShouldEnableLiveChat:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'
    Description: When true, adds execute-api invoke permission for a livechat endpoint
Conditions:
  LexV2Provided: !Not [!Equals [!Ref LexV2BotID, '']]
  UseLexV1: !Not [Condition: LexV2Provided]
  NotForceCognitoLogin: !Equals [!Ref ForceCognitoLogin, 'false']
  EnableLiveChat: !Equals [!Ref ShouldEnableLiveChat, 'true']
  IncludeLexV1Unauthenticated: !And [Condition: UseLexV1, Condition: NotForceCognitoLogin]
  IncludeLexV2Unauthenticated: !And [Condition: LexV2Provided, Condition: NotForceCognitoLogin]
  IncludeLiveChatUnauthenticated: !And [Condition: EnableLiveChat, Condition: NotForceCognitoLogin]
Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-user-pool'
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: given_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: true
        - Name: family_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: true
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: true
        - Name: preferred_username
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: true
  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-user-pool-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
  IdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Ref IdentityPoolName
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ProviderName: !Sub 'cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}'
          ClientId: !Ref UserPoolClient
          ServerSideTokenCheck: false
  AuthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud': !Ref IdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr': authenticated
      Policies:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Route53 hosted zone and DNS records for passengerlist.org, including CloudFront distributions and ACM certificates'

Parameters:
  SystemName:
    Type: String
    Default: passengerlist-dns
    Description: Base name for resource tagging
  GoogleSiteVerificationValue:
    Type: String
    Default: '"google-site-verification=placeholder"'
    Description: Value for the Google site verification TXT record
  ZendeskVerificationName:
    Type: String
    Default: "zendeskverification._domainkey.passengerlist.org."
    Description: Fully qualified domain name for the Zendesk verification CNAME (e.g., zendeskverification._domainkey.passengerlist.org.)
  ZendeskVerificationValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "zendeskverification._domainkey.example.com"
    Description: Target domain for the Zendesk verification CNAME
  DKIMVerificationName:
    Type: String
    Default: "google._domainkey.passengerlist.org."
    Description: Fully qualified domain name for the DKIM verification CNAME (e.g., google._domainkey.passengerlist.org.)
  DKIMVerificationValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "google.com"
    Description: Target domain for the DKIM verification CNAME
  SquarespaceVerificationName:
    Type: String
    Default: "_sq_verify.passengerlist.org."
    Description: Fully qualified domain name for the Squarespace verification CNAME (e.g., _sq_verify.passengerlist.org.)
  SquarespaceVerificationValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "verify.squarespace.com"
    Description: Target domain for the Squarespace verification CNAME

Resources:
  HostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

      Name: passengerlist.org.
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: Public hosted zone for passengerlist.org
      HostedZoneTags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref SystemName

  # ACM Certificates for each domain/subdomain - created in parallel, pending validation
  CertRoot:
    Type: AWS::CertificateManager::Certificate
    Properties:
      DomainName: passengerlist.org
      ValidationMethod: DNS
  CertWww:
    Type: AWS::CertificateManager::Certificate
    Properties:
      DomainName: www.passengerlist.org
      ValidationMethod: DNS
  CertDepartures:
    Type: AWS::CertificateManager::Certificate
    Properties:
      DomainName: departures.passengerlist.org

    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref SystemName
  BucketDepartures:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref SystemName
  BucketJoin:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref SystemName
  BucketAthena:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref SystemName
  BucketFeed:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref SystemName

  # CloudFront Origin Access Identities
  OAIRoot:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::CloudFrontOriginAccessIdentity
    Properties:
      CloudFrontOriginAccessIdentityConfig:
        Comment: !Sub 'OAI for ${SystemName} root bucket'
  OAIWww:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::CloudFrontOriginAccessIdentity
    Properties:
      CloudFrontOriginAccessIdentityConfig:
        Comment: !Sub 'OAI for ${SystemName} www bucket'
  OAIDepartures:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::CloudFrontOriginAccessIdentity
    Properties:
      CloudFrontOriginAccessIdentityConfig:
        Comment: !Sub 'OAI for ${SystemName} departures bucket'
  OAIJoin:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::CloudFrontOriginAccessIdentity

        Comment: !Sub 'OAI for ${SystemName} join bucket'
  OAIAthena:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::CloudFrontOriginAccessIdentity
    Properties:
      CloudFrontOriginAccessIdentityConfig:
        Comment: !Sub 'OAI for ${SystemName} athena bucket'
  OAIFeed:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::CloudFrontOriginAccessIdentity
    Properties:
      CloudFrontOriginAccessIdentityConfig:
        Comment: !Sub 'OAI for ${SystemName} feed bucket'

    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Customer Support Authentication Infrastructure - Cognito User Pool, Groups, Clients, Domain, Lambda Trigger, SSM Parameters"
Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: "CustomerSupportUserPool"
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
          AttributeDataType: String
        - Name: preferred_username
          Required: false
          Mutable: true
          AttributeDataType: String
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      LambdaConfig:
        PostConfirmation: !GetAtt AddToCustomerGroupLambda.Arn

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: "admin"
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  CustomerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: "customer"
      Precedence: 2
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: "customersupport"
      Name: "CustomerSupportResourceServer"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: "read"
          ScopeDescription: "Read access to customer data"

  WebClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: "WebAppClient"
      GenerateSecret: false
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      CallbackURLs:
        - "https://example.com/callback"
      LogoutURLs:
        - "https://example.com/logout"
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
        - !Sub "${ResourceServer}/read"
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true

  M2MClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: "M2MClient"
      GenerateSecret: true
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub "${ResourceServer}/read"
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true

  Domain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub "customersupport-${AWS::AccountId}"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  AddToCustomerGroupLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LoggingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"

  AddToCustomerGroupLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: "AddToCustomerGroupPostConfirmation"
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt AddToCustomerGroupLambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import os

          def handler(event, context):
              user_pool_id = event['userPoolId']
              username = event['userName']
              group_name = 'customer'
              client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')
              try:
                  client.admin_add_user_to_group(
                      UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                      Username=username,
                      GroupName=group_name
                  )
                  print(f"Added user {username} to group {group_name}")
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f"Error adding user {username} to group {group_name}: {str(e)}")
                  raise e
              return event

  AddToCustomerGroupLambdaPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: CognitoAddUserToGroupPolicy
      Roles:
        - !Ref AddToCustomerGroupLambdaRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
            Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  LambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !GetAtt AddToCustomerGroupLambda.Arn
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  WebClientIdParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: "/app/customersupport/agentcore/web_client_id"
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref WebClient

  M2MClientIdParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: "/app/customersupport/agentcore/m2m_client_id"
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref M2MClient

  M2MClientSecretParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: "/app/customersupport/agentcore/m2m_client_secret"
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt M2MClient.ClientSecret

  UserPoolIdParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: "/app/customersupport/agentcore/user_pool_id"
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref UserPool

  OAuthScopeParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: "/app/customersupport/agentcore/oauth_scope"
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "${ResourceServer}/read"

  DiscoveryUrlParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: "/app/customersupport/agentcore/discovery_url"
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration"

  TokenEndpointParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: "/app/customersupport/agentcore/token_endpoint"
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://${Domain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token"

  AuthorizeEndpointParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: "/app/customersupport/agentcore/authorize_endpoint"
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://${Domain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/authorize"

  DomainParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: "/app/customersupport/agentcore/domain"
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://${Domain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "VPC with public and private subnets across two AZs, NAT Gateways, and routing"

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: "10.10.0.0/16"
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "MyVPC"

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "10.10.0.0/24"
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "PublicSubnet1"

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "10.10.1.0/24"
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "PublicSubnet2"

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "10.10.10.0/24"
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "PrivateSubnet1"

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "10.10.11.0/24"
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "PrivateSubnet2"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "MyInternetGateway"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  EIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "NATGatewayEIP1"

  EIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "NATGatewayEIP2"

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "NatGateway1"
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "NatGateway2"
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "PublicRouteTable"

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "PrivateRouteTable1"

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "PrivateRouteTable2"

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1
    DependsOn: NatGateway1

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2
    DependsOn: NatGateway2

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: "ID of the VPC"
    Value: !Ref VPC

  VpcCidr:
    Description: "CIDR block of the VPC"
    Value: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock

  AvailabilityZones:
    Description: "List of availability zones used (comma-separated)"
    Value: !Join [",", [!Select [0, !GetAZs ""], !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]]]

  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: "IDs of the public subnets (comma-separated)"
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2]]

  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: "IDs of the private subnets (comma-separated)"
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2]]

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'DR Standby VPC, EC2, and Flow Logs for OCI-AWS Disaster Recovery'

Parameters:
  LatestAL2023AMI:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>
    Default: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
    Description: Latest Amazon Linux 2023 AMI

Resources:
  DRVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.82.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: dr-standby-vpc
        - Key: Environment
          Value: DR
        - Key: Role
          Value: standby
        - Key: Project
          Value: cross-cloud-dr
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref DRVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.82.10.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: dr-standby-subnet
        - Key: Environment
          Value: DR
        - Key: Role
          Value: standby
        - Key: Project
          Value: cross-cloud-dr
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: dr-standby-igw
        - Key: Environment
          Value: DR
        - Key: Role
          Value: standby
        - Key: Project
          Value: cross-cloud-dr
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref DRVPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref DRVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: dr-standby-rt
        - Key: Environment
          Value: DR
        - Key: Role
          Value: standby
        - Key: Project
          Value: cross-cloud-dr
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  DRSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for DR standby EC2 instance
      VpcId: !Ref DRVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/8
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/8
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/8
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: dr-standby-sg
        - Key: Environment
          Value: DR
        - Key: Role
          Value: standby
        - Key: Project
          Value: cross-cloud-dr
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  DRRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: dr-standby-role
        - Key: Environment
          Value: DR
        - Key: Role
          Value: standby
        - Key: Project
          Value: cross-cloud-dr
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  DRInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref DRRole

  DRElasticIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: dr-standby-eip
        - Key: Environment
          Value: DR
        - Key: Role
          Value: standby
        - Key: Project
          Value: cross-cloud-dr
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  DREC2Instance:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    DependsOn:
      - VPCGatewayAttachment
      - SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      InstanceType: t3.micro
      ImageId: !Ref LatestAL2023AMI
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref DRSecurityGroup
      IamInstanceProfile: !Ref DRInstanceProfile
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            Encrypted: true
            VolumeType: gp3
      MetadataOptions:
        HttpTokens: required
        HttpEndpoint: enabled
      UserData:
        Fn::Base64: |
          #!/bin/bash
          yum install -y python3
          mkdir -p /var/www/html
          cat > /var/www/html/index.html << 'EOF'
          <html><body>OK</body></html>
          EOF
          nohup python3 -m http.server 80 --directory /var/www/html &
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: dr-standby-ec2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: DR
        - Key: Role
          Value: standby
        - Key: Project
          Value: cross-cloud-dr
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  EIPAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIPAssociation
    Properties:
      InstanceId: !Ref DREC2Instance
      AllocationId: !GetAtt DRElasticIP.AllocationId

  DRKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for VPC Flow Logs encryption
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow CloudWatch Logs to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub "logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: dr-standby-flowlog-key
        - Key: Environment
          Value: DR
        - Key: Role
          Value: standby
        - Key: Project
          Value: cross-cloud-dr
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  KMSAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/dr-standby-flowlog-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref DRKMSKey

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/vpc/flowlogs/dr-standby
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt DRKMSKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: dr-standby-flowlog-group
        - Key: Environment
          Value: DR
        - Key: Role
          Value: standby
        - Key: Project
          Value: cross-cloud-dr
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  FlowLogDeliveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: dr-standby-flowlog-role
        - Key: Environment
          Value: DR
        - Key: Role
          Value: standby
        - Key: Project
          Value: cross-cloud-dr
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref DRVPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogDeliveryRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: dr-standby-flowlog
        - Key: Environment
          Value: DR
        - Key: Role
          Value: standby
        - Key: Project
          Value: cross-cloud-dr
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

Outputs:
  ElasticIPAddress:
    Description: Elastic IP address for DR standby endpoint
    Value: !Ref DRElasticIP
  InstanceId:
    Description: EC2 instance ID
    Value: !Ref DREC2Instance
  VPCId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref DRVPC

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Route53 hosted zone for prxu.org with Google Workspace records, CloudFront CDNs, ACM certificates, and all required DNS records.

Parameters:
  GoogleWorkspaceVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Description: Google Workspace domain verification token string (e.g., google-site-verification=...)
    Default: "google-site-verification=placeholder-token"
  FeedProxyTarget:
    Type: String
    Description: Target endpoint for authenticated feed proxy CNAME records
    Default: "feed-proxy.example.com"
  RouterTarget:
    Type: String
    Description: Target endpoint for dovetail router CNAME records
    Default: "router.example.com"

Resources:
  HostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: prxu.org.
      HostedZoneTags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production
        - Key: Deployment
          Value: final
        - Key: UpdatedAt
          Value: final-v2
        - Key: Finalized
          Value: "true"

  TXTRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: prxu.org.
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${GoogleWorkspaceVerificationToken}"'

  MXRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: prxu.org.
      Type: MX
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - "1 ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM."
        - "5 ALT1.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM."
        - "5 ALT2.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM."
        - "10 ALT3.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM."
        - "10 ALT4.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM."

  CloudFrontDistributionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudFrontDistributionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudfront:CreateDistribution
                  - cloudfront:UpdateDistribution
                  - cloudfront:GetDistribution
                  - cloudfront:DeleteDistribution
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"

  CloudFrontDistributionProvider:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.9
      Role: !GetAtt CloudFrontDistributionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import logging
          import time

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
          client = boto3.client('cloudfront')

          def handler(event, context):
              logger.info("Event: %s", json.dumps(event))
              request_type = event['RequestType']
              physical_resource_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId')
              props = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})
              distribution_config = props.get('DistributionConfig')
              response_data = {}

              try:
                  if request_type == 'Create':
                      response = client.create_distribution(
                          DistributionConfig=distribution_config
                      )
                      distribution = response['Distribution']
                      physical_resource_id = distribution['Id']
                      response_data['DomainName'] = distribution['DomainName']
                  elif request_type == 'Update':
                      # Get existing distribution to include Id and IfMatch
                      existing = client.get_distribution(Id=physical_resource_id)
                      etag = existing['ETag']
                      existing_config = existing['Distribution']['DistributionConfig']
                      # Update distribution config
                      response = client.update_distribution(
                          DistributionConfig=distribution_config,
                          Id=physical_resource_id,
                          IfMatch=etag
                      )
                      distribution = response['Distribution']
                      response_data['DomainName'] = distribution['DomainName']
                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      if physical_resource_id:
                          try:
                              existing = client.get_distribution(Id=physical_resource_id)
                              etag = existing['ETag']
                              config = existing['Distribution']['DistributionConfig']
                              if config['Enabled']:
                                  # Disable distribution first
                                  config['Enabled'] = False
                                  client.update_distribution(
                                      DistributionConfig=config,
                                      Id=physical_resource_id,
                                      IfMatch=etag
                                  )
                                  # Wait for disable to propagate (optional)
                                  time.sleep(5)
                                  existing = client.get_distribution(Id=physical_resource_id)
                                  etag = existing['ETag']
                              client.delete_distribution(
                                  Id=physical_resource_id,
                                  IfMatch=etag
                              )
                          except client.exceptions.NoSuchDistribution:
                              pass
                      response_data = {}
              except Exception as e:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Parameters:
  Prefix:
    Description: Naming prefix for all resources
    Type: String
    Default: SimpleApp1
  CreateInternetGateway:
    Description: Boolean flag to create Internet Gateway and attachment
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "true"
  CreatePublicSubnet:
    Description: Boolean flag to create the public subnet
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "true"
  CreateRouteTable:
    Description: Boolean flag to create the public route table
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "true"
  CreateSecurityGroup:
    Description: Boolean flag to create the security group
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "true"
  SourceCidr:
    Description: Allowed CIDR block for HTTP and HTTPS inbound traffic
    Type: String
    Default: "0.0.0.0/0"
    AllowedPattern: "^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/([0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-2])$"

Conditions:
  CreateInternetGatewayTrue:
    Fn::Equals:
      - !Ref CreateInternetGateway
      - "true"
  CreatePublicSubnetTrue:
    Fn::Equals:
      - Ref: CreatePublicSubnet
      - "true"
  CreateRouteTableTrue:
    Fn::Equals:
      - Ref: CreateRouteTable
      - "true"
  CreateSecurityGroupTrue:
    Fn::Equals:
      - Ref: CreateSecurityGroup
      - "true"
  CreatePublicInternetRoute:
    Fn::And:
      - Condition: CreateInternetGatewayTrue
      - Condition: CreateRouteTableTrue
  CreateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Fn::And:
      - Condition: CreatePublicSubnetTrue
      - Condition: CreateRouteTableTrue

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${Prefix}-vpc

  InternetGateway:
    Condition: CreateInternetGatewayTrue
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${Prefix}-igw

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Condition: CreateInternetGatewayTrue
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Condition: CreatePublicSubnetTrue
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref "AWS::Region"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${Prefix}-public-subnet

  PublicRouteTable:
    Condition: CreateRouteTableTrue
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${Prefix}-public-rt

  PublicInternetRoute:
    Condition: CreatePublicInternetRoute
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn:
      - VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Condition: CreateSubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  SecurityGroup:
    Condition: CreateSecurityGroupTrue
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub "Security group for ${Prefix}"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: !Ref SourceCidr
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref SourceCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${Prefix}-sg

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: The ID of the created VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC

    Description: 'Environment name prefix used for resource naming and tagging'

Resources:
  # VPC
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: Hub VPC for multi-account connectivity

  # Internet Gateway
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Public Subnets
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Type
          Value: Public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Type
          Value: Public

  # Private Subnets
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.10.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Type
          Value: Private

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.11.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Type
          Value: Private

  # Public Route Table
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # Elastic IPs for NAT Gateways
  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # NAT Gateways
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: NAT for private subnet 1

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: NAT for private subnet 2

  # Private Route Tables
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # Private Routes to NAT Gateways
  PrivateRoute1Default:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateRoute2Default:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  # Private Subnet Route Table Associations
  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  # Transit Gateway
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      AmazonSideAsn: 64512
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: enable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-tgw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # Transit Gateway VPC Attachment
  TransitGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-tgw-attachment'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # Private Routes to Transit Gateway for spoke connectivity (10.0.0.0/8)
  PrivateRoute1ToTGW:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/8
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  PrivateRoute2ToTGW:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/8
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  # VPC Flow Logs
  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${EnvironmentName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-flowlogs-lg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - ec2:Describe*
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-flowlogs-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-flowlog'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # Security Group for VPC Endpoints
  VPCEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for VPC endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-endpoint-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # VPC Endpoints
  SSMEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-ssm-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  EC2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-ec2messages-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  SSMMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-ssmmessages-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  CloudWatchLogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-logs-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-s3-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
