AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Student Services Agent Infrastructure for Educational Platform"

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Shared Managed Policy
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BaseBedrockAgentPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: BaseBedrockAgentPolicy
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: BedrockModelInvocation
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - bedrock:InvokeModel
              - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
            Resource: "arn:aws:bedrock:*:*:model/*"
          - Sid: CloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:aws/bedrock-agentcore/student-services/*"
          - Sid: CloudWatchMetrics
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: XRay
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - xray:PutTraceSegments
              - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: SSMParameterAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParametersByPath
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/student-services/*"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. StudentServicesAgent (only execution role)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StudentServicesAgentExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: StudentServicesAgentExecutionRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:agent/*"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref BaseBedrockAgentPolicy

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. StudentServicesGateway (Cognito resources only, no execution role)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StudentServicesGatewayUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: StudentServicesGatewayUserPool
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 6
          RequireUppercase: false
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false
          RequireSymbols: false
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          Mutable: true

  StudentServicesGatewayUserPoolDomain:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark Section 3 - Logging Monitoring Controls
Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    Description: Environment name for tagging and naming resources
Conditions: {}
Resources:
  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for CloudWatch Logs encryption and SNS topic encryption
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow CloudWatch Logs to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow SNS to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow CloudTrail to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
  KMSAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/cis-${Environment}-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
  SNSTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub cis-${Environment}-alarms
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
  SNSTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref SNSTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Allow CloudWatch Alarms to publish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref SNSTopic
          - Sid: Allow root account access
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref SNSTopic
  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/cloudtrail/management-events
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
  CloudTrailRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub cis-${Environment}-cloudtrail-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt LogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
  CloudTrailBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub cis-cloudtrail-logs-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
  CloudTrailBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref CloudTrailBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AWSCloudTrailAclCheck
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:GetBucketAcl
            Resource: !Sub arn:aws:s3:::${CloudTrailBucket}
          - Sid: AWSCloudTrailWrite
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub arn:aws:s3:::${CloudTrailBucket}/AWSLogs/${AWS::AccountId}/*
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                s3:x-amz-acl: bucket-owner-full-control

    Type: AWS::CloudTrail::Trail

      TrailName: !Sub cis-${Environment}-trail

      IncludeGlobalServiceEvents: true
      IsMultiRegionTrail: true
      EnableLogFileValidation: true
      CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: !GetAtt LogGroup.Arn
      CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt CloudTrailRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Security Hub automated deployment across AWS Organization using Control Tower events

Parameters:
  AuditAccountId:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: ^\d{12}$
    Default: '000000000000'
    Description: The 12-digit AWS account ID of the Audit (Security) account
  LogArchiveAccountId:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: ^\d{12}$
    Default: '000000000000'
    Description: The 12-digit AWS account ID of the Log Archive account
  SuperwerkerPathPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: /superwerker/
    Description: Path prefix in Parameter Store for configuration values
  ControlTowerExecutionRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: AWSControlTowerExecution
    Description: Name of the cross-account role provisioned by Control Tower

Conditions:
  AuditAccountIdProvided: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AuditAccountId, '000000000000']]
  LogArchiveAccountIdProvided: !Not [!Equals [!Ref LogArchiveAccountId, '000000000000']]

Resources:

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # SSM Parameters
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  AuditAccountIdParameter:
    Condition: AuditAccountIdProvided
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Type: String
      Name: !Sub ${SuperwerkerPathPrefix}audit_account_id
      Value: !Ref AuditAccountId
      Description: AWS Account ID of the Audit (Security) delegated administrator

  LogArchiveAccountIdParameter:
    Condition: LogArchiveAccountIdProvided
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Type: String
      Name: !Sub ${SuperwerkerPathPrefix}log_archive_account_id
      Value: !Ref LogArchiveAccountId
      Description: AWS Account ID of the Log Archive account

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Roles
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  EventBridgeToSSMRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartAutomationExecutions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${HandleNewAccountDocument}:$DEFAULT
                  - !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/EnableSecurityHubDelegatedAdmin:$DEFAULT
                  - !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/EnableSecurityHubMember:$DEFAULT
                  - !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/AcceptSecurityHubInvitation:$DEFAULT
                  - !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/EnableSecurityHubInLogArchive:$DEFAULT

  SSMAutomationAssumeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CrossAccountAndSecurityHub
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: sts:AssumeRole
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:sts::*:role/${ControlTowerExecutionRoleName}
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: sts:TagSession
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:GetParameter
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter${SuperwerkerPathPrefix}*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - securityhub:EnableSecurityHub
                  - securityhub:CreateMembers
                  - securityhub:InviteMembers
                  - securityhub:ListInvitations
                  - securityhub:AcceptInvitation
                  - securityhub:GetMembers
                  - securityhub:ListMembers
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:RegisterDelegatedAdministrator
                  - organizations:DeregisterDelegatedAdministrator
                  - organizations:ListDelegatedAdministrators
                  - organizations:ListAccounts
                  - organizations:DescribeOrganization
                Resource: '*'

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # SSM Automation Documents
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  EnableSecurityHubDelegatedAdminDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: EnableSecurityHubDelegatedAdmin
      UpdateMethod: Replace
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >
          Enables Security Hub in the Audit account and registers it as the
          delegated administrator for Security Hub in AWS Organizations.
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the role that SSM Automation will use to run the steps.
          TargetRoleName:
            type: String
            default: "AWSControlTowerExecution"
            description: Name of the cross-account role to assume in the Audit account.
        mainSteps:
          - name: GetAuditAccountId
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ssm
              Api: GetParameter
              Name: "/superwerker/audit_account_id"
            outputs:
              - Name: auditAccountId
                Selector: "$.Parameter.Value"
                Type: String
          - name: EnableSecurityHub
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.10
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                accountId: "{{ GetAuditAccountId.auditAccountId }}"
                roleName: "{{ TargetRoleName }}"
              Script: |
                import boto3
                def handler(events, context):
                    account_id = events['accountId']
                    role_name = events['roleName']
                    role_arn = f'arn:aws:iam::{account_id}:role/{role_name}'
                    sts = boto3.client('sts')
                    assumed = sts.assume_role(
                        RoleArn=role_arn,
                        RoleSessionName='EnableSecurityHub'
                    )
                    creds = assumed['Credentials']
                    client = boto3.client(
                        'securityhub',
                        aws_access_key_id=creds['AccessKeyId'],
                        aws_secret_access_key=creds['SecretAccessKey'],
                        aws_session_token=creds['SessionToken']
                    )
                    client.enable_security_hub(EnableDefaultStandards=True)
                    return {'Success': True}
            outputs:
              - Name: Success
                Selector: $.Payload.Success
                Type: Boolean
          - name: RegisterDelegatedAdmin
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.10
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                accountId: "{{ GetAuditAccountId.auditAccountId }}"
                roleName: "{{ TargetRoleName }}"
              Script: |
                import boto3
                def handler(events, context):
                    account_id = events['accountId']
                    role_name = events['roleName']
                    role_arn = f'arn:aws:iam::{account_id}:role/{role_name}'
                    sts = boto3.client('sts')
                    assumed = sts.assume_role(
                        RoleArn=role_arn,
                        RoleSessionName='RegisterDelegatedAdmin'
                    )
                    creds = assumed['Credentials']
                    client = boto3.client(
                        'organizations',
                        aws_access_key_id=creds['AccessKeyId'],
                        aws_secret_access_key=creds['SecretAccessKey'],
                        aws_session_token=creds['SessionToken']
                    )
                    client.register_delegated_administrator(
                        AccountId=account_id,
                        ServicePrincipal='securityhub.amazonaws.com'
                    )
                    return {'Success': True}
            outputs:
              - Name: Success
                Selector: $.Payload.Success
                Type: Boolean
          - name: SuccessStatus
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.10
              Handler: handler
              Script: |
                def handler(events, context):
                    return {'Success': True}
            outputs:
              - Name: Success
                Selector: $.Payload.Success
                Type: Boolean

  EnableSecurityHubMemberDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: EnableSecurityHubMember
      UpdateMethod: Replace
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >
          Enables Security Hub in a target member account, then uses the delegated
          admin account to create the member and send an invitation.
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the role that SSM Automation will use to run the steps.
          TargetAccountId:
            type: String
            description: The 12-digit AWS account ID of the target member account.
          TargetRoleName:
            type: String
            default: "AWSControlTowerExecution"
            description: Name of the cross-account role to assume in the target account.
        mainSteps:
          - name: GetAuditAccountId
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ssm
              Api: GetParameter
              Name: "/superwerker/audit_account_id"
            outputs:
              - Name: auditAccountId
                Selector: "$.Parameter.Value"
                Type: String
          - name: EnableHubInTarget
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.10
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                targetAccountId: "{{ TargetAccountId }}"
                targetRoleName: "{{ TargetRoleName }}"
              Script: |
                import boto3
                def handler(events, context):
                    account_id = events['targetAccountId']
                    role_name = events['targetRoleName']
                    role_arn = f'arn:aws:iam::{account_id}:role/{role_name}'
                    sts = boto3.client('sts')
                    assumed = sts.assume_role(
                        RoleArn=role_arn,
                        RoleSessionName='EnableHubInTarget'
                    )
                    creds = assumed['Credentials']
                    client = boto3.client(
                        'securityhub',
                        aws_access_key_id=creds['AccessKeyId'],
                        aws_secret_access_key=creds['SecretAccessKey'],
                        aws_session_token=creds['SessionToken']
                    )
                    client.enable_security_hub(EnableDefaultStandards=True)
                    return {'Success': True}
            outputs:
              - Name: Success
                Selector: $.Payload.Success
                Type: Boolean
          - name: CreateMemberInDelegatedAdmin
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.10
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                auditAccountId: "{{ GetAuditAccountId.auditAccountId }}"
                targetAccountId: "{{ TargetAccountId }}"
                targetRoleName: "{{ TargetRoleName }}"
              Script: |

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: Shared IAM roles and supporting resources for EKS deployments
Parameters:
  EnvironmentAlias:
    Type: String
    Default: shared
    Description: Environment alias used as prefix for resource names
  Hash:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional hash suffix for resource names
  PermissionsBoundaryArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: ARN of a permissions boundary to attach to all roles (leave empty if not required)
  BastionBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional name for the S3 bucket created by this stack (leave empty for auto-generated name)
Conditions:
  HasPermissionsBoundary: !Not [!Equals [!Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn, ""]]
  HasBastionBucketName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref BastionBucketName, ""]]
Resources:
  # GuardDuty Detector
  GuardDutyDetector:
    Type: AWS::GuardDuty::Detector
    Properties:
      Enable: true
      FindingPublishingFrequency: FIFTEEN_MINUTES
  # Bastion S3 Bucket
  BastionBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !If [HasBastionBucketName, !Ref BastionBucketName, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
  # Log Groups for CloudFormation Registry
  CfnRegistryResourceLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: cloudformation/registry/awsqs-kubernetes-resource
      RetentionInDays: 3653
  CfnRegistryHelmLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: awsqs-kubernetes-helm-logs
      RetentionInDays: 3653
  CfnRegistryEksClusterLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: cloudformation/registry/awsqs-eks-cluster
      RetentionInDays: 3653
  # Lambda Resource Discovery Role
  LambdaResourceDiscoveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentAlias}${Hash}-lambda-resource-discovery"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
  # Lambda Caller Identity Role
  LambdaCallerIdentityRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentAlias}${Hash}-lambda-caller-identity"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CallerIdentityPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                  - cloudformation:Describe*
                  - cloudformation:ListStack*
                  - cloudtrail:DescribeTrails
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:GetLogEvents
                Resource: "*"
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
  # Describe EKS Node Group Role
  DescribeEksNodeGroupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentAlias}${Hash}-describe-eks-nodegroup"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DescribeEksNodeGroupPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:DescribeNodegroup
                  - eks:ListNodegroups
                  - ec2:Describe*
                Resource: "*"
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
  # CloudFormation Execution Role
  CloudFormationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentAlias}${Hash}-cfn-execution"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      MaxSessionDuration: 8400
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CfnExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:*
                  - secretsmanager:*
                  - kms:*
                  - s3:*
                  - ec2:*
                  - lambda:*
                  - logs:*
                  - cloudwatch:*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                Resource: "*"
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
  # Logging Delivery Role
  LoggingDeliveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'SQS infrastructure for testing with FIFO, standard queues, DLQs, KMS encryption, and CloudWatch alarms.'
Resources:
  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: 'KMS key for SQS queue encryption'
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: 'Enable root user access'
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: 'Allow SQS service to use the key'
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
  FIFOQueueNoDLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-fifo-no-dlq.fifo'
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: false
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
  FIFODLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-fifo-dlq.fifo'
      FifoQueue: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
  FIFOQueueWithDLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-fifo-with-dlq.fifo'
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: false
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt FIFODLQ.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
  StandardDLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-standard-dlq'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
  StandardQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-standard'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt StandardDLQ.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
  SeparateFIFODLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-separate-fifo-dlq.fifo'
      FifoQueue: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
  StandardQueueMessagesSentAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-standard-queue-messages-sent'
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: breaching
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      OKActions: []
      AlarmActions: []
      InsufficientDataActions: []
  FIFOQueueWithDLQMessagesSentAnomalyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    DependsOn: FIFOQueueWithDLQMessagesSentAnomalyDetector
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-fifo-with-dlq-messages-sent-anomaly'
      ThresholdMetricId: m1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanUpperThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Metrics:
        - Id: m1
          Expression: ANOMALY_DETECTION_BAND(m2, 2)
          Label: 'Anomaly Detection Band'
          ReturnData: true
        - Id: m2
          ReturnData: true
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/SQS
              MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
              Dimensions:
                - Name: QueueName
                  Value: !GetAtt FIFOQueueWithDLQ.QueueName
            Stat: Average
            Period: 300
      OKActions: []
      AlarmActions: []
      InsufficientDataActions: []
  FIFOQueueWithDLQMessagesSentAnomalyDetector:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::AnomalyDetector
    Properties:
      MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Stat: Average
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt FIFOQueueWithDLQ.QueueName
      Configuration:
        ExcludedTimeRanges: []
        MetricTimeZone: UTC
  StandardQueueSentMessageSizeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-standard-queue-sent-message-size'
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: SentMessageSize
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      Threshold: 183500
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      OKActions: []
      AlarmActions: []
      InsufficientDataActions: []
  FIFOQueueNoDLQSentMessageSizeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-fifo-no-dlq-sent-message-size'
      Namespace: AWS/SQS

    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-fifo-dlq-visible-messages'

      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible

  StandardQueueAgeOfOldestMessageAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-standard-queue-age-of-oldest-message'
      Namespace: AWS/SQS

      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      OKActions: []

    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Private ROSA Networking Infrastructure with Egress VPC via Transit Gateway'

Parameters:
  ROSACIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.1.0.0/16'
    Description: 'CIDR block for the ROSA VPC'
  EgressCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.0/16'
    Description: 'CIDR block for the Egress VPC'
  NumberOfAZs:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['1', '3']
    Default: '1'
    Description: 'Number of Availability Zones for ROSA private subnets'
  ROSASubnetCIDR1:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.1.0.0/24'
    Description: 'CIDR block for ROSA private subnet in Availability Zone 1'
  ROSASubnetCIDR2:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.1.1.0/24'
    Description: 'CIDR block for ROSA private subnet in Availability Zone 2'
  ROSASubnetCIDR3:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.1.2.0/24'
    Description: 'CIDR block for ROSA private subnet in Availability Zone 3'
  EgressPublicCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.0/24'
    Description: 'CIDR block for the Egress VPC public subnet'
  EgressPrivateCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.1.0/24'
    Description: 'CIDR block for the Egress VPC private subnet'
  CreateSLR:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Default: 'false'
    Description: 'Whether to create the Elastic Load Balancing service-linked role'
  EnableFlowLogs:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Default: 'false'
    Description: 'Whether to enable VPC Flow Logs for both VPCs'

Conditions:
  IsThreeAZs: !Equals [!Ref NumberOfAZs, '3']
  CreateELBSLR: !Equals [!Ref CreateSLR, 'true']
  EnableFlowLogsCondition: !Equals [!Ref EnableFlowLogs, 'true']

Resources:
  # VPCs
  ROSAVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref ROSACIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'ROSA VPC'

  EgressVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'Egress VPC'

  # ROSA Private Subnets
  ROSAPrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ROSAVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref ROSASubnetCIDR1
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'ROSA Private Subnet 1'

  ROSAPrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: IsThreeAZs
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ROSAVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref ROSASubnetCIDR2
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'ROSA Private Subnet 2'

  ROSAPrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: IsThreeAZs
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ROSAVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref ROSASubnetCIDR3
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'ROSA Private Subnet 3'

  # Egress Subnets
  EgressPublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressPublicCIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'Egress Public Subnet'

  EgressPrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressPrivateCIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'Egress Private Subnet'

  # Internet Gateway and Attachment
  EgressIGW:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'Egress IGW'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref EgressIGW

  # NAT Gateway
  NATEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  EgressNATGW:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NATEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'Egress NAT Gateway'

  # Transit Gateway
  TGW:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      Description: 'ROSA Egress Transit Gateway'
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: "disable"
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: "disable"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'ROSA-TGW'

  TGWRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TGW
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'ROSA-TGW-RouteTable'

  # Transit Gateway Attachments
  TGWAttachmentROSA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TGW
      VpcId: !Ref ROSAVPC
      SubnetIds: !If
        - IsThreeAZs
        - [!Ref ROSAPrivateSubnet1, !Ref ROSAPrivateSubnet2, !Ref ROSAPrivateSubnet3]
        - [!Ref ROSAPrivateSubnet1]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'ROSA-VPC-Attachment'

  TGWAttachmentEgress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TGW
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      SubnetIds: [!Ref EgressPrivateSubnet]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'Egress-VPC-Attachment'

  # Associate TGW Attachments to TGW Route Table
  TGWAssociationROSA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TGWRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TGWAttachmentROSA

  TGWAssociationEgress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TGWRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TGWAttachmentEgress

  # Static Routes in TGW Route Table
  TGWRoute0ToEgress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TGWRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TGWAttachmentEgress

  TGWRouteROSAtoEgress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TGWRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref EgressCIDR
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TGWAttachmentEgress

  TGWRouteEgressToROSA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TGWRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref ROSACIDR
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TGWAttachmentROSA

  # Route Tables for ROSA Private Subnets
  ROSAPrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ROSAVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'ROSA Private RT 1'

  ROSAPrivateRouteTable2:
    Condition: IsThreeAZs
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ROSAVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'ROSA Private RT 2'

  ROSAPrivateRouteTable3:
    Condition: IsThreeAZs
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ROSAVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'ROSA Private RT 3'

  # Route Table Associations for ROSA Subnets
  ROSASubnetRTAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref ROSAPrivateRouteTable1
      SubnetId: !Ref ROSAPrivateSubnet1

  ROSASubnetRTAssociation2:
    Condition: IsThreeAZs
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref ROSAPrivateRouteTable2
      SubnetId: !Ref ROSAPrivateSubnet2

  ROSASubnetRTAssociation3:
    Condition: IsThreeAZs
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref ROSAPrivateRouteTable3
      SubnetId: !Ref ROSAPrivateSubnet3

  # Routes in ROSA Private Subnets (default route to TGW)
  ROSAPrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TGWAttachmentROSA
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref ROSAPrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TGW

  ROSAPrivateRoute2:
    Condition: IsThreeAZs
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TGWAttachmentROSA
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref ROSAPrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TGW

  ROSAPrivateRoute3:
    Condition: IsThreeAZs
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TGWAttachmentROSA
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref ROSAPrivateRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TGW

  # Route Tables for Egress Subnets
  EgressPublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'Egress Public RT'

  EgressPrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'Egress Private RT'

  # Subnet Route Table Associations for Egress
  EgressPublicRTAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet

  EgressPrivateRTAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet

  # Routes in Egress Public Subnet (default route to IGW)
  EgressPublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      GatewayId: !Ref EgressIGW

  # Routes in Egress Private Subnet (default route to NATGW, plus return route to ROSA VPC via TGW)
  EgressPrivateRouteDefault:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      NatGatewayId: !Ref EgressNATGW

  EgressPrivateRouteToROSA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TGWAttachmentEgress
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref ROSACIDR
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TGW

  # Optional Service-Linked Role for ELB
  ELBSLR:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ServiceLinkedRole
    Condition: CreateELBSLR
    Properties:
      AWSServiceName: elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com
      Description: 'Service-linked role for Elastic Load Balancing'

  # VPC Flow Logs (optional)
  FlowLogsKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: EnableFlowLogsCondition
    Properties:
      Description: 'KMS key for VPC Flow Logs encryption'
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow CloudWatch Logs to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Condition: EnableFlowLogsCondition
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/vpc/flowlogs
      RetentionInDays: 7
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKMSKey.Arn

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: EnableFlowLogsCondition
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogGroup'
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogGroups'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Encrypt'
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
                  - 'kms:DescribeKey'
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsKMSKey.Arn

  FLowLogROSAPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Condition: EnableFlowLogsCondition
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref ROSAVPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn

  FLowLogEgressVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Condition: EnableFlowLogsCondition
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref EgressVPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn

Outputs:
  ROSAVPC:
    Description: 'ROSA VPC ID'
    Value: !Ref ROSAVPC

  EgressVPC:
    Description: 'Egress VPC ID'
    Value: !Ref EgressVPC

  ROSAPrivateSubnet1:
    Description: 'ROSA Private Subnet 1 ID'
    Value: !Ref ROSAPrivateSubnet1

  ROSAPrivateSubnet2:
    Description: 'ROSA Private Subnet 2 ID'
    Condition: IsThreeAZs
    Value: !Ref ROSAPrivateSubnet2

  ROSAPrivateSubnet3:
    Description: 'ROSA Private Subnet 3 ID'
    Condition: IsThreeAZs
    Value: !Ref ROSAPrivateSubnet3

  EgressPublicSubnet:
    Description: 'Egress Public Subnet ID'
    Value: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet

  EgressPrivateSubnet:
    Description: 'Egress Private Subnet ID'
    Value: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet

  TransitGatewayId:
    Description: 'Transit Gateway ID'
    Value: !Ref TGW

  NatGatewayId:
    Description: 'NAT Gateway ID'
    Value: !Ref EgressNATGW

  InternetGatewayId:
    Description: 'Internet Gateway ID'
    Value: !Ref EgressIGW

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Prerequisites and nine SSM Automation Documents for PCI DSS remediation

Resources:
  # 1. CloudTrail CloudWatch Logs Log Group
  CloudTrailLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: 1827
      LogGroupName: /aws/cloudtrail/logs

  # 2. KMS Key with rotation and root access
  CloudTrailKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'

  # 3. SSM Automation IAM Role (with IAMFullAccess and AdministratorAccess)
  SSMAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: SSMAutomationRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/IAMFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

  # 4. CloudTrail CloudWatch Logs IAM Role
  CloudTrailCWLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: CloudTrailCWLogsRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudTrailCWLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                Resource: '*'

  # 5. SSM Document: EncryptTrailAndIntegrateCWLogs
  EncryptTrailAndIntegrateCWLogs:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: EncryptTrailAndIntegrateCWLogs
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Encrypt a CloudTrail trail with a KMS key and integrate with CloudWatch Logs
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          trailName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the CloudTrail trail
          kmsKeyId:
            type: String
            description: KMS key ID or ARN
          logGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateTrail
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{ trailName }}'
              KmsKeyId: '{{ kmsKeyId }}'
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: '{{ logGroupArn }}'

  # 6. SSM Document: EnableKMSKeyRotation
  EnableKMSKeyRotation:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: EnableKMSKeyRotation
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Enable key rotation on a specified KMS key
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          KmsKeyId:
            type: String
            description: KMS key ID or ARN
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableKeyRotation
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: kms
              Api: EnableKeyRotation
              KeyId: '{{ KmsKeyId }}'

  # 7. SSM Document: IntegrateCloudTrailWithCWLogs
  IntegrateCloudTrailWithCWLogs:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: IntegrateCloudTrailWithCWLogs
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Integrate a CloudTrail trail with CloudWatch Logs
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the CloudTrail trail
          LogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateTrail
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: '{{ LogGroupArn }}'

  # 8. SSM Document: UpdatePasswordPolicy
  UpdatePasswordPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: UpdatePasswordPolicy
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Update IAM password policy with PCI DSS requirements
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters: {}
        mainSteps:
          - name: updatePasswordPolicy
            action: aws:executeAutomation
            inputs:
              DocumentName: AWS-UpdatePasswordPolicy
              RuntimeParameters:
                MinPasswordLength: ['14']
                RequireUppercase: ['true']
                RequireLowercase: ['true']
                RequireNumbers: ['true']
                RequireSymbols: ['true']
                AllowUsersToChangePassword: ['true']
                HardExpiry: ['true']
                MaxPasswordAge: ['90']
                PasswordReusePrevention: ['24']

  # 9. SSM Document: EnableLogFileValidationAndMultiRegion
  EnableLogFileValidationAndMultiRegion:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: EnableLogFileValidationAndMultiRegion
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Enable log file validation and multi-region trail, integrate CloudWatch Logs
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the CloudTrail trail
          LogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateTrail
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
              EnableLogFileValidation: true
              IsMultiRegionTrail: true
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: '{{ LogGroupArn }}'

  # 10. SSM Document: RevokeDefaultSGRules
  RevokeDefaultSGRules:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: RevokeDefaultSGRules
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Revoke all inbound and outbound rules on a default security group
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          SecurityGroupId:
            type: String
            description: ID of the default security group
        mainSteps:
          - name: DescribeSecurityGroup
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DescribeSecurityGroups
              GroupIds: ['{{ SecurityGroupId }}']
            outputs:
              - Name: IpPermissions
                Selector: $.SecurityGroups[0].IpPermissions
                Type: StringList
              - Name: IpPermissionsEgress
                Selector: $.SecurityGroups[0].IpPermissionsEgress
                Type: StringList
          - name: RevokeIngress
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              GroupId: '{{ SecurityGroupId }}'
              IpPermissions: '{{ DescribeSecurityGroup.IpPermissions }}'
          - name: RevokeEgress
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
              GroupId: '{{ SecurityGroupId }}'
              IpPermissions: '{{ DescribeSecurityGroup.IpPermissionsEgress }}'

  # 11. SSM Document: DeleteSecurityGroup
  DeleteSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: DeleteSecurityGroup
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Delete a specified security group
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          SecurityGroupId:
            type: String
            description: ID of the security group to delete
        mainSteps:
          - name: DeleteSG
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DeleteSecurityGroup
              GroupId: '{{ SecurityGroupId }}'

  # 12. SSM Document: ReleaseUnusedEIP
  ReleaseUnusedEIP:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: ReleaseUnusedEIP
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Release an unused Elastic IP address
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          AllocationId:
            type: String
            description: Allocation ID of the Elastic IP
        mainSteps:
          - name: ReleaseEIP
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: ReleaseAddress
              AllocationId: '{{ AllocationId }}'

  # 13. Lambda Role for CodeBuild environment cleaner
  CodeBuildEnvCleanerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: CodeBuildEnvCleanerRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CodeBuildAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codebuild:BatchGetProjects
                  - codebuild:UpdateProject
                Resource: '*'

  # 14. Lambda Function for CodeBuild environment cleanup
  CodeBuildEnvCleanerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt CodeBuildEnvCleanerRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              project_name = event['ProjectName']
              codebuild = boto3.client('codebuild')
              
              # Get current project configuration
              response = codebuild.batch_get_projects(names=[project_name])
              project = response['projects'][0]
              env = project['environment']
              
              # Filter out sensitive environment variables
              filtered_vars = [v for v in env.get('environmentVariables', []) if v['name'] not in ('AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID', 'AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY')]
              env['environmentVariables'] = filtered_vars
              
              # Update project
              codebuild.update_project(
                  name=project_name,
                  environment=env
              )
              return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': json.dumps('Environment variables updated')}

  # 15. SSM Document: RemoveCodeBuildEnvVars (using Lambda)
  RemoveCodeBuildEnvVars:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: RemoveCodeBuildEnvVars
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Remove AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY environment variables from a CodeBuild project
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          ProjectName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the CodeBuild project
        mainSteps:
          - name: invokeLambda
            action: aws:invokeLambdaFunction
            inputs:
              FunctionName: !Ref CodeBuildEnvCleanerFunction
              Payload: '{"ProjectName": "{{ ProjectName }}"}'

Outputs:
  CloudTrailLogGroupName:
    Description: CloudTrail CloudWatch Logs log group name
    Value: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
    Export:
      Name: CloudTrailLogGroupName

  CloudTrailKMSKeyArn:
    Description: KMS key ARN for CloudTrail
    Value: !GetAtt CloudTrailKMSKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: CloudTrailKMSKeyArn

  SSMAutomationRoleArn:
    Description: IAM role ARN for SSM automations
    Value: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: SSMAutomationRoleArn

  CloudTrailCWLogsRoleArn:
    Description: IAM role ARN for CloudTrail CloudWatch Logs delivery
    Value: !GetAtt CloudTrailCWLogsRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: CloudTrailCWLogsRoleArn

  EncryptTrailAndIntegrateCWLogsName:
    Description: SSM document name
    Value: !Ref EncryptTrailAndIntegrateCWLogs
    Export:
      Name: EncryptTrailAndIntegrateCWLogsName

  EnableKMSKeyRotationName:
    Description: SSM document name
    Value: !Ref EnableKMSKeyRotation
    Export:
      Name: EnableKMSKeyRotationName

  IntegrateCloudTrailWithCWLogsName:
    Description: SSM document name
    Value: !Ref IntegrateCloudTrailWithCWLogs
    Export:
      Name: IntegrateCloudTrailWithCWLogsName

  UpdatePasswordPolicyName:
    Description: SSM document name
    Value: !Ref UpdatePasswordPolicy
    Export:
      Name: UpdatePasswordPolicyName

  EnableLogFileValidationAndMultiRegionName:
    Description: SSM document name
    Value: !Ref EnableLogFileValidationAndMultiRegion
    Export:
      Name: EnableLogFileValidationAndMultiRegionName

  RevokeDefaultSGRulesName:
    Description: SSM document name
    Value: !Ref RevokeDefaultSGRules
    Export:
      Name: RevokeDefaultSGRulesName

  DeleteSecurityGroupName:
    Description: SSM document name
    Value: !Ref DeleteSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: DeleteSecurityGroupName

  ReleaseUnusedEIPName:
    Description: SSM document name
    Value: !Ref ReleaseUnusedEIP
    Export:
      Name: ReleaseUnusedEIPName

  RemoveCodeBuildEnvVarsName:
    Description: SSM document name
    Value: !Ref RemoveCodeBuildEnvVars
    Export:
      Name: RemoveCodeBuildEnvVarsName

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CDK Bootstrap Stack - creates encrypted S3 bucket, immutable ECR repo, KMS key, SSM parameter, and IAM roles'

Parameters:
  Qualifier:
    Type: String
    Default: cdk
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9]+$'
    Description: Short qualifier for resource names
  TrustedAccounts:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: List of AWS account IDs that can assume publishing and deployment roles
  ManagedPolicyArns:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess
    Description: List of managed policy ARNs to attach to bootstrap roles
  BootstrapVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: '1'
    Description: Version of the bootstrap template

Conditions:
  HasTrustedAccounts: !Not [!Equals [!Join [',', !Ref TrustedAccounts], '']]

Resources:
  # KMS Key for S3 bucket encryption
  FileAssetsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for CDK file asset bucket encryption
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow S3 service to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  FileAssetsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/cdk-${Qualifier}-file-assets-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FileAssetsKey

  # S3 Bucket for file assets
  FileAssetsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref FileAssetsKey
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  FileAssetsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref FileAssetsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyHTTP
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:*
            Resource:
              - !Sub '${FileAssetsBucket.Arn}'
              - !Sub '${FileAssetsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': false

  # ECR Repository for container assets
  ContainerAssetsRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-container-assets'
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      EncryptionConfiguration:
        EncryptionType: AES256
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  # SSM Parameter for bootstrap version
  BootstrapVersionParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/cdk-bootstrap/${Qualifier}/version'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref BootstrapVersion
      Description: CDK bootstrap version
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  # IAM Role for file publishing
  FilePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-file-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - HasTrustedAccounts
                - !Split [',', !Join [',', [!Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root', !Join [',', !Ref TrustedAccounts]]]]
                - !Split [',', !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root']
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns: !Ref ManagedPolicyArns
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FilePublishingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                Resource: !Sub '${FileAssetsBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub '${FileAssetsBucket.Arn}'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt FileAssetsKey.Arn
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  # IAM Role for image publishing
  ImagePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-image-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - HasTrustedAccounts
                - !Split [',', !Join [',', [!Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root', !Join [',', !Ref TrustedAccounts]]]]
                - !Split [',', !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root']
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns: !Ref ManagedPolicyArns
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImagePublishingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:PutImage
                  - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
                  - ecr:UploadLayerPart
                  - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:DescribeRepositories
                  - ecr:ListImages
                Resource: !GetAtt ContainerAssetsRepository.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: '*'
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  # IAM Role for account lookup
  LookupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-lookup-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - HasTrustedAccounts
                - !Split [',', !Join [',', [!Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root', !Join [',', !Ref TrustedAccounts]]]]
                - !Split [',', !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root']
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns: !Ref ManagedPolicyArns
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LookupPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:GetUser
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                  - ec2:DescribeRegions
                  - organizations:DescribeOrganization
                Resource: '*'
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  # IAM Role for deployment actions (deploy)
  DeployRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-deploy-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - HasTrustedAccounts
                - !Split [',', !Join [',', [!Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root', !Join [',', !Ref TrustedAccounts]]]]
                - !Split [',', !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root']
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns: !Ref ManagedPolicyArns
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DeployPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:CreateChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:ExecuteChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                  - cloudformation:DeleteStack
                  - cloudformation:DeleteChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:ListStacks
                  - cloudformation:TagResource
                  - cloudformation:UntagResource
                  - cloudformation:CreateStack
                  - cloudformation:UpdateStack
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource: !Sub '${FileAssetsBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:DescribeRepositories
                  - ecr:ListImages
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt FileAssetsKey.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt CfnExecutionRole.Arn
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  # IAM Role for CloudFormation execution
  CfnExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-cfn-exec-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns: !Ref ManagedPolicyArns
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CfnExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: '*'
                Resource: '*'
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

Outputs:
  FileAssetsBucketName:
    Description: S3 bucket for file assets
    Value: !Ref FileAssetsBucket
    Export:
      Name: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-file-assets-bucket'
  ContainerAssetsRepositoryUri:
    Description: ECR repository URI for container assets
    Value: !GetAtt ContainerAssetsRepository.RepositoryUri
    Export:
      Name: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-container-assets-repo-uri'
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: KMS key ARN for S3 encryption
    Value: !GetAtt FileAssetsKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-file-assets-key-arn'
  BootstrapVersionParamName:
    Description: SSM parameter name for bootstrap version
    Value: !Ref BootstrapVersionParam
    Export:
      Name: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-bootstrap-version-param'
  FilePublishingRoleArn:
    Description: IAM role ARN for file publishing
    Value: !GetAtt FilePublishingRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-file-publishing-role-arn'
  ImagePublishingRoleArn:
    Description: IAM role ARN for image publishing
    Value: !GetAtt ImagePublishingRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-image-publishing-role-arn'
  LookupRoleArn:
    Description: IAM role ARN for account lookup
    Value: !GetAtt LookupRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-lookup-role-arn'
  DeployRoleArn:
    Description: IAM role ARN for deployment actions
    Value: !GetAtt DeployRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-deploy-role-arn'
  CfnExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: IAM role ARN for CloudFormation execution
    Value: !GetAtt CfnExecutionRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-cfn-exec-role-arn'
