AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  CloudFormation template for Elastic Beanstalk with Blue-Green deployment support.
  Supports creating a new application and environment, or referencing existing ones.
  Green environment can be created temporarily for traffic routing and then deleted.
  The latest available Node.js 20 on Amazon Linux 2023 solution stack is dynamically
  fetched using a Lambda-backed custom resource.

Parameters:
  CreateNewApplication:
    Description: Whether to create a new Elastic Beanstalk application.
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "true"

  CreateGreenEnvironment:
    Description: Whether to create a temporary green environment for Blue-Green deployment.
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "false"

  ApplicationName:
    Description: The name of the Elastic Beanstalk application. Leave empty to auto-generate from stack name when creating a new application.
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,98}[a-z0-9]$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens, starting and ending with alphanumeric.

  ExistingApplicationName:
    Description: Name of an existing Elastic Beanstalk application. Required if CreateNewApplication is false.
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,98}[a-z0-9]$"
    ConstraintDescription: If provided, must be lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens.

  ExistingBlueEnvironmentName:
    Description: Name of an existing blue environment. Required if CreateNewApplication is false.
    Type: String
    Default: "existing-blue-env"
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,98}[a-z0-9]$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens.

  ExistingBlueEnvironmentEndpointURL:
    Description: Endpoint URL of the existing blue environment. Required if CreateNewApplication is false.
    Type: String
    Default: ""

  S3BucketOverride:
    Description: Override S3 bucket for the sample application source bundle. Leave empty to use the default elasticbeanstalk-samples-<region> bucket.
    Type: String
    Default: ""

  S3Key:
    Description: S3 key for the sample application source bundle.
    Type: String
    Default: nodejs-sample.zip

Conditions:
  CreateNewApp:
    !Equals [!Ref CreateNewApplication, "true"]
  CreateGreenEnv:
    !Equals [!Ref CreateGreenEnvironment, "true"]
  NoCustomBucket:
    !Equals [!Ref S3BucketOverride, ""]
  IsAppNameProvided:
    !Not [!Equals [!Ref ApplicationName, ""]]
  IsExistingAppProvided:
    !Not [!Equals [!Ref ExistingApplicationName, ""]]

Resources:
  # -------------------------------------------------- IAM Roles --------------------------------------------------
  ServiceRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: elasticbeanstalk.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSElasticBeanstalkService
      Path: "/"

  InstanceProfileRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSElasticBeanstalkWebTier
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSElasticBeanstalkMulticontainerDocker
      Path: "/"

  InstanceProfile:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile"
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref InstanceProfileRole
      Path: "/"

  # -------------------------------------------------- Lambda Custom Resource for Solution Stack --------------------
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ElasticBeanstalkListStacks
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticbeanstalk:ListAvailableSolutionStacks
                Resource: "*"

  LatestStackLambda:
    Type: "AWS::Lambda::Function"
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.14
      Timeout: 30
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] in ('Create', 'Update'):
                      client = boto3.client('elasticbeanstalk')
                      response = client.list_available_solution_stacks()
                      stacks = response['SolutionStacks']
                      
                      # Try multiple filter patterns for Node.js 20 on Amazon Linux
                      candidates = []
                      for s in stacks:
                          # Accept both "Amazon Linux 2023" and "Amazon Linux 2"
                          if ('Node.js 20' in s) and ('Amazon Linux 2023' in s or 'Amazon Linux 2' in s):
                              candidates.append(s)
                      
                      if not candidates:
                          # Fallback to a known working Node.js 18 stack
                          for s in stacks:
                              if ('Node.js 18' in s) and ('Amazon Linux 2' in s or 'Amazon Linux 2023' in s):
                                  candidates.append(s)
                      
                      if not candidates:
                          # Final fallback: take any Node.js stack
                          for s in stacks:
                              if 'Node.js' in s and 'Amazon Linux' in s:
                                  candidates.append(s)
                      
                      if not candidates:
                          raise Exception("No suitable Elastic Beanstalk solution stack found")
                      
                      candidates.sort(reverse=True)
                      latest = candidates[0]
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS,
                          {'SolutionStackName': latest},
                          physicalResourceId=latest)
                  else:
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
              except Exception as e:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED,
                      {'Error': str(e)})

  LatestSolutionStack:
    Type: "Custom::LatestSolutionStack"
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt LatestStackLambda.Arn
      Region: !Ref "AWS::Region"

  VPC:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::VPC"
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: "10.0.0.0/16"

      Tags:

          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::InternetGateway"
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-igw"

  AttachGateway:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Subnet"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "10.0.1.0/24"
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet1"

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Subnet"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "10.0.2.0/24"
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet2"

  RouteTable:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::RouteTable"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-route-table"

  RouteToIGW:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Route"
    DependsOn: AttachGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteAssociation1:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation"
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  SubnetRouteAssociation2:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation"
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  EnvironmentSecurityGroup:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup"
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Elastic Beanstalk environment
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: "0.0.0.0/0"
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: "0.0.0.0/0"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-env-sg"

  # -------------------------------------------------- Elastic Beanstalk Application (Conditional) --------------------
  Application:
    Condition: CreateNewApp
    Type: "AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Application"
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !If
        - IsAppNameProvided
        - !Ref ApplicationName
        - !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-app"
      Description: Elastic Beanstalk application for Blue-Green deployments

  # -------------------------------------------------- Application Version (always) ---------------------------------
  ApplicationVersion:
    Type: "AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::ApplicationVersion"
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !If
        - CreateNewApp
        - !Ref Application
        - !If
          - IsExistingAppProvided
          - !Ref ExistingApplicationName
          - !Ref ApplicationName
      SourceBundle:
        S3Bucket: !If
          - NoCustomBucket
          - !Sub "elasticbeanstalk-samples-${AWS::Region}"
          - !Ref S3BucketOverride
        S3Key: !Ref S3Key

  # -------------------------------------------------- Blue Environment (conditional) -------------------------------

    Condition: CreateNewApp
    Type: "AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Environment"
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref Application
      EnvironmentName: !Join ["-", [!Ref Application, "blue"]]
      CNAMEPrefix: !Join ["-", [!Ref Application, "blue"]]
      SolutionStackName: !GetAtt LatestSolutionStack.SolutionStackName
      VersionLabel: !Ref ApplicationVersion
      OptionSettings:
        - Namespace: "aws:ec2:vpc"
          OptionName: VPCId
          Value: !Ref VPC
        - Namespace: "aws:ec2:vpc"
          OptionName: Subnets
          Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2]]
        - Namespace: "aws:ec2:vpc"
          OptionName: ELBSubnets

        - Namespace: "aws:ec2:vpc"
          OptionName: ELBScheme
          Value: "public"
        - Namespace: "aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration"
          OptionName: InstanceType
          Value: t3.micro
        - Namespace: "aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration"
          OptionName: IamInstanceProfile
          Value: !Ref InstanceProfile
        - Namespace: "aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration"
          OptionName: SecurityGroups
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentSecurityGroup
        - Namespace: "aws:autoscaling:asg"
          OptionName: MinSize

        - Namespace: "aws:autoscaling:asg"
          OptionName: MaxSize
          Value: "2"

  # -------------------------------------------------- Green Environment (conditional) ------------------------------

      EnvironmentName: !Join

        - [!If [CreateNewApp, !Ref Application, !Ref ExistingApplicationName], "green"]
      CNAMEPrefix: !Join
        - "-"
        - [!If [CreateNewApp, !Ref Application, !Ref ExistingApplicationName], "green"]
      SolutionStackName: !GetAtt LatestSolutionStack.SolutionStackName
      VersionLabel: !Ref ApplicationVersion
      OptionSettings:
        - Namespace: "aws:ec2:vpc"
          OptionName: VPCId
          Value: !Ref VPC
        - Namespace: "aws:ec2:vpc"
          OptionName: Subnets
          Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2]]
        - Namespace: "aws:ec2:vpc"
          OptionName: ELBSubnets
          Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2]]
        - Namespace: "aws:ec2:vpc"
          OptionName: ELBScheme
          Value: "public"
        - Namespace: "aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration"
          OptionName: InstanceType
          Value: t3.micro
        - Namespace: "aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration"
          OptionName: IamInstanceProfile
          Value: !Ref InstanceProfile
        - Namespace: "aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration"
          OptionName: SecurityGroups
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentSecurityGroup
        - Namespace: "aws:autoscaling:asg"
          OptionName: MinSize
          Value: "1"
        - Namespace: "aws:autoscaling:asg"
          OptionName: MaxSize
          Value: "2"
        - Namespace: "aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment"
          OptionName: ServiceRole
          Value: !Ref ServiceRole
        - Namespace: "aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment:process:default"
          OptionName: HealthCheckPath

        - Namespace: "aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment:process:default"
          OptionName: HealthCheckURL
          Value: "/"

        - !Ref ApplicationName

    Description: The name of the blue environment.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Self-contained Service Catalog environment for ML workshop"

Parameters:
  EnvironmentPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: "user-1"

Resources:
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # S3 Bucket for product templates
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  TemplateBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: false
        BlockPublicPolicy: false
        IgnorePublicAcls: false
        RestrictPublicBuckets: false

  TemplateBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref TemplateBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: "*"
            Action: s3:GetObject
            Resource: !Sub "${TemplateBucket.Arn}/*"

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda execution role for uploading template objects
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: "/servicecatalog/"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3PutGetObjects
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub "${TemplateBucket.Arn}/*"

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda function to upload template objects
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  TemplateUploadFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: nodejs24.x
      Timeout: 120
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          const https = require('https');
          const AWS = require('aws-sdk');

          exports.handler = async (event, context) => {
            if (event.RequestType === 'Delete') {
              await sendResponse(event, context.logStreamName, 'SUCCESS');
              return;
            }
            try {
              const s3 = new AWS.S3();
              const bucket = event.ResourceProperties.BucketName;
              const objects = event.ResourceProperties.Objects;
              for (const obj of objects) {
                await s3.putObject({Bucket: bucket, Key: obj.Key, Body: obj.Body}).promise();
              }
              await sendResponse(event, context.logStreamName, 'SUCCESS');
            } catch (err) {
              console.error(err);
              await sendResponse(event, context.logStreamName, 'FAILED');
            }
          };

          function sendResponse(event, physicalResourceId, responseStatus) {
            return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
              const parsedUrl = new URL(event.ResponseURL);
              const body = JSON.stringify({
                Status: responseStatus,
                Reason: 'See CloudWatch logs',
                PhysicalResourceId: physicalResourceId,
                StackId: event.StackId,
                RequestId: event.RequestId,
                LogicalResourceId: event.LogicalResourceId,
                NoEcho: false,
                Data: {}
              });
              const options = {
                hostname: parsedUrl.hostname,
                port: 443,
                path: parsedUrl.pathname + parsedUrl.search,
                method: 'PUT',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Content-Length': body.length }
              };
              const req = https.request(options, (res) => {
                resolve(res.statusCode === 200);
              });
              req.on('error', (err) => reject(err));
              req.write(body);
              req.end();
            });
          }
      Description: "Uploads template objects to S3 bucket"

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Custom resource to trigger upload of all template objects
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  S3BucketObjects:
    Type: Custom::S3ObjectUploader
    DependsOn:
      - TemplateBucketPolicy
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt TemplateUploadFunction.Arn
      BucketName: !Ref TemplateBucket
      Objects:

            Description: "Placeholder VPC product"
            Resources:

                Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
                Properties:
                  Type: String
                  Value: "vpc-placeholder"
        - Key: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-iam-kms-s3-product.template"

            AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
            Description: "Placeholder IAM KMS S3 product"
            Resources:
              Placeholder:
                Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
                Properties:
                  Type: String
                  Value: "iam-kms-s3-placeholder"
        - Key: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-dataexchange-product.template"
          Body: |
            AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
            Description: "Placeholder Data Exchange product"
            Resources:
              Placeholder:
                Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
                Properties:
                  Type: String
                  Value: "dataexchange-placeholder"
        - Key: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-infrastructure-product.template"
          Body: |
            AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
            Description: "Placeholder infrastructure product"
            Resources:
              Placeholder:
                Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
                Properties:
                  Type: String
                  Value: "infrastructure-placeholder"
        - Key: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-application-product.template"
          Body: |
            AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
            Description: "Placeholder application product"
            Resources:
              Placeholder:
                Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
                Properties:
                  Type: String
                  Value: "application-placeholder"
        - Key: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-sagemaker-product.template"
          Body: |
            AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
            Description: "Placeholder SageMaker product"
            Resources:
              Placeholder:
                Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
                Properties:
                  Type: String
                  Value: "sagemaker-placeholder"
        - Key: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-thirdparty-ml-product.template"
          Body: |
            AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
            Description: "Placeholder third-party ML product"
            Resources:
              Placeholder:
                Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
                Properties:
                  Type: String
                  Value: "thirdparty-ml-placeholder"

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Portfolios
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::Portfolio
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-admin-portfolio"
      Description: "Admin team portfolio for ML workshop"
      ProviderName: "Admin Team"

  EndUserPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::Portfolio
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-enduser-portfolio"
      Description: "End user portfolio for ML workshop"
      ProviderName: "End User Team"

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Products (7) – using CloudFormationProduct with LoadTemplateFromURL to self‑controlled S3

        - Name: "v1"
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub "https://${TemplateBucket}.s3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${EnvironmentPrefix}-dataexchange-product.template"

    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-infrastructure-product"
      Description: "Infrastructure product"

      ProductType: "CLOUD_FORMATION_TEMPLATE"
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: "v1"
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub "https://${TemplateBucket}.s3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${EnvironmentPrefix}-infrastructure-product.template"
      SupportDescription: "Admin support"

  ApplicationProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    DependsOn: S3BucketObjects
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-application-product"
      Description: "Application product"
      Owner: "End User Team"
      ProductType: "CLOUD_FORMATION_TEMPLATE"
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'VPC with dual-stack IPv4/IPv6, public/private subnets, NAT, placement group, DHCP options, and network ACLs'

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - staging
      - production
    Default: staging
    Description: Environment type (staging or production)

  DeployNATGateway:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'
    Description: Deploy NAT Gateway for private subnets

  BastionVPNPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1194
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 65535
    Description: Bastion VPN port for allow rule in public network ACL

Mappings:
  EnvironmentCIDRMap:
    staging:
      VpcCIDR: 10.0.0.0/16
      PublicSubnet1CIDR: 10.0.1.0/24
      PublicSubnet2CIDR: 10.0.2.0/24
      PublicSubnet3CIDR: 10.0.3.0/24
      PrivateSubnet1CIDR: 10.0.4.0/24
      PrivateSubnet2CIDR: 10.0.5.0/24
      DomainName: staging.example.com
    production:
      VpcCIDR: 10.1.0.0/16
      PublicSubnet1CIDR: 10.1.1.0/24
      PublicSubnet2CIDR: 10.1.2.0/24
      PublicSubnet3CIDR: 10.1.3.0/24
      PrivateSubnet1CIDR: 10.1.4.0/24
      PrivateSubnet2CIDR: 10.1.5.0/24
      DomainName: production.example.com

Conditions:
  DeployNATGatewayCondition: !Equals [!Ref DeployNATGateway, 'true']

Resources:
  # VPC
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentCIDRMap, !Ref Environment, VpcCIDR]
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-vpc'

  # Amazon‑provided IPv6 CIDR block for the VPC
  VPCCidrBlock:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCCidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AmazonProvidedIpv6CidrBlock: true

  # DHCP Options
  DHCPOptions:
    Type: AWS::EC2::DHCPOptions
    Properties:
      DomainName: !FindInMap [EnvironmentCIDRMap, !Ref Environment, DomainName]
      DomainNameServers:
        - AmazonProvidedDNS
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-dhcp-options'

  VPCDHCPOptionsAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCDHCPOptionsAssociation
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      DhcpOptionsId: !Ref DHCPOptions

  # Internet Gateway
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Egress‑Only Internet Gateway
  EgressOnlyInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EgressOnlyInternetGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-eigw'

  # Public Subnets
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCCidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentCIDRMap, !Ref Environment, PublicSubnet1CIDR]
      Ipv6CidrBlock:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::Cidr:
              - !Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks]
              - 5
              - 64
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-public-subnet-1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCCidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentCIDRMap, !Ref Environment, PublicSubnet2CIDR]
      Ipv6CidrBlock:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::Cidr:
              - !Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks]
              - 5
              - 64
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-public-subnet-2'

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCCidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentCIDRMap, !Ref Environment, PublicSubnet3CIDR]
      Ipv6CidrBlock:
        Fn::Select:
          - 2
          - Fn::Cidr:
              - !Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks]
              - 5
              - 64
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-public-subnet-3'

  # Private Subnets
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCCidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentCIDRMap, !Ref Environment, PrivateSubnet1CIDR]
      Ipv6CidrBlock:
        Fn::Select:
          - 3
          - Fn::Cidr:
              - !Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks]
              - 5
              - 64
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-private-subnet-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCCidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentCIDRMap, !Ref Environment, PrivateSubnet2CIDR]
      Ipv6CidrBlock:
        Fn::Select:
          - 4
          - Fn::Cidr:
              - !Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks]
              - 5
              - 64
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-private-subnet-2'

  # Public Route Table
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-public-rt'

  PublicRouteIPv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteIPv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: ::/0
      EgressOnlyInternetGatewayId: !Ref EgressOnlyInternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # Private Route Table
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-private-rt'

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # NAT Gateway (conditional)
  NATGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: DeployNATGatewayCondition
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NATGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: DeployNATGatewayCondition
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NATGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-nat-gateway'

  PrivateRouteToNATGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: DeployNATGatewayCondition
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway

  # Placement Group
  PlacementGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::PlacementGroup
    Properties:
      Strategy: cluster
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-placement-group'

  # Public Network ACL
  PublicNetworkAcl:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-public-acl'

  # Public ACL Inbound Rules (both IPv4 and IPv6 for each port)
  PublicInboundHTTPv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 80
        To: 80

  PublicInboundHTTPv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 101
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      Ipv6CidrBlock: ::/0
      PortRange:
        From: 80
        To: 80

  PublicInboundHTTPSv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 110
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 443
        To: 443

  PublicInboundHTTPSv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 111
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      Ipv6CidrBlock: ::/0
      PortRange:
        From: 443
        To: 443

  PublicInboundSSHv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 120
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 22
        To: 22

  PublicInboundSSHv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 121
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      Ipv6CidrBlock: ::/0
      PortRange:
        From: 22
        To: 22

  PublicInboundVPNv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 130
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: !Ref BastionVPNPort
        To: !Ref BastionVPNPort

  PublicInboundVPNv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 131
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      Ipv6CidrBlock: ::/0
      PortRange:
        From: !Ref BastionVPNPort
        To: !Ref BastionVPNPort

  PublicInboundEphemeralv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 140
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 1024
        To: 65535

  PublicInboundEphemeralv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 141
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      Ipv6CidrBlock: ::/0
      PortRange:
        From: 1024
        To: 65535

  # Public ACL Outbound Rules (open all traffic)
  PublicOutboundAllv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: -1
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0

  PublicOutboundAllv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 101
      Protocol: -1
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      Ipv6CidrBlock: ::/0

  # Public ACL Subnet Associations
  PublicSubnetAclAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl

  PublicSubnetAclAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl

  PublicSubnetAclAssociation3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl

  # Private Network ACL
  PrivateNetworkAcl:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-private-acl'

  # Private ACL Inbound All
  PrivateInboundAllv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: -1
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0

  PrivateInboundAllv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 101
      Protocol: -1
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      Ipv6CidrBlock: ::/0

  # Private ACL Outbound All
  PrivateOutboundAllv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: -1
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0

  PrivateOutboundAllv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 101
      Protocol: -1
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      Ipv6CidrBlock: ::/0

  # Private ACL Subnet Associations
  PrivateSubnetAclAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl

  PrivateSubnetAclAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'

  VpcCidr:
    Description: VPC CIDR block
    Value: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcCidr'

  PublicSubnet1:
    Description: Public Subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Description: Public Subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2'

  PublicSubnet3:
    Description: Public Subnet 3 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet3'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Description: Private Subnet 1 ID

      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1'

  PrivateSubnet2:

      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2'

  PrivateRouteTableId:
    Description: Private Route Table ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRouteTableId'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Parameters:
  EnvironmentParameter:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
Resources:
  MoviesDynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: title
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: title
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt MoviesDynamoDBTable.Arn
  CreateMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/CreateMovieFunction
      RetentionInDays: 1
  ReadMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/ReadMovieFunction
      RetentionInDays: 1
  UpdateMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/UpdateMovieFunction
      RetentionInDays: 1
  DeleteMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/DeleteMovieFunction
      RetentionInDays: 1
  CreateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: CreateMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: CreateMovieFunction
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesDynamoDBTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, boto3, os
          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])
          def handler(event, context):
              body = json.loads(event['body'])
              table.put_item(Item=body)
              return {'statusCode': 201, 'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'}, 'body': json.dumps(body)}
  ReadMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: ReadMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: ReadMovieFunction
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesDynamoDBTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, boto3, os
          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])
          def handler(event, context):
              title = event['pathParameters']['title']
              response = table.get_item(Key={'title': title})
              item = response.get('Item')
              if not item:
                  return {'statusCode': 404, 'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'}, 'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Not found'})}
              return {'statusCode': 200, 'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'}, 'body': json.dumps(item)}
  UpdateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: UpdateMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: UpdateMovieFunction
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesDynamoDBTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, boto3, os
          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])
          def handler(event, context):
              body = json.loads(event['body'])
              title = body['title']
              update_expression = "SET "
              expression_attribute_values = {}
              for key, value in body.items():
                  if key != 'title':
                      update_expression += f"{key} = :{key}, "
                      expression_attribute_values[f":{key}"] = value
              update_expression = update_expression.rstrip(', ')
              if update_expression == "SET ":
                  return {'statusCode': 400, 'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'}, 'body': json.dumps({'error': 'No attributes to update'})}
              table.update_item(Key={'title': title}, UpdateExpression=update_expression, ExpressionAttributeValues=expression_attribute_values)
              return {'statusCode': 200, 'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'}, 'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Updated'})}
  DeleteMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: DeleteMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: DeleteMovieFunction
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesDynamoDBTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, boto3, os
          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])
          def handler(event, context):
              body = json.loads(event['body'])
              title = body['title']
              table.delete_item(Key={'title': title})
              return {'statusCode': 200, 'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'}, 'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Deleted'})}
  MoviesApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: Movies API
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL
  MoviesResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt MoviesApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: Movies

      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY

  PutMethod:

      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${UpdateMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations"
  DeleteMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: DELETE
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${DeleteMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations"
  OptionsMethodMovies:

            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true

    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:

      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${ReadMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template to provision SageMaker Studio user profile for MLOps engineer persona with self-contained VPC or existing domain support.

Parameters:
  DomainId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional ID of an existing SageMaker Studio domain. If not provided, a new domain with self-contained VPC will be created.
  SubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional list of subnet IDs associated with the existing domain (ignored when DomainId is not provided).
  SecurityGroupIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional list of security group IDs associated with the existing domain (ignored when DomainId is not provided).
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: mlops-studio-domain
    Description: Name for the SageMaker Studio domain when created internally.
  UserProfileName:
    Type: String
    Default: mlops-engineer
    Description: Name for the SageMaker Studio user profile.

Conditions:
  HasDomainId: !Not [!Equals [!Ref DomainId, '']]
  CreateDomain: !Equals [!Ref DomainId, '']

Resources:
  # VPC resources – created only when DomainId is not provided
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-studio-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  Subnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-subnet1'

  Subnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-subnet2'

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-rtb'

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateDomain
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  Subnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  Subnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  # SageMaker Studio Domain – created only when DomainId not provided
  SageMakerDomain:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::Domain
    Condition: CreateDomain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      DomainName: !Ref DomainName
      AuthMode: IAM
      AppNetworkAccessType: PublicInternetOnly
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet1
        - !Ref Subnet2
      DefaultUserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ExecutionRole.Arn

  # IAM Execution Role for MLOps engineer persona
  ExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-execution-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PassRolePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${AWS::StackName}-execution-role'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
        - PolicyName: SageMakerPipelinesPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreatePipeline
                  - sagemaker:StartPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:StopPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:RetryPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:UpdatePipeline
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelineExecutions
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelines
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipeline
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: ModelMonitoringPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:StopMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:DescribeMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:ListMonitoringSchedules
                  - sagemaker:CreateProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListProcessingJobs
                  - sagemaker:StopProcessingJob
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: ModelManagementPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateModel
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackageGroups
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModel
                  - sagemaker:ListModels
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: ExperimentsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:ListExperiments
                  - sagemaker:DescribeExperiment
                  - sagemaker:ListTrials
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrial
                  - sagemaker:ListLineageGroups
                  - sagemaker:DescribeLineageGroup
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: TrainingJobsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:CreateTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:CreateProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:CreateHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:ListTrainingJobs
                  - sagemaker:ListTransformJobs
                  - sagemaker:ListHyperParameterTuningJobs
                  - sagemaker:StopTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:StopTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:StopHyperParameterTuningJob
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: EndpointsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:UpdateEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:DeleteEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:ListEndpoints
                  - sagemaker:InvokeEndpoint
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: StudioAppsSpacesPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateApp
                  - sagemaker:DeleteApp
                  - sagemaker:DescribeApp
                  - sagemaker:ListApps
                  - sagemaker:CreateSpace
                  - sagemaker:DeleteSpace
                  - sagemaker:DescribeSpace
                  - sagemaker:ListSpaces
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  ForAllValues:StringEquals:
                    sagemaker:UserProfileName: !Ref UserProfileName

  # SageMaker Studio User Profile
  UserProfile:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::UserProfile
    Properties:
      DomainId: !If [HasDomainId, !Ref DomainId, !Ref SageMakerDomain]
      UserProfileName: !Ref UserProfileName
      UserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ExecutionRole.Arn

Outputs:
  UserProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the created SageMaker Studio user profile
    Value: !GetAtt UserProfile.UserProfileArn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained AppSync GraphQL API with DynamoDB, JS resolvers, subscriptions
Parameters: {}
Resources:
  TodoTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: owner
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: OwnerIndex
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: owner
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
          ProvisionedThroughput:
            ReadCapacityUnits: 5
            WriteCapacityUnits: 5
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 5
        WriteCapacityUnits: 5
  GraphQLApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: TodoAPIwithJs
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY
  ApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Description: Default API key for TodoAPIwithJs
  GraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Definition: |-
        type Todo {
          id: ID!
          owner: String!
          title: String!
          description: String
          createdAt: AWSDateTime!
          updatedAt: AWSDateTime!
        }
        input CreateTodoInput {
          id: ID
          owner: String!
          title: String!
          description: String
        }
        input UpdateTodoInput {
          id: ID!
          owner: String
          title: String
          description: String
        }
        input DeleteTodoInput {
          id: ID!
        }
        type Query {
          getTodo(id: ID!): Todo
          listTodos(limit: Int, nextToken: String): TodoConnection
          queryTodosByOwner(owner: String!, limit: Int, nextToken: String): TodoConnection
        }
        type Mutation {
          createTodo(input: CreateTodoInput!): Todo
          updateTodo(input: UpdateTodoInput!): Todo
          deleteTodo(input: DeleteTodoInput!): Todo
        }
        type Subscription {
          onCreateTodo: Todo @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["createTodo"])
          onUpdateTodo: Todo @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["updateTodo"])
          onDeleteTodo: Todo @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["deleteTodo"])
        }
        type TodoConnection {
          items: [Todo]
          nextToken: String
        }
        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
          subscription: Subscription
        }
  AppSyncRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncDynamoDBPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt TodoTable.Arn
                  - !Sub "${TodoTable.Arn}/index/*"
  DynamoDBDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: DynamoDBDataSource
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref TodoTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncRole.Arn
  NoneDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: NoneDataSource
      Type: NONE
  CreateTodoFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      Name: CreateTodoFunction
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      Code: |-
        export function request(ctx) {
          const { input } = ctx.arguments;
          const item = {
            id: input.id || util.autoId(),
            owner: input.owner,
            title: input.title,
            description: input.description,
            createdAt: util.time.nowISO8601(),
            updatedAt: util.time.nowISO8601()
          };
          return {
            operation: 'PutItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id: item.id }),
            attributeValues: util.dynamodb.toMapValues(item)
          };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }
  UpdateTodoFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      Name: UpdateTodoFunction
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      Code: |-
        export function request(ctx) {
          const { input } = ctx.arguments;
          const updates = {};
          if (input.title !== undefined) updates.title = input.title;
          if (input.description !== undefined) updates.description = input.description;
          if (input.owner !== undefined) updates.owner = input.owner;
          updates.updatedAt = util.time.nowISO8601();
          const updateExpression = 'SET ' + Object.keys(updates).map(k => `#${k} = :${k}`).join(', ');
          const expressionNames = Object.keys(updates).reduce((acc, k) => { acc[`#${k}`] = k; return acc; }, {});
          const expressionValues = util.dynamodb.toMapValues(updates);
          return {
            operation: 'UpdateItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id: input.id }),
            update: {
              expression: updateExpression,
              expressionNames: expressionNames,
              expressionValues: expressionValues
            }
          };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }
  DeleteTodoFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      Name: DeleteTodoFunction
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      Code: |-
        export function request(ctx) {
          return {
            operation: 'DeleteItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id: ctx.arguments.input.id })
          };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }
  GetTodoFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      Name: GetTodoFunction
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      Code: |-
        export function request(ctx) {
          return {
            operation: 'GetItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id: ctx.arguments.id })
          };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }
  ListTodosFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      Name: ListTodosFunction
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      Code: |-
        export function request(ctx) {
          const limit = ctx.arguments.limit || 10;
          const nextToken = ctx.arguments.nextToken || null;
          return {
            operation: 'Scan',
            limit: limit,
            nextToken: nextToken
          };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }
  QueryByOwnerFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      Name: QueryByOwnerFunction
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      Code: |-
        export function request(ctx) {
          const owner = ctx.arguments.owner;
          const limit = ctx.arguments.limit || 10;
          const nextToken = ctx.arguments.nextToken || null;
          return {
            operation: 'Query',
            index: 'OwnerIndex',
            query: {
              expression: '#owner = :owner',
              expressionNames: { '#owner': 'owner' },
              expressionValues: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ ':owner': owner })
            },
            limit: limit,
            nextToken: nextToken
          };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }
  PassThroughFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt NoneDataSource.Name
      Name: PassThroughFunction
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      Code: |-
        export function request(ctx) {
          return ctx.arguments;
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }
  GetTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getTodo
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:

      RequestMappingTemplate: '{"version": "2018-05-29", "payload": $util.toJson($ctx.arguments)}'

      ResponseMappingTemplate: '$util.toJson($ctx.result)'
  QueryByOwnerResolver:

  CreateTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId

  UpdateTodoResolver:

      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId

      FieldName: updateTodo
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt UpdateTodoFunction.FunctionId
      RequestMappingTemplate: '{"version": "2018-05-29", "payload": $util.toJson($ctx.arguments)}'

      RequestMappingTemplate: '{"version": "2018-05-29", "payload": $util.toJson($ctx.arguments)}'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'IAM roles for Data Master data pipeline (ingestion to analytics)'

Parameters:
  KMSKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of existing KMS key used for raw data encryption
    Default: ""
    ConstraintDescription: If not provided, KMS decrypt permissions will be omitted from the relevant roles.
  TargetAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: Target AWS Account ID for DMS VPC role assume role restriction
    Default: ""
    ConstraintDescription: If not provided, the DMS VPC role will not restrict the source account condition.

Conditions:
  UseKMSKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref KMSKeyArn, ""]]
  UseTargetAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TargetAccountId, ""]]

Resources:

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. DMS to Kinesis Role
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DmsToKinesisRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dms.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DmsToKinesisPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesis:PutRecord
                  - kinesis:PutRecords
                  - kinesis:DescribeStream
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. EventBridge Pipes to Firehose Role
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EventBridgePipesToFirehoseRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: pipes.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EventBridgePipesToFirehosePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. Lambda Processing Controller Role
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaProcessingControllerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaProcessingControllerPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"
              - !If
                - UseKMSKey
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action: kms:Decrypt
                  Resource: !Ref KMSKeyArn
                - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4. Lambda Routing Role
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaRoutingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaRoutingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 5. Glue Crawler Role
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GlueCrawlerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: GlueCrawlerS3Policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 6. Glue ETL Role
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GlueETLRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: GlueETLS3Policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 7. Lake Formation Data Lake Access Role
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LakeFormationDataLakeAccessRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lakeformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LakeFormationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: lakeformation:*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 8. Step Functions Orchestration Role
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StepFunctionsOrchestrationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StepFunctionsOrchestrationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                  - glue:StartJobRun
                  - glue:GetJobRun
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 9. ECS Fargate Task Role (Worker)
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EcsFargateTaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EcsFargateTaskPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"
              - !If
                - UseKMSKey
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action: kms:Decrypt
                  Resource: !Ref KMSKeyArn
                - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 10. EMR Serverless Job Role
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EmrServerlessJobRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: emr-serverless.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EmrServerlessJobPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:*
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 11. AWS Managed Grafana Monitoring Role
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GrafanaMonitoringRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: grafana.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: GrafanaMonitoringPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
                  - ec2:Describe*
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:StartQuery
                  - logs:GetQueryResults
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 12. Firehose Access Role
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FirehoseAccessRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: firehose.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FirehoseAccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource: "*"
              - !If
                - UseKMSKey
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action: kms:Decrypt
                  Resource: !Ref KMSKeyArn
                - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 13. DMS VPC Role (with source account restriction)
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DmsVpcRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dms.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition: !If
              - UseTargetAccount
              - StringEquals:
                  aws:SourceAccount: !Ref TargetAccountId
              - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DmsVpcPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs – ARNs exported with naming convention: dm-<role-name>-role-arn
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Outputs:
  DmsToKinesisRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of DMS to Kinesis role
    Value: !GetAtt DmsToKinesisRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: dm-dms-to-kinesis-role-arn

  EventBridgePipesToFirehoseRoleArn:

    Export:

  GlueCrawlerRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of Glue crawler role
