AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "IAM identities and permissions for Cluster API Provider for AWS (CAPA)"

Parameters:
  Prefix:
    Type: String
    Default: "CAPA"
    Description: "Prefix for all IAM resource names"
  ControllersOIDCProviderArn:
    Type: String
    Default: "arn:aws:iam::000000000000:oidc-provider/placeholder"
    Description: "ARN of the EKS cluster OIDC provider (set after creation)"
  ControllersOIDCID:
    Type: String
    Default: "REPLACEME"
    Description: "OIDC ID from the EKS cluster OIDC provider"
  CreateConsoleAccess:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Default: "false"
    Description: "Whether to create a console password for the bootstrapper user"
  BootstrapperUserPassword:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Default: ""
    Description: "Initial password for bootstrapper user (required only if CreateConsoleAccess is true)"

Conditions:
  ConsoleAccess: !Equals [!Ref CreateConsoleAccess, "true"]

Resources:
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Custom Managed Policy for CAPA Controllers
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  ClusterAPIControllersPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${Prefix}-ClusterAPIControllersPolicy"
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2Management
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
              - ec2:DescribeNatGateways
              - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeAddresses
              - ec2:DescribeTags
              - ec2:CreateVpc
              - ec2:CreateSubnet
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:CreateInternetGateway
              - ec2:CreateNatGateway
              - ec2:CreateRouteTable
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:AttachInternetGateway
              - ec2:DetachInternetGateway
              - ec2:AssociateRouteTable
              - ec2:DisassociateRouteTable
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:DeleteVpc
              - ec2:DeleteSubnet
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteInternetGateway
              - ec2:DeleteNatGateway
              - ec2:DeleteRouteTable
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:RunInstances
              - ec2:TerminateInstances
              - ec2:StartInstances
              - ec2:StopInstances
              - ec2:AllocateAddress
              - ec2:ReleaseAddress
              - ec2:AssociateAddress
              - ec2:DisassociateAddress
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:DeleteTags
            Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*"

          - Sid: LoadBalancing
            Effect: Allow
            Action: elasticloadbalancing:*
            Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*"

          - Sid: AutoScaling
            Effect: Allow
            Action: autoscaling:*
            Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:autoscaling:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*"

          - Sid: EKSManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Action: eks:*
            Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:eks:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*"

          - Sid: IAMRoles
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
              - iam:PassRole
              - iam:GetRole
              - iam:GetInstanceProfile
              - iam:CreateInstanceProfile
              - iam:AddRoleToInstanceProfile
              - iam:RemoveRoleFromInstanceProfile
              - iam:DeleteInstanceProfile
              - iam:ListInstanceProfiles
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${Prefix}-*"
              - !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/*"
              - !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:instance-profile/${Prefix}-*"

          - Sid: STSAssumeRoles
            Effect: Allow
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${Prefix}-*"

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Control Plane Role & Instance Profile
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${Prefix}-ControlPlaneRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2FullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ElasticLoadBalancingFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AutoScalingFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/SecretsManagerReadWrite
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
        - !Ref ClusterAPIControllersPolicy

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub "${Prefix}-ControlPlaneRole"
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Worker Node Role & Instance Profile
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  VPC infrastructure for OpenSearch cross-region resilience. Creates a VPC with
  public/private subnets across three AZs, Internet Gateway, optional NAT Gateways
  (Single or PerAZ), and VPC Flow Logs with 7-day retention.
Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    AllowedPattern: "[a-zA-Z0-9-]+"
    Description: Environment name used for tagging all resources.
  NATGatewayType:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - Single
      - PerAZ
    Default: Single
    Description: >
      Number of NAT Gateways to deploy. 'Single' creates one NAT Gateway for
      cost-effectiveness. 'PerAZ' creates one NAT Gateway per Availability Zone
      for high availability.
Conditions:
  IsSingleNAT: !Equals [!Ref NATGatewayType, "Single"]
  IsPerAZNAT: !Not [!Equals [!Ref NATGatewayType, "Single"]]
Resources:
  # VPC
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpc"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # Internet Gateway
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-igw"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Subnets
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.101.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.102.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.103.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-3"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.3.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-3"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # Elastic IPs (conditionally created)
  NATGatewaySingleEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsSingleNAT
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-single"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NATGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsPerAZNAT
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NATGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsPerAZNAT
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NATGateway3EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsPerAZNAT
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-3"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # NAT Gateways (conditionally created)
  NATGatewaySingle:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsSingleNAT
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NATGatewaySingleEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-single"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NATGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsPerAZNAT
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NATGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NATGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsPerAZNAT
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NATGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NATGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsPerAZNAT
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NATGateway3EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-3"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # Public Route Tables and Associations (conditionally created)
  PublicRouteTableSingle:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: IsSingleNAT
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-rt-single"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicRouteSingle:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsSingleNAT
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTableSingle
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetAssoc1Single:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsSingleNAT
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTableSingle

  PublicSubnetAssoc2Single:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsSingleNAT
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTableSingle

  PublicSubnetAssoc3Single:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsSingleNAT
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTableSingle

  PublicRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: IsPerAZNAT
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-rt-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsPerAZNAT
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetAssoc1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsPerAZNAT
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable1

  PublicRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: IsPerAZNAT
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-rt-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsPerAZNAT
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetAssoc2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsPerAZNAT
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable2

  PublicRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: IsPerAZNAT
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-rt-3"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsPerAZNAT
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetAssoc3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsPerAZNAT
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable3

  # Private Route Tables and Associations (conditionally created)
  PrivateRouteTableSingle:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: IsSingleNAT
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-single"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRouteSingle:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsSingleNAT
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableSingle
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGatewaySingle

  PrivateSubnetAssoc1Single:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsSingleNAT
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableSingle

  PrivateSubnetAssoc2Single:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsSingleNAT
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableSingle

  PrivateSubnetAssoc3Single:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsSingleNAT
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableSingle

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: IsPerAZNAT
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsPerAZNAT
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway1

  PrivateSubnetAssoc1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsPerAZNAT
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: IsPerAZNAT
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsPerAZNAT
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway2

  PrivateSubnetAssoc2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsPerAZNAT
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  PrivateRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: IsPerAZNAT
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-3"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsPerAZNAT
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway3

  PrivateSubnetAssoc3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsPerAZNAT
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3

  # VPC Flow Logs
  RoleVpcFlowLogs:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcFlowLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/vpc/flow-logs/${EnvironmentName}"

    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  FlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    DependsOn: RoleVpcFlowLogs
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt RoleVpcFlowLogs.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/vpc/flow-logs/${EnvironmentName}"
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL

Outputs:

    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: Public Subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
  PublicSubnet2Id:

  PrivateSubnet2Id:

    Value: !Ref NATGateway2
  NATGateway3Id:
    Condition: IsPerAZNAT
    Description: NAT Gateway 3 ID (AZ3)
    Value: !Ref NATGateway3

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Isolated VPC with VPC Endpoints for AI Customer Support Application.
  No direct internet access. Private subnets across 3 AZs.
  Interface endpoints for Bedrock, ECR, CloudWatch, RDS Data, Secrets Manager,
  SSM, KMS, X-Ray. Gateway endpoints for S3 and DynamoDB.
  VPC Flow Logs encrypted with customer-managed KMS key.
  Dedicated security groups for Agent Runtime, MCP Runtime, and Lambda functions.
Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: AICustomerSupport
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: Dev
Mappings:
  PrefixListMap:
    us-east-1:
      S3: "pl-63a5400a"
      DynamoDB: "pl-02cd2c6b"
    us-east-2:
      S3: "pl-75a5530b"
      DynamoDB: "pl-3a8e1264"
    us-west-1:
      S3: "pl-48e33f0d"
      DynamoDB: "pl-76db361b"
    us-west-2:
      S3: "pl-802abe0a"
      DynamoDB: "pl-3f8e124f"
    eu-west-1:
      S3: "pl-7796fc11"
      DynamoDB: "pl-6894f211"
    eu-central-1:
      S3: "pl-73d4b816"
      DynamoDB: "pl-8d6c0de9"
    eu-west-2:
      S3: "pl-70f4ab18"
      DynamoDB: "pl-7f6d5b11"
    ap-southeast-1:
      S3: "pl-0ef1c93c"
      DynamoDB: "pl-76a6f41c"
    ap-southeast-2:
      S3: "pl-31277900"
      DynamoDB: "pl-376c7402"
    ap-northeast-1:
      S3: "pl-51e73737"
      DynamoDB: "pl-6f6a3024"
    ap-northeast-2:
      S3: "pl-3174b653"
      DynamoDB: "pl-97a2b6f3"
    ap-south-1:
      S3: "pl-d3a745be"
      DynamoDB: "pl-4ca14d23"
    sa-east-1:
      S3: "pl-89f38cc1"
      DynamoDB: "pl-71fa501f"
    ca-central-1:
      S3: "pl-7a275f05"
      DynamoDB: "pl-026b1375"
    eu-north-1:
      S3: "pl-64b02a02"
      DynamoDB: "pl-58a4bd1e"
    eu-west-3:
      S3: "pl-19a6e12c"
      DynamoDB: "pl-3d8e1352"
    ap-northeast-3:
      S3: "pl-71a12925"
      DynamoDB: "pl-5a8b142e"
Resources:
  # VPC
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-VPC"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
  # Private Subnets in 3 AZs
  Subnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr ["10.0.0.0/16", 3, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-Subnet1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
  Subnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr ["10.0.0.0/16", 3, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-Subnet2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
  Subnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr ["10.0.0.0/16", 3, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-Subnet3"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
  # Private Route Table
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-PrivateRouteTable"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
  # Subnet-to-RouteTable associations
  SubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
  SubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
  SubnetRouteTableAssociation3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
  # Customer-managed KMS key for encryption
  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: "Customer managed key for encrypting flow logs and other resources"
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: Allow CloudWatch Logs to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - "kms:Encrypt"
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-KMSKey"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
  KMSAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${ProjectName}/flow-logs-key-${AWS::StackName}"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
  # CloudWatch Log Group for Flow Logs
  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/vpc/flow-logs/${ProjectName}-${AWS::StackName}"
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-FlowLogGroup"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
  # IAM Role for VPC Flow Logs
  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-VPCFlowLogRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: flow-logs-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-FlowLogRole"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
  # Application Security Groups (no inbound rules; egress defined later)
  AgentRuntimeSg:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Agent Runtime component
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-AgentRuntimeSg"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
  MCPRuntimeSg:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for MCP Runtime component
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-MCPRuntimeSg"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
  LambdaSg:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Lambda functions
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-LambdaSg"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
  # VPC Interface Endpoint Security Groups (one per service)
  BedrockEndpointSg:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Bedrock VPC endpoint
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref AgentRuntimeSg
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref MCPRuntimeSg
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref LambdaSg
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-BedrockEndpointSg"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
  EcrApiEndpointSg:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for ECR API VPC endpoint
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref AgentRuntimeSg
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref MCPRuntimeSg
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref LambdaSg
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-EcrApiEndpointSg"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
  EcrDkrEndpointSg:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for ECR DKR VPC endpoint
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443

        - IpProtocol: tcp

      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp

        - IpProtocol: tcp

  CloudWatchMonitoringEndpointSg:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for CloudWatch Monitoring VPC endpoint
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443

        - IpProtocol: tcp

        - IpProtocol: tcp

          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref LambdaSg
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-CloudWatchMonitoringEndpointSg"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
  RdsDataEndpointSg:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for RDS Data API VPC endpoint
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref AgentRuntimeSg
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443

          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref MCPRuntimeSg
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443

          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref LambdaSg
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-RdsDataEndpointSg"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
  SecretsManagerEndpointSg:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Secrets Manager VPC endpoint
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref AgentRuntimeSg
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref MCPRuntimeSg
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref LambdaSg
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-SecretsManagerEndpointSg"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
  SsmEndpointSg:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for SSM Parameter Store VPC endpoint
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp

        - IpProtocol: tcp

          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref MCPRuntimeSg
        - IpProtocol: tcp

          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref LambdaSg
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-SsmEndpointSg"
        - Key: Environment

  KmsEndpointSg:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for KMS VPC endpoint
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref AgentRuntimeSg
        - IpProtocol: tcp

        - IpProtocol: tcp

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "VPC with public/private subnets across three AZs, NAT Gateways, and security groups for EKS hosting."
Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/16"
  VpcName:
    Type: String
    Default: "EKS-VPC"
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.1.0/24"
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.2.0/24"
  PublicSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.3.0/24"
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.101.0/24"
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.102.0/24"
  PrivateSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.103.0/24"
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref VpcName
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-igw"
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Join ["", [!Ref VpcName, "-public-", !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]]]
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: "1"
  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Join ["", [!Ref VpcName, "-public-", !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]]]
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: "1"
  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Join ["", [!Ref VpcName, "-public-", !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]]]
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: "1"
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Join ["", [!Ref VpcName, "-private-", !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]]]
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: "1"
  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Join ["", [!Ref VpcName, "-private-", !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]]]
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: "1"
  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Join ["", [!Ref VpcName, "-private-", !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]]]
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: "1"
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-public-rt"
  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  EIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  EIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  EIP3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Join ["", [!Ref VpcName, "-nat-", !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]]]
  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Join ["", [!Ref VpcName, "-nat-", !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]]]
  NatGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP3.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Join ["", [!Ref VpcName, "-nat-", !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]]]
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Join ["", [!Ref VpcName, "-private-rt-", !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]]]
  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1
  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Join ["", [!Ref VpcName, "-private-rt-", !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]]]
  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2
  PrivateRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Join ["", [!Ref VpcName, "-private-rt-", !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]]]
  PrivateRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3
  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
  EksControlPlaneSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for EKS control plane to communicate with worker nodes
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref PrivateSubnet3Cidr
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 10250
          ToPort: 10250
          CidrIp: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 10250
          ToPort: 10250
          CidrIp: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 10250
          ToPort: 10250
          CidrIp: !Ref PrivateSubnet3Cidr
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-eks-control-plane-sg"
  AppSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group exposing application ports to the internet
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 8080
          ToPort: 8080
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 8443
          ToPort: 8443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-app-sg"
Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: "VPC ID"
    Value: !Ref VPC
  EksControlPlaneSecurityGroupId:
    Description: "Security Group ID for EKS control plane"
    Value: !Ref EksControlPlaneSecurityGroup
  AppSecurityGroupId:
    Description: "Security Group ID for application ports"
    Value: !Ref AppSecurityGroup
  AllSubnetIds:
    Description: "Comma-separated list of all public and private subnet IDs"
    Value: !Join
      - ","
      - - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
        - !Ref PublicSubnet3
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: Creates IAM execution role for SageMaker HyperPod integrated with EKS, along with prerequisite VPC, subnets, security group, and S3 buckets.

Parameters:
  ResourceNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: 'MyHyperPod'
    Description: Prefix used to name resources (e.g., "MyHyperPod").
  EksClusterName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'my-eks-cluster'
    Description: Name of the existing EKS cluster.
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  LifecycleScriptsBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'myhyperpod-lifecycle-scripts'
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket for lifecycle scripts. Must be globally unique and follow S3 bucket naming rules.
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 63
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]*[a-z0-9]$"
    ConstraintDescription: Bucket name must be between 3 and 63 characters, start and end with a lowercase letter or number, and contain only lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, and dots.
  CreateRigResources:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Default: 'false'
    Description: Flag to create RIG-related resources.
  RigInputBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Name of the RIG input S3 bucket (required if CreateRigResources is true).
  RigOutputBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Name of the RIG output S3 bucket (optional).
  EnableGatedAccess:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Default: 'false'
    Description: Flag to enable gated access policies.

Conditions:
  CreateRigResourcesCondition: !Equals [!Ref CreateRigResources, 'true']
  RigInputProvided: !Not [!Equals [!Ref RigInputBucketName, '']]
  RigOutputProvided: !Not [!Equals [!Ref RigOutputBucketName, '']]
  GatedAccessEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableGatedAccess, 'true']
  CreateRigPolicy: !And [Condition: CreateRigResourcesCondition, Condition: RigInputProvided]
  CreateGatedPolicy: !And [Condition: CreateRigResourcesCondition, Condition: GatedAccessEnabled]

Resources:
  # VPC and networking
  HyperPodVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: SageMakerHyperPodPrerequisite
          Value: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole"

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HyperPodVPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCIDR, 2, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: SageMakerHyperPodPrerequisite
          Value: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole"

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HyperPodVPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCIDR, 2, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: SageMakerHyperPodPrerequisite
          Value: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole"

  HyperPodSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for SageMaker HyperPod instances
      VpcId: !Ref HyperPodVPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: SageMakerHyperPodPrerequisite
          Value: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole"

  # Self-referencing ingress rule to allow all internal traffic
  HyperPodSGSelfIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref HyperPodSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: -1
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref HyperPodSecurityGroup

  # S3 bucket for lifecycle scripts
  LifecycleScriptsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Ref LifecycleScriptsBucketName
      Tags:
        - Key: SageMakerHyperPodPrerequisite
          Value: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole"

  # IAM role
  HyperPodExecRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerClusterInstanceRolePolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: SageMakerHyperPodPrerequisite
          Value: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole"

  # Inline policy 1: EKS CNI plugin permissions
  EksCniPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: EksCniPolicy
      Roles:
        - !Ref HyperPodExecRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AttachNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeTags
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: ec2:CreateTags
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                ec2:CreateAction: CreateNetworkInterface
            Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:network-interface/*"

  # Inline policy 2: Broader ENI management and other permissions
  EniManagementPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: EniManagementPolicy
      Roles:
        - !Ref HyperPodExecRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - ec2:DescribeDhcpOptions
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
              - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: eks-auth:AssumeRoleForPodIdentity
            Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:eks:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:cluster/${EksClusterName}"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:GetObject
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${LifecycleScriptsBucketName}"
              - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${LifecycleScriptsBucketName}/*"

  # Inline policies for each private subnet (ENI actions scoped to subnet)
  SubnetPolicy1:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}SubnetPolicy1"
      Roles:
        - !Ref HyperPodExecRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
            Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:subnet/${PrivateSubnet1}"

  SubnetPolicy2:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}SubnetPolicy2"
      Roles:
        - !Ref HyperPodExecRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
            Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:subnet/${PrivateSubnet2}"

  # Inline policy for security group (ENI actions scoped to SG)
  SecurityGroupPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}SecurityGroupPolicy"
      Roles:
        - !Ref HyperPodExecRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
            Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:security-group/${HyperPodSecurityGroup}"

  # Conditional RIG input policy
  RigInputPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: CreateRigPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: RigInputPolicy
      Roles:
        - !Ref HyperPodExecRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:GetObject
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${RigInputBucketName}"
              - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${RigInputBucketName}/*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                lambda:FunctionArn:
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*SageMaker*"
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*sagemaker*"

  # Conditional RIG output policy
  RigOutputPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: RigOutputProvided
    Properties:
      PolicyName: RigOutputPolicy
      Roles:
        - !Ref HyperPodExecRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:DeleteObject
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${RigOutputBucketName}"
              - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${RigOutputBucketName}/*"

  # Conditional gated access policy
  GatedAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: CreateGatedPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: GatedAccessPolicy
      Roles:
        - !Ref HyperPodExecRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: s3:GetObject
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                s3:DataAccessPointArn: !Sub "arn:aws:s3:*:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/*SageMaker*"
                s3:DataAccessPointBucket: "*SageMaker*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: s3:GetObject
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                s3:prefix: "*"
                s3:objecttag/Name: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sqs:ReceiveMessage
              - sqs:DeleteMessage
              - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                sqs:QueueArn:
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*SageMaker*"
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*sagemaker*"

Outputs:
  RoleName:
    Description: Name of the SageMaker HyperPod execution role
    Value: !Ref HyperPodExecRole
  RoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the SageMaker HyperPod execution role
    Value: !GetAtt HyperPodExecRole.Arn

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'VPC with three-tier subnets across three Availability Zones, NAT Gateways, and route tables'

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-VPC

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-InternetGateway

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  WebSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-WebSubnet1

  WebSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-WebSubnet2

  WebSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.3.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-WebSubnet3

  WebRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-WebRouteTable

  WebDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  WebSubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  WebSubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  WebSubnetRouteTableAssociation3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  NatEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  NatEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  NatEIP3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-NatGateway1

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-NatGateway2

  NatGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP3.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-NatGateway3

  AppSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.11.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-AppSubnet1

  AppSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.12.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-AppSubnet2

  AppSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.13.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-AppSubnet3

  DbSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.21.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DbSubnet1

  DbSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.22.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DbSubnet2

  DbSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.23.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DbSubnet3

  AppRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-AppRouteTable1

  AppRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  AppSubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable1

  AppRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-AppRouteTable2

  AppRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  AppSubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable2

  AppRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-AppRouteTable3

  AppRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3

  AppSubnetRouteTableAssociation3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable3

  DbRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DbRouteTable1

  DbRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  DbSubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable1

  DbRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DbRouteTable2

  DbRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  DbSubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable2

  DbRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DbRouteTable3

  DbRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3

  DbSubnetRouteTableAssociation3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable3

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
  AvailabilityZones:
    Description: Availability Zones used
    Value: !Join [',', [!Select [0, !GetAZs ''], !Select [1, !GetAZs ''], !Select [2, !GetAZs '']]]
  WebSubnetIds:
    Description: Web Tier Subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref WebSubnet1, !Ref WebSubnet2, !Ref WebSubnet3]]
  AppSubnetIds:
    Description: Application Tier Subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref AppSubnet1, !Ref AppSubnet2, !Ref AppSubnet3]]
  DbSubnetIds:
    Description: Database Tier Subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref DbSubnet1, !Ref DbSubnet2, !Ref DbSubnet3]]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Creates IAM roles, instance profiles, and SSM parameters required by the Amazon EKS Quick Start. All role names use the 'eks-quickstart' prefix and SSM parameters are stored under /quickstart/amazon-eks/."

Resources:

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda execution role that aggregates permissions for all EKS custom
  # resource operations (copy S3 artifacts, read-only access, create VPC
  # role, delete buckets, clean up load balancers / security groups /
  # Lambda functions, resolve caller ARNs, register custom resource types,
  # manage node security groups, create Fargate profiles, and resolve SSM
  # parameters).
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-lambda-execution-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EKSQuickStartCustomResourcePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: arn:aws:s3:::*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: arn:aws:s3:::*/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/CloudFormation-Kubernetes-VPC
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNatGateway
                  - ec2:DeleteInternetGateway
                  - ec2:DeleteSubnet
                  - ec2:DeleteVpc
                  - ec2:Describe*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
                  - elasticloadbalancing:Describe*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:DeleteFunction
                  - lambda:GetFunction
                  - lambda:ListFunctions
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                  - cloudformation:RegisterType
                  - cloudformation:DeregisterType
                  - cloudformation:DescribeType
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                  - ssm:DescribeParameters
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/quickstart/amazon-eks/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:CreateFargateProfile
                  - eks:DeleteFargateProfile
                  - eks:DescribeFargateProfile
                  - eks:ListFargateProfiles
                  - eks:CreateNodegroup
                  - eks:DeleteNodegroup
                  - eks:DescribeNodegroup
                  - eks:ListNodegroups
                  - eks:DescribeCluster
                  - eks:ListClusters
                Resource: "*"

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EKS control plane role
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  EKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-cluster-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSServicePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EKSControlPlaneExtraPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes
                  - ec2:DescribeAddresses
                  - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
                Resource: "*"

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Fargate pod execution role
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  FargateRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-fargate-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSFargatePodExecutionRolePolicy

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Managed node instance role and instance profile
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  ManagedNodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-managed-node-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemReadOnlyAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: NodeSignalPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: cloudformation:SignalResource
                Resource: "*"

  ManagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: eks-quickstart-managed-node-instance-profile
      Roles:
        - !Ref ManagedNodeRole

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Unmanaged node instance role and instance profile
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  UnmanagedNodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-unmanaged-node-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemReadOnlyAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: NodeSignalPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: cloudformation:SignalResource
                Resource: "*"

  UnmanagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: eks-quickstart-unmanaged-node-instance-profile
      Roles:
        - !Ref UnmanagedNodeRole

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Role creation role – grants a Lambda function permission to create the
  # fixed-name role CloudFormation-Kubernetes-VPC and attach only the two
  # specified AWS managed policies.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  RoleCreatorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-role-creator-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: RoleCreatorPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:CreateRole
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/CloudFormation-Kubernetes-VPC
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:AttachRolePolicy
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/CloudFormation-Kubernetes-VPC
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    "iam:PolicyARN":
                      - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaENIManagementAccess
                      - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/CloudFormation-Kubernetes-VPC
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    "iam:PassedToService": lambda.amazonaws.com

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SSM Parameters storing the ARN of each created role
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaRoleArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /quickstart/amazon-eks/lambda-role-arn
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn

  ClusterRoleArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /quickstart/amazon-eks/cluster-role-arn
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt EKSControlPlaneRole.Arn

  FargateRoleArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /quickstart/amazon-eks/fargate-role-arn
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt FargateRole.Arn

  ManagedNodeRoleArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /quickstart/amazon-eks/managed-node-role-arn
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt ManagedNodeRole.Arn

  UnmanagedNodeRoleArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /quickstart/amazon-eks/unmanaged-node-role-arn
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt UnmanagedNodeRole.Arn

  RoleCreatorRoleArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /quickstart/amazon-eks/role-creator-role-arn
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt RoleCreatorRole.Arn

Description: "Lab VPC with web and application subnets, S3 Gateway endpoint, Kinesis interface endpoints, and shared route table."

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: LabVPC

  WebSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ""
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSubnet1

  WebSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ""
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSubnet2

  AppSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.3.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ""
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppSubnet1

  AppSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.4.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ""
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppSubnet2

  SharedRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: SharedRouteTable

  WebSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  WebSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  AppSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:

              - s3:HeadObject

      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kinesis-streams"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref WebSubnet1
        - !Ref WebSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref WebSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  KinesisFirehoseEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kinesis-firehose"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref WebSubnet1
        - !Ref WebSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref WebSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

    Value: !Ref VPC

    Value: !Ref WebSubnet1

    Description: "Web Subnet 2 ID"
    Value: !Ref WebSubnet2

    Description: "App Subnet 1 ID"
    Value: !Ref AppSubnet1
  AppSubnet2Id:
    Description: "App Subnet 2 ID"
    Value: !Ref AppSubnet2
  WebSecurityGroupId:
    Description: "Web Security Group ID"
    Value: !Ref WebSecurityGroup
