AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Template to create IAM user and group for SES SMTP, with Lambda-backed custom resource to generate SMTP credentials and store them in SSM Parameter Store."

Parameters:
  IAMUserName:
    Type: String
    Default: SMTPUser
    Description: Desired IAM username (must match IAM naming pattern).
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9_+=,.@-]+$"
  RotationVersion:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    Description: Version number to force re-invocation of the custom resource when the access key is rotated.
  LambdaLogRetention:
    Type: Number
    Default: 7
    Description: Retention period (in days) for the Lambda function's CloudWatch log group.
  KMSKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional ARN of a customer-managed KMS key for encrypting SSM parameters.
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^arn:aws:kms:[a-z0-9-]+:\\d{12}:key/[a-f0-9-]{36}$"

Conditions:
  HasKMSKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref KMSKeyArn, ""]]

Resources:
  SESGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: "SES-SMTP-Group"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "SES-Send-Policy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ses:SendEmail
                  - ses:SendRawEmail
                Resource: "*"

  IAMUser:
    Type: AWS::IAM::User
    Properties:
      UserName: !Ref IAMUserName

  UserToGroupAddition:
    Type: AWS::IAM::UserToGroupAddition
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Ref SESGroup
      Users:
        - !Ref IAMUser

  IAMAccessKey:
    Type: AWS::IAM::AccessKey
    Properties:
      UserName: !Ref IAMUser

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SSMAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:PutParameter
                  - ssm:DeleteParameter
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/ses-smtp/*"
        - !If
          - HasKMSKey
          - PolicyName: KMSAccess
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: "2012-10-17"
              Statement:
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - kms:GenerateDataKey
                    - kms:Decrypt
                  Resource: !Ref KMSKeyArn
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  LambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/lambda/${LambdaFunction}"
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LambdaLogRetention

  LambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, os, boto3, hashlib, hmac, base64, logging
          import cfnresponse

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          def sanitize(name):
              import re
              return re.sub(r'[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]', '-', name)

          def generate_smtp_password(secret_key, region):
              date = "20220101"
              service = "ses"
              message = "SendRawEmail"
              terminal = "aws4_request"
              ksecret = ("AWS4-HMAC-SHA256" + secret_key).encode()
              kdate = hmac.new(ksecret, date.encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest()
              kregion = hmac.new(kdate, region.encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest()
              kservice = hmac.new(kregion, service.encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest()
              ksigning = hmac.new(kservice, terminal.encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest()
              signature = hmac.new(ksigning, message.encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest()
              return base64.b64encode(signature).decode()

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              logger.info("Event: %s", json.dumps(event))
              request_type = event['RequestType']
              props = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})
              response_data = {}
              physical_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId', None)

              try:
                  if request_type in ['Create', 'Update']:
                      username = props.get('UserName', '')
                      access_key_id = props.get('AccessKeyId', '')
                      secret_access_key = props.get('SecretAccessKey', '')
                      kms_key_arn = props.get('KMSKeyArn', '')
                      region = os.environ.get('AWS_REGION', 'us-east-1')

                      sanitized_user = sanitize(username)
                      physical_id = f"sessmtp-{sanitized_user}"

                      smtp_password = generate_smtp_password(secret_access_key, region)

                      ssm = boto3.client('ssm')
                      username_path = f"/ses-smtp/{sanitized_user}/SMTPUsername"
                      password_path = f"/ses-smtp/{sanitized_user}/SMTPPassword"

                      kwargs = {
                          'Name': username_path,
                          'Value': access_key_id,
                          'Type': 'SecureString',
                          'Overwrite': True
                      }
                      if kms_key_arn:
                          kwargs['KeyId'] = kms_key_arn
                      ssm.put_parameter(**kwargs)

                      kwargs['Name'] = password_path
                      kwargs['Value'] = smtp_password
                      ssm.put_parameter(**kwargs)

                      response_data = {
                          'SMTPUsernamePath': username_path,
                          'SMTPPasswordPath': password_path
                      }
                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      if physical_id:
                          sanitized_user = physical_id[len('sessmtp-'):]
                          ssm = boto3.client('ssm')
                          for path in [f"/ses-smtp/{sanitized_user}/SMTPUsername", f"/ses-smtp/{sanitized_user}/SMTPPassword"]:
                              try:
                                  ssm.delete_parameter(Name=path)
                              except:
                                  pass

                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, response_data, physical_id)
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error("Error: %s", str(e))
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'error': str(e)}, physical_id)

  SESSMTPCredentials:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt LambdaFunction.Arn
      UserName: !Ref IAMUserName
      AccessKeyId: !Ref IAMAccessKey
      SecretAccessKey: !GetAtt IAMAccessKey.SecretAccessKey
      KMSKeyArn: !Ref KMSKeyArn
      RotationVersion: !Ref RotationVersion

Outputs:
  IAMUserName:
    Description: Created IAM username.
    Value: !Ref IAMUser
  AccessKeyId:
    Description: IAM access key ID for the user.
    Value: !Ref IAMAccessKey
  SMTPUsernamePath:
    Description: SSM Parameter Store path for SMTP username.
    Value: !GetAtt SESSMTPCredentials.SMTPUsernamePath
  SMTPPasswordPath:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'WebSocket API with Lambda and DynamoDB for grant-processing status updates'

Parameters:
  AppName:
    Type: String
    Default: WebSocketApp
    Description: Application name used for resource naming
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: API Gateway stage name
  CustomRouteKey:
    Type: String
    Default: message
    Description: Route key for the custom message route
  AdditionalKMSDecryptRoles:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional list of IAM role ARNs allowed to decrypt Lambda env vars (comma separated)

Resources:
  # DynamoDB table for WebSocket connections
  ConnectionsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          KeyType: HASH

  # KMS key for Lambda environment variables
  LambdaEnvKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting Lambda environment variables
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - !If
            - HasAdditionalDecryptRoles
            - Sid: Allow Additional Roles to Decrypt
              Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: !Ref AdditionalKMSDecryptRoles
              Action:
                - kms:Decrypt
                - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              Resource: '*'
            - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  LambdaEnvKmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${AppName}-LambdaEnvKey
      TargetKeyId: !Ref LambdaEnvKmsKey

  # KMS key for CloudWatch Logs
  LogGroupKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting API Gateway CloudWatch Logs
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow API Gateway Logging Role
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt ApiGatewayLogRole.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow CloudWatch Logs Service
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'

  LogGroupKmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${AppName}-LogGroupKey
      TargetKeyId: !Ref LogGroupKmsKey

  # Lambda execution role
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${AppName}-LambdaExecutionRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt ConnectionsTable.Arn
        - PolicyName: KMSDecrypt
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt LambdaEnvKmsKey.Arn

  # Lambda function
  LambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ${AppName}-Handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      KmsKeyArn: !GetAtt LambdaEnvKmsKey.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref ConnectionsTable
          STAGE_NAME: !Ref StageName
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, boto3, os
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          table_name = os.environ['TABLE_NAME']
          stage = os.environ['STAGE_NAME']
          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)
          apigw = boto3.client('apigatewaymanagementapi')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              route_key = event.get('requestContext', {}).get('routeKey', '$default')
              connection_id = event.get('requestContext', {}).get('connectionId')
              domain = event['requestContext']['domainName']
              apigw_endpoint = f'https://{domain}/{stage}'
              apigw_client = boto3.client('apigatewaymanagementapi', endpoint_url=apigw_endpoint)

              if route_key == '$connect':
                  # Store connection
                  table.put_item(Item={'connectionId': connection_id})
                  return {'statusCode': 200}

              elif route_key == '$disconnect':
                  # Remove connection
                  try:
                      table.delete_item(Key={'connectionId': connection_id})
                  except ClientError:
                      pass
                  return {'statusCode': 200}

              elif route_key == '$default':
                  # Default handler
                  return {'statusCode': 200}

              elif route_key == 'message':
                  # Custom message handling: send status update to the connection
                  # In real scenario, parse body and act accordingly
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body', '{}'))
                  # Example: echo back
                  apigw_client.post_to_connection(Data=json.dumps({'status': 'received'}), ConnectionId=connection_id)
                  return {'statusCode': 200}

              return {'statusCode': 200}
      Description: 'WebSocket handler for grant-processing status updates'

  # API Gateway WebSocket API
  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AppName}-WebSocketApi
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: $request.body.action

  # Integration with Lambda
  LambdaIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${LambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      PayloadFormatVersion: '1.0'

  # Routes
  ConnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $connect
      Target: !Sub integrations/${LambdaIntegration}

  DisconnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $disconnect
      Target: !Sub integrations/${LambdaIntegration}

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $default
      Target: !Sub integrations/${LambdaIntegration}

  CustomRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: !Ref CustomRouteKey
      Target: !Sub integrations/${LambdaIntegration}

  # Stage with auto-deploy
  Stage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      StageName: !Ref StageName
      AutoDeploy: true

  # Lambda permission to allow API Gateway invoke
  LambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*/*

  # IAM role for API Gateway CloudWatch logging
  ApiGatewayLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${AppName}-ApiGatewayLogRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ApiGatewayCloudWatchLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:PutRetentionPolicy
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/apigateway/*

  # API Gateway Account-level settings for CloudWatch logging (V1 resource)
  ApiGatewayAccount:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Account
    Properties:
      CloudWatchRoleArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayLogRole.Arn

  # Log group for API Gateway execution logs (encrypted with LogGroupKmsKey)
  ApiGatewayLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/apigateway/websocket-${WebSocketApi}
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogGroupKmsKey.Arn

# Conditions for additional decrypt roles
Conditions:
  HasAdditionalDecryptRoles: !Not [!Equals [!Join ['', !Ref AdditionalKMSDecryptRoles], '']]

# Outputs
Outputs:
  WebSocketURL:
    Description: WebSocket connection URL
    Value: !Sub wss://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${Stage}
  WSSEndpoint:
    Description: Secure WSS endpoint
    Value: !Sub wss://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${Stage}
  ApiArn:
    Description: ARN of the WebSocket API
    Value: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}

      Tags:
        - Key: environment

  SNSTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy

        - !Ref SNSTopic

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: SNS:Publish
            Resource: !Ref SNSTopic

  SSMAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'elasticache-test-ssm-automation-${AWS::StackName}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: environment
          Value: test

  SSMAutomationPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      PolicyName: elasticache-test-ssm-automation-policy
      Roles:
        - !Ref SSMAutomationRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: ssm:SendAutomationSignal
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-execution/*'

Outputs:

    Description: The ID of the ElastiCache Replication Group
    Value: !Ref ReplicationGroup

    Description: The ARN of the SNS Topic
    Value: !Ref SNSTopic

    Description: The ARN of the IAM role for SSM Automation
    Value: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
  KMSKeyId:
    Description: The ID of the KMS key
    Value: !Ref KMSKey

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template for a Cognito-secured REST API with protected and public endpoints.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub "${AppName}UserPool"
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "${AppName}UserPoolClient"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        RefreshToken: days
  LambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AppName}LambdaRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${AppName}Lambda"
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  claims = event['requestContext']['authorizer']['claims']
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'headers': {
                          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                          'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'
                      },
                      'body': json.dumps({
                          'authenticated': True,
                          'claims': {
                              'sub': claims['sub'],
                              'email': claims.get('email'),
                              'cognito:username': claims.get('cognito:username', ''),
                              'email_verified': claims.get('email_verified', '')
                          }
                      })
                  }

                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'headers': {
                          'Content-Type': 'application/json',

        - !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  MeResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource

      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: me
  OpenResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: open
  MeMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MeResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref Authorizer
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY

        Uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${Lambda.Arn}/invocations"
  OpenMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref OpenResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${Lambda.Arn}/invocations"
  LambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref Lambda
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApi}/prod/GET/*"
  Deployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - MeMethod
      - OpenMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      StageName: prod
